tei:div.tei:p: rtsom sgrig u yon lhan khang /kru'u rin/ dgra 'dul/kru'u rin gzhon pa/ gdugs dkar tshe ring /gtso sgrig pa/ bsod nams tshe ring /gco sgrig gzhon pa/ rta mgrin skyabs/ rin chen don grub/sgrol ma rgya ma31/rtsom sgrig u yon/ rdo rje tshe ring / tshe ring thar/ gsang bdagapad+ma rdo rje/ blo gros/ bde skyid sgrol ma/bkra rgyal/ zla ba tshe ring / dbang phyug mtsho mo/lis zha'o kru'u/ lha byams rgyal/

sngon 'gro'i gtam/legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs la 'jug pa'i sngon 'gro'i gtam/gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing ri klung bar khams thams cad rnam par dag pa'i bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir/bod mi rigs rnams lo ngo stong phrag du ma'i snga rol nas gzhis chags shing 'tsho gzhes gnang ste 'od stong rnam par bkra ba'i lo rgyus bskrun yod la/ khyad par du bod rig pa zhes mtshan snyan 'dzam gling yangs pa'i khyon la mngon par ldir ba'i rig gnas kyi bang mdzod zad mtha' med pa zhig nga tsho phyi rabs pa'i bgo skal du stsal cing / gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu'i mkhas dbang mang po rim par byon nas dus rabs so sor rnam pa mi 'dra ba'i rtsom rig gi brtsams chos sna tshogs shig rtsom gnang mdzad pa dang /bod rang gi khyad chos dang yongs su mthun pa'i legs bshad ces pa'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa gsar ba zhig gsar skrun bgyis pa des/1

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rtsom rig spyi'i rigs sam lus kyi rnam pa je mang je tshang du btang ba yin pas/ rtsom rig gi gzhung lugs thad bla na med pa'i mdzad rjes shig dang rmad du byung ba'i dge mtshan zhig bskrun par snang ngo / /skabs bab kyi brjod bya legs bshad ces pa'i tha snyad de don gang la 'jug ce na/ yongs grags su sgra yangs 'jug dang dog 'jug gnyis su dbye ste brjod par bya dgos te/ tshig sbyor snyan zhing don gyis phyug pa'i gsung rnam dag dang bstan bcos mtha' dag la legs bshad ces pa sgra yangs 'jug gi don yin la/ rtsom stangs nges can zhig gis 'ching ba'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa zhig la legs bshad ces pa sgra dog 'jug gi don yin no/ /de ltar 'jug pa'i don gnyis ni phan tshun 'gal bar mi 'gyur te/ de gnyis bdag nyid gcig pa'i 'brel ba yod pa'i phyir/ sgra dog 'jug gi don ldan pa'i brtsams chos yin na yangs 'jug gi don gyi rang bzhin ldan pas khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /yin na'ang sgra yangs 'jug gi don ldan pa'i brtsams chos yin na dog 'jug gi don gyi bdag 2

sngon 'gro'i gtam/nyid ldan pa'i brtsams chos yin pa'i nges pa ma mchis so/ /'dir brjod pa'i legs bshad ni sgra dog 'jug gi don yin te/ rtsom rig gi rnam pa zhig la brjod pa yin no/ /'di lta bu'i legs bshad ces pa'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa der khyad chos ci zhig ldan zhe na/ de la 'di ltar brtag dgos te/brjod bya sna mang phun tshogs la dpe don legs par sbyar te tshigs bcad kyi rnam pas ston pa'i rtsom rig gi brtsams chos la legs bshad ces pa'i tha snyad btags pa yin/ de'i brjod bya sna mang phun tshogs yin par smra bar rgyu mtshan yod de/ rtsom pa pos bo da kyi spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab dang bstun nas chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ chos lugs/ slob gso/ dmag dom/ la sogs pa chos dang 'jig rten gyi bya dngos mang po la legs par dpyad nas/chos lugs kyi bsam blo/ srid 'dzin gyi thabs lam/ mkhas blun gyi spyod pa/ blang dor gyi tshad gzhi bcas lkog gyur gyi don mang po la rang nyid kyi lta stangs dang bzhed tshul gsal bar ston pa'i brtsams chos yin pa'i phyir ro/ /legs bshad bstan bcos de sgyu 3

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rtsal gyi rang bzhin yongs su gtams pa'i rtsom rig gi brtsams chos yin pa'i dbang gis/ de'i rjod byed kyi tshig dang ston byed kyi thabs la brtsams chos gzhan dang mi mthun pa'i khyad chos mang po yod/ mdor sdud na/ legs bshad kyi brtsams chos mtha' dag tshigs bcad kyi rnam pa yin pa dang gcig sho lo ka gcig las tshig rkang gnyis dpe dang tshig rkang gnyis don snga phyi nges med du legs par sbyar te bstan bya rdzogs par ston pa dang gnyis/gsal byed kyi dpe skye bo mkhas blun thams cad kyis nyams su myong ba'am thos pa las byung ba'i yun ring du 'dris pa'i bya dngos yin pa dang gsum/ tshig sbyor bde zhing go sla ba/ dmangs khrod kyi gtam dpe'i rang bzhin ldan pa/ skye bo kun gyis dka' tshegs med par bde blag tu 'jug nus pa dang bzhi/ tshig snyan zhing ro nyams ldan pa/ skye bo mchog dman kun gyi mig gi bdud rtsir gyur pa dang lnga'i khyad par gyi yon tan ldan pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i yon tan lnga ldan gyi rtsom rig gi rnam pa de/ bod mi rigs kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus thog gal che zhing 'phang mtho ba'i go sa yod par mkhas pa 4

sngon 'gro'i gtam/rnams kyis yang yang du bsngags pa'o/ /legs bshad rtsom rig de bod la ji ltar byung ba dang ji ltar 'phel ba'i lo rgyus thad cung tsam dpyad na/ bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum dang tun hong yig cha nas zhal gdams zhes pa dpe don sbyar nas bslab bya'i rang bzhin yod pa'i brtsams chos byung / de dag ni legs bshad rtsom rig gi sa bon lta bur gyur te/ rtsom rig gi rnam pa de bod yul du thog mar gzhi chags so/ /de rjes spyi lo dus rabs bcu gsum par sa skya parnyi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis zhal gdams de dag gi srol rgyun gzhir byas shing / 'phags yul gyi rtsom rig skye bo gso thigs sogs brtsams chos 'ga' dper byas nas legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba'i sho lo ka bzhi brgya lhag yod pa'i brtsams chos mdzad de/ legs bshad rtsom rig gi rnam gzhag gtan la phab/ dus rabs bcu drug par paṇa chen bsod nams grags pas sa skya legs bshad kyi rnam gzhag dang cha yongs su mtshungs pa'i mkhas blun brtag pa'i bstan bcos dge ldan legs 5

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bshad pad+ma dkar po'i chun po zhes bya ba sho lo ka brgya lhag ldan pa'i bstan bcos mdzad de/ legs bshad rtsom rig gi rnam pa de je rgyas je legs su btang / de rjes dus rabs bco brgyad par gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes gong smras legs bshad bstan bcos dag ma dper byas nas chu'i bstan bcos dang shing gi bstan bcos zhes bsdoms pas sho lo ka nyis brgya lhag yod pa'i bstan bcos gnyis mdzad pa dang / dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i mkhas dbang dkyil zur blo bzang sbyin pas gung thang pa'i chu shing bstan bcos kyi rtsom stangs dang yongs su mthun pa'i lugs zung ba dan g.yo ba'i legs bshad rlung gi bstan bcos zhes bya ba sho lo ka drug cu lhag yod pa'i bstan bcos dang / 'jig rten mi chos dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya gsal bar ston pa'i legs bshad zla ba'i bstan bcos zhes pa sho lo ka sum cu lhag yod pa'i bstan bcos sogs du ma mdzad/ brtsams chos de dag ni thog mtha' bar gsum du dpe chos can gcig gi steng du de'i skyon yon brtags shing don dang sbyar nas bslab bya'i tshul gyis ston pa yin 6

sngon 'gro'i gtam/pas legs bshad kyi rtsom stangs gsar ba zhig spel ba yin/gzhan yang mkhas dbang 'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtshos gong smras legs bshad rtsom stangs kyi legs cha yongs su bsdus nas rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos zhes bya ba le'u nyer gcig dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos mdzad de/ legs bshad kyi rtsom stangs gong nas gong du spel ba yin no/ /smras pa/ skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi pir rtse las/ /thon pa'i leṭa par bshad pa'i bstan bcos rnams/ /rang re gangs can rtsom rig bang mdzod du/ /'od 'bar nor bu gcig tu ci yang snang / /de yang 'dzam gling rig gnas dga' tshal du/ /legs bshad ces pa'i me tog mtshar sdug cig /rnam par bzhad pas phyi nang mkhas pa yi/ /yid kyi bung ba dbang med phyogs 'dir 'khor/ /'di ltar legs bshad kyi che ba brjod pa dang rtsom rig gi rin thang dpog pa ni/ rtog bzo dang sgro 'dogs kyi gtam tsam ma 7

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/yin te/ bstan bcos de dag gi dngos gzhi dang de las byung ba'i phan yon gyis bsgrubs pas so/ /'o na legs bshad bstan bcos las byung ba'i phan yon ci yod ce na/ gzhan phan dge phyogs la mos pa dang sdig pa mi dge ba spong dgos pa'i slob gso gtong ba dang gcig yon tan la bstod cing blun rmongs la smad pa'i bsam blo spel ba dang gnyis/ las la brtson pa dang le lo spong dgos pa'i gnas lugs bstan pa dang gsum/ che ba la gus shing chung ba la gces pa'i lugs bzang spel ba dang bzhi/ mthun sgril la dga' zhing dbyen 'byed la sdang ba'i spyod bzang dar spel gtong ba dang lnga'o/ /'di lta bu'i phyogs lnga las bslab bya'i tshul gyis gdams te/ mi rnams kyi bsam blo dag sbyong dang kun spyod legs skyong byed pa la phan yon dpag dka' ba byung zhing / bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas dpal yon dang bsam blo'i dpal yon 'dzugs skrun byed pa dang spyi tshogs mthun sgrig byed pa la phan nus gzhal dka' ba bton pa yin no/ /da res mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis legs bshad 8

sngon 'gro'i gtam/bstan bcos de dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs zhes pa'i dpe tshogs par skrun byas pa de/ spyi tshogs la phan pa'i dge mtshan dang / rig gnas la phan pa'i don snying ldan pa zhig yin no/ /gna' mo'i legs bshad bstan bcos kyis/ /spel ba'i dgongs pa'i dge mtshan de/ /deng gi bsam blo'i dpal yon gyi/ /don snying dang mthun e ma rmad/ /ces spyi lo2006lo'i zla3pa'i tshes24nyin gyi na ba blo bzang chos grags kyis bris pa'o/ /bkra shis/ dge'o/ /

dkayangachag da dkar chagarab tu byed pa dang po/ bag yod byed pa/ (3)rab tu byed pa gnyis pa/ mi bdag mkhas pa brtag pa/ (10)rab tu byed pa gsum pa/ spyod pa brtag pa/ (22)rab tu byed pa bzhi ba/ bdag dang gzhan gyi ngag brtag pa/ (34)rab tu byed pa lnga ba/ 'khor gyi skye bo brtag pa/ (47)rab tu byed pa drug pa/ bden smra lung bstan pa'i mdo las gsungs pa rgyal po'i tshul gyi le'u'i don bshad pa/ (65)rab tu byed pa bdun pa/ mdo sde dran pa nyer bzhag las gsungs pa rgyal po'i lugs/ (97)rab tu byed pa brgyad pa/ gser 'od dam pa las byung ba'i rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos/ (108)rab tu byed pa dgu ba/ brtan zhing brtson pa brtag pa/ (116)rab tu byed pa bcu ba/ mi bdag dul ba brtag pa/ (136)rab tu byed pa bcu gcig pa/ kun la snyoms pa brtag pa/ (145)1

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ rab tu byed pa bcu gnyis pa/ snying rje brtag pa/ (157)rab tu byed pa bcu gsum pa/ mi yi bdag po rang gis rang nyid legs par srung ba'i tshul brtag pa/ (169)rab tu byed pa bcu bzhi ba/ yul 'khor bde bar srung ba'i tshul brtag pa/ (202)rab tu byed pa bco lnga ba/ gros brtag pa/ (215)rab tu byed pa bcu drug pa/ dge bcu'i chos dang ldan pa'i tshul brtag pa/ (224)rab tu byed pa bcu bdun pa/ chos kyi rgyal po'i khrims brtag pa/ (232)rab tu byed pa bco brgyad pa/ thabs la mkhas pa'i sgo nas phyogs lanu/ rnam par rgyal ba'i tshul brtag pa/ (252)rab tu byed pa bcu dgu ba/ chos la sems pa'i tshul brtag pa/ (269)rab tu byed pa nyi shu ba/ bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po brtag pa/ (279)rab tu byed pa nyer gcig pa/ lugs la gnas pa dang 2
sa kyi bstan bcos kyi yon tan brtab

rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos/༄༅/ /rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rgya gar skad du/ rā dza nī ti shās+t+ra bhū mi pā la su a laṅgā ra nā ma/bod skad du/ rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan zhes bya pa/ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal mchog ston pa tshad ma'i skyes bu dang / /rnam grol 'jug ngogs bstan pa rin po che/ /de 'dzin 'phags tshogs 'jig rten rgyan gyur pa/ /dkon mchog gsum la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa ye shes 'od zer can/ /'gro ba'i yid kyi mun pa rnam sel ba/ /'jam dpal smra ba'i nyi ma gang de yis/ /

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/skye rgu'i blo gros pad tshal skyong bar mdzod/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras 'phags pa chen po rnams/ /bsam bzhin skye rgu'i mgon du legs bzhugs pa/ /lha dang mi yi dbang phyug mchog rnams dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs kyis shis par mdzod/ /gang 'dir phan dang bde ba'i legs lam sgo/ /dam pa rnams kyi mdzad par rag las phyir/ /mi bdag rnams dang phal ba dag gis kyang / /don gnyis yid bzhin 'grub par bya ba'i slad/ /rgyal ba mchog dang rgyal sras che rnams dang / /mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams kyi bstan bcos las/ /snying po bsdus shing go sla'i ngag gis ni/ /gsal bar phye ste brtse bas bshad par bya/ /2

bag yod byed pa/rab tuzud pha dang dzo/ bag yod zudapha/blo gros rab tu gsal gyur cing / /lugs las mi g.yo brtan pa dang / /brtse bas 'khor 'bangs mnyam par skyong / /bsod nams rgya cher 'du byed pas/ /nyi ma lhun po sa gzhi dang / /chu gter lta bur bsngags 'os pa'i /mi bdag gang na gnas pa ni/ /'khor gyi skye bo nyer 'tsho'i gzhi/ /mi shes slob phyir blang dor gnas/ /'chugs med khrims kyis legs 'dzin pa'i/ /sa skyong bzang na skye rgu bde/ /ngan na 'khor 'bangs sdug bsngal 'thob/ /de phyir skye bo phal mo che/ /kun las rgyal po gnyan pa'i phyir/ /3

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mi dbang rnams kyi spyod pa las/ /phan gnod 'bras bu rgya cher 'byin/ /kun gyis lta zhing rtog pa'i gnas/ /yin phyir rgyal po rgyal rigs kyi/ /spyod pa bzang ngan phra mo yang / /'jig rten na ni brjod cing dpyod/ /sa bdag blo gros ldan pa rnams/ /ya rabs lugs la shin tu mos/ /'od zer stong dang ldan pa yi/ /nyi ma 'jig rten 'di na mdzes/ /ya rabs dam pa'i tshul la ni/ /mi mos gdol pa'i spyod pa can/ /phal ba yin yang mi mdzes na/ /rgyal po'i rigs la smos ci dgos/ /rigs ngan skye bo'i tshogs rnams dang / /lhan cig spyod pa 'dres gyur na/ /sus kyang bkur bar mi 'gyur zhing / /4

bag yod byed pa/brnyas bcos mi snyan rjod par byed/ /dbang dang 'byor pa ldan pa yi/ /rgyal rigs phal cher bag med pas/ /myos pa'i glang chen bzhin du 'khyams/ /de yi 'khor yang de 'drar 'gyur/ /gzhan yang rgyal po rgyal rigs kyi/ /spyod pa bzang ngan ji 'dra ba/ /de 'dra'i tshul la bltas nas su/ /'bangs rnams de dang de 'dra ste/ /rgyal po nor la brkams gyur na/ /nor gyis rgyal khrims bslu bar rtsom /mi bdag g.yem la dga' gyur na/ /'phyon ma'i tshogs rnams mgo 'phang mtho/ /phra mar nyan na dbyen gyis gtor/ /brtag dpyad mi shes rdzun gyis bslu/ /nga lo yang na kun gyis bskyod/ /ngo dgar brtsi na zol tshig smra/ /5

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/de dang de la sogs pa yi/ /mi bdag de la gang gang gis/ /bslu bar rung ba'i skabs mthong na/ /g.yon can tshogs kyis thabs de sems/ /mi rnams rang 'dod sna tshogs la/ /rgyal po kun gyi thun mong phyir/ /rgyal pos bsam gzhig ma byas na/ /tha mar rgyal srid 'jig par 'gyur/ /chen po'i go sar gnas pa la/ /skyon kyang yon tan yin tshul du/ /'khor ngan rnams kyis ngo bstod smra/ /de phyir skyon yon shes pa dka'/ /lhag par rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i tshe/ /'khor gyi nang na ma rabs mang / /skyon yang yon tan ltar mthong la/ /rang 'dod che zhing rgyal po bslu/ /chus dang 'khor gyi bde thabs la/ /6

bag yod byed pa/bsam gzhig byed pa dkon pa'i phyir/ /rgyal pos legs par dpyad nas su/ /bden pa'i ngag las gzhan pa dor/ /rgyal po nor gyis mi dbul zhing / /'khor gyi ngo bstod mi thos min/ /nor gyis bslu dang ngo bstod dang / /zol tshig rnams la dga' mi bya/ /rgyal rigs rnams kyis rnam kun tu/ /'di ltar bsam gzhig gtang bya ste/ /'khor du gtogs pa'i skye rgu 'di'i/ /bde sdug bdag la rag las shing / /'di kun bdag gis 'chos dgos na/ /thog mar bdag gis rigs pa dang / /mi rigs gang yin ma shes par/ /skye rgu'i blang dor bya ba la /rang nyid dpang por mi 'os pas/ /rgyal ba mchog dang rgyal sras kyi/ /7

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rgyal po'i lugs kyi bstan bcos las/ /ji skad gsungs pa mnyan par bya/ /thos pa'i don la rtse gcig tu/ /brtags nas yid ches rnyed 'gyur tshe/ /bdag ni skye rgu skyong ba yi/ /mgon dang mig tu bsngags pas na/ /phal las mchog tu ma gyur na'ang / /dman dang mnyam pa ga la zhes/ /bdag la rtogs shing bag yod pa'i/ /mi bdag de ni don dang ldan/ /sa skyong yon tan ldan gyur na/ /'khor gyi skye bo'i tshogs rnams kyang / /rang 'dod ma rabs bya ba la/ /'jug pa'i go skabs dgag par bya/ /yon tan gang yang mi 'tshol bar rigs kyi nga rgyal tsam zhig gis/ /rang gi 'khor la 'tshe ba ni/ /8

bag yod byed pa/rgyal rigs yin kyang tha mar nyams/ /rgyal po'i mnga' thang che chung ni/ /'khor gyi dar gud rjes su 'gro/ /de phyir 'bangs kyi bde thabs la /legs par gzhig pa rgyal po yin/ /lugs kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan las/ bag yod pa'i rab tu byed pa ste dang po'o//

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rab tu zud pa gnyis pa/ mi bdag mkhas pa brtag pa/mi yi bdag po mchog rnams kyis/ /lugs dang lugs min shes pa'i slad/ /sna tshogs bstan bcos bslab bya zhing / /yon tan can la bsten par bya/ /bstan bcos rnams la ma byang na/ /blo gros chung ngu'i shes pa yis/ /blang dor rgya chen mi 'byed pas/ /bka' dang dgongs 'grel blta bar bya/ /yon tan bslab pa'i dus nyid na/ /che tshugs spangs te bla ma bsten/ /dam pa rnams la bsten byas na/ /yon tan dbyar gyi chu bzhin 'phel/ /10

mi bdag mkhas pa brtag pa/mthong dang ma mthong yon tan ni/ /kun gyi rtsa ba shes rab yin/ /shes rab med na yul 'khor la/ /byams pa tsam gyis skyong mi nus/ /shes rab ldan pas brtsams byas na/ /mi 'grub pa ni gang yang med/ /shes rab stobs kyis sangs rgyas kyang / /'grub par nus na gzhan lta ci/ /shes rab rgya cher 'phel ba'i sgo/ /thos pa yin pa de yi phyir/ /'bad de thos pa mi 'tshol bar/ /mnog chung bya bas ci zhig bya/ /chos don 'dod dang thar pa yi/ /'byung gnas chen po rig pa yin/ /rig pa spel ba'i gzhung bzang po/ /byin kyang mi mkho phyugs min nam/ /shes rab ldan pa gcig pus kyang / /

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/stobs ldan dgra tshogs pham par nus/ /'od zer mchog tu 'phags pa yi/ /nyi mas skar tshogs mnan pa bzhin/ /shes rab med na 'byor pa sogs/ /yod kyang dgra yi gsos su 'gro/ /stobs dang ldan yang gzhan dbang 'gyur/ /lcags kyus glang chen bkol ba 'dra/ /gang zhig mkhas par 'dod pa na/ /nyi ma re la tshig re zung / /cha yis bsags par gyur pa na/ /zla ba yar ngo bzhin du 'phel/ /ma bslabs kha rog 'dug pa la/ /lo brgya song yang bzang skyed med/ /mkhas pa'i spyod yul 'thob 'dod na/ /brtson pas dka' ba dang du longs/ /brtson pa med la yon tan med/ /yon tan med na dpal 'byor la/ /12

myidzhabadag mkhas pa brtag pa/re sgug byed pa 'bras med de/ /dgun gyi ljon shing ji bzhin no/ /gal te yon tan yod gyur na/ /re zhig rgud par gyur kyang bla/ /mi ring bde ba'i 'bras 'byin te// /dpyid ka'i ljon shing bzang po bzhin/ /rgyal po rang gi yul na rtsi/ /yon tan ldan pa yul gzhan bkur/ /rgyal srid las kyang don che ba'i/ /yon tan rang gis len pas chog /yon tan blangs pas chog bzhin du/ /rang la yon tan mi sbyor zhing / /yon tan can la 'khu ba rnams/ /kye ma las kyi mthu yis bcom/ /shes rab rtsal dang bral ba yi /skye bo mang du tshogs na yang / /seng ges glang chen khyu bzhin du/ /13

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/blo ldan gcig gis cham la 'bebs/ /pha rol stobs dang ldan gyur kyang / /blo dang ldan na bkol du btub/ /'thab tshe mkha' lding rgyal na yang / /tha mar khyab 'jug bzhon par byas/ /shes rab rtsal dang ldan pa yis/ /sa rnams ma lus skyong byed pa'i/ /rgyal po gcig pu kho nas kyang / /nor 'dzin mtha' dag bdag gir nus/ /shes rab mar me thogs gyur na/ /rgud pa'i mun pa der mi gnas/ /gtsug lag shes pa'i blo gros can/ /nyi ma bzhin du 'jig rten rgyan/ /chos dang srid kyi legs tshogs kun/ /shes rab stobs la rag las phyir/ /thog mar shes rab mig bsgrubs te/ /de nas gang 'dod bsgrub par bya/ /14

mi bdag mkhas pa brtag pa/bya ba min dang bya ba'i gnas/ /tre mi shes pa yis don chung ngu / /'bad pas bsgrubs kyang 'grub dka' na/ /don chen 'grub pa lta ci smos/ /phal bas sgrub par mi nus pa/ /shes rab ldan pas thabs kyis 'grub/ /gang pos ma thul gcer bu'i tshogs/ /'jam dpal shes rab ldan pas brtul/ /shes rab rgya cher 'phel ba na/ /bya ba kun la thogs rdugs med/ /dmus long stong gis bgrod dka' ba'i/ /lam rnams mig ldan gcig gis gcod/ /shes rab ldan pa'i ngag tsam gyis/ /phal ba rnams kyis don chen 'grub/ /rgyal po me long gdong zhes pa'i/ /tshig las gzhan dag bde ba thob/ /mkhas pa legs bshad kyis mi ngoms/ /15

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dam pa yon tan gyis mi ngoms /rgya mtsho chu yis ngoms pa med/ /byis pa 'dod yon gyis mi ngoms/ /skyon dang yon tan 'dres pa dang / /dus dang dus ma yin pa dang / /mkhas dang mi mkhas khyad par sogs/ /mkhas pas 'byed kyi blun pos min/ /bstan bcos zab mo'i don dang ni/ /gal chen gnad kyi bya ba la/ /sbyar tshe mkhas blun khyad par rtogs/ /ltar snang mkhas dang blun po mnyam/ /mkhas pas skyon sel yon tan sgrub/ /blun pos skyon sgrub yon tan spong / /blun pos mkhas la dpya byed kyang / /mkhas pas blun la snying rje skye/ /blun po ji ltar 'byor gyur kyang / /smyig ma 'bru chags bzhin du 'dzad/ /16

mi bdag mkhas pa brtag pa/mkhas pa ji ltar rgud gyur kyang / /sa bon grung po bzhin du 'phel/ /mkhas pa yon tan ldan pa rnams/ /legs bshad byis pa las kyang len/ /blun po rang mthong che ba rnams/ /mkhas pa byung tshe gzhan du byol/ /legs par bshad pas mi mgu zhing / /zab don thos na mi nyan la/ /don chung gnas la cher brtson pa/ /blun po rnams kyi rtags yin no/ /phan pa'i gdams pa chud gson cing / /dam pa min la lhag par dad/ /dam pa'i skye bor yid 'khu ba/ /'di yang blun por mtshon pa'i sgo/ /bden par smras na yid mi ches/ /gya gyur khrid na de rjes 'brang / /ngo bstod tsam gyis mgu byed pa/ /17

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ 'di 'dra rmongs pa rnams kyi rtags/ /mthong ma thag tu yid rton byed/ /gang smras pa la bden par 'dzin/ /gang byung las la nan gyis 'jug /'di yang blun por mtshon pa'i brda/ /mi 'grub bya bar khas len byed/ /ma brtags gang thos de bzhin smra/ /ma shes don yang gya tshom sgrogs/ /'dis kyang blun por shes par byed/ /ma dris rang gi yon tan smra/ /rgyu mtshan med par gzhan la 'tshe/ / brnyas thabs byed cing rang mthong che /'di 'dra gang byung blun po yin/ /blun po'i rtags la tshad med kyang / /'di las mtshon te mkhas rnams kyis/ /blun po'i rang bzhin shes sla zhing / /de las gang ldog mkhas par shes/ /18

mi bdag mkhas pa brtag pa/blun po nga rgyal che ba dang / /rgyal po ngan dang chung ma ngan/ / —yul ngan rnams ni spangs byas na/ /rang nyid bde ba 'thob par 'gyur/ /mkhas pa dul zhing brtan pa dang / /rgyal po bzang dang mdza' bzang dang / /yul bzang rnams la brten byas na/ /bdag nyid dga' ba 'phel bar 'gyur/ /de phyir mkhas dang blun po yi/ /skyon dang yon tan shes byas nas/ /rgyal po lugs la mkhas pa yis/ /mkhas pa'i yon tan blang bar bya /'jig rten sgyu rtsal rig pa dang / /khyad par rgyal po lugs kyi gzhung / /bzo dang gso ba sgra tshad dang / /nang don rig pa'i gzhung lugs bslab/ /rtsis rig snyan ngag sdeb sbyor sogs/ /19

zhe—/legasabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bslab par bya ba gang la yang / /rgyal rigs mkhas pas mi slob med/ /mkhas pa rgyal po'i rgyan gyi mchog /khyad par rgyal ba'i bka' dang ni/ /dgongs 'grel rnams kyi don bslabs na/ /shes par bya ba'i gnas rnams la/ /'a jigs pa med pa'i spobs pa 'thob/ /de ltar rgyal po blo gros mchog ldan pa/ /sa yi steng na mtshungs med rgyan gyur te/ /sa steng mun pa mtha' dag 'joms byed pa'i/ /nyi ma las kyang mchog tu 'di 'phags so/ /nyin mor byed pas gzhom par ma nus pa'i/ /skye rgu'i nang gi mun pa ma lus pa/ /mi bdag nyi ma'i snang bas mngon sel phyir/ /sa skyong de la ngo mtshar 'bum dang ldan/ /sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i 'jig rten gyi/ /blo ldan yid kyi pad tshal ji snyed pa/ /20
mi dbang mkhas pa'i nyi ma de dang gnyen/ /de phyir sa gsum dpal du shar ba 'o/ /lugs kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan las/ mi bdag mkhas pa brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa ste gnyis pa'o//

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rab tu zud pa gsum pa/ s+hod pa brtag pa/mi bdag rnams kyi spyod lam ni/ /shin tu brtags te bsgrim par bya/ /gang phyir ma brtags spyod pa phal/ /chung yang grags pa nyams pa'i rgyu/ /sa skyong rang gi gnas khang du/ /nor bu bzhin du sba bar bya/ /rgyal po khri dang mi 'bral zhes/ /'jig rten grags pa don dang ldan/ /ma mthong rgyang nas rtsi 'gyur la/ /mthong thos mang na phal dang 'dra/ /rgyal khab dang ni rgyal po'i rgyus/ /gzhan gyis shes par mi bya 'o/ /rgyal po lam du 'gro ba na/ /dpung dang bcas te che rtags kyis/ /22

spyod pa brtag pa/rgyal mtshan bzhin du phyar te 'gro/ /dus min 'khyams pa nam yang min/ /nga rgyal med kyang rgyal rigs rnams/ /che ba'i rtags dang 'bral mi bya/ /che ba spangs nas phal ba bzhin/ /rgyu ba mnga' thang nyams pa'i rtags/ /phyi nas che ba'i spyod lam gyis/ /me dang 'dra bar bzod dka' yang / /drung du phyin na zhun mar bzhin/ /dul ba'i spyod lam mkhas pas spyad/ /bla ma dge sbyong bram ze sogs/ /bkur 'os rnams la ches 'dud cing / /rigs kyi rgan rabs bkur byas na/ /rgyal rigs rang nyid che ba 'thob/ /mi 'os skye bo'i che thabs dang / /'os pa'i che tshugs shor ba gnyis/ /skye bo khrel ba'i rgyu ru mtshungs/ /23

— legasabashad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ da wade slad 'os shing rigs par spyad/ /sems kyis bag yod byas gyur na/ /lus dang ngag gi spyod pa la/ /bcos su mi btub gang yang med/ /de bas dus su bag yod bya/ /gang zhig sngon chad bag med kyang / /phyis nas bag dang ldan gyur na/ /sprin bral zla ba ltar 'gyur te/ /dga' bo mthong ldan la sogs bzhin/ /skye bo'i cha lugs ltas dag las/ /phyi nas 'byung 'gyur bzang ngan mngon/ /de bas gna' bo ya rabs kyi/ /lugs srol dag las 'da' mi bya/ /nang na yon tan kun ldan yang / /cha lugs ngan na kun gyis brnyas/ /de phyir 'byor pa'i 'os dang bstun/ /chas rgyan ya rabs lugs su bya/ /24

tshospyod pa brtag pa/nor med rgyan dga' che ba dang / /'byor ldan hrul po'i chas zhugs pa/ /gnyis ka 'jig rten bzhad gad rgyu/ /de phyir rgyan chas 'tsham par spyad/ /rgyan chas bzang pos brgyan pa yi/ /'khor ni gtso bo'i che rtags 'gyur/ /rta la rgyan gyis brgyan pa ni/ /bdag po nyid la mdzes pa bzhin/ /sna tshogs skad du gtam smras kyang / /kla klo mgu bar mi 'gyur la/ /kla klo rang gi skad smras na/ /de nyid mgu bar 'gyur ba bzhin/ /bsam pa chung ngu'i 'jig rten rnams/ / nang gi yon tan mi shes pas/ /phyi tshul bzang po 'jig rten dang / /mthun par byas na 'jig rten mgu/ /de phyir sems dpa' mchog rnams la/ /25

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'phyor po'i 'du shes mi mnga' yang / /'jig rten yid rab drang ba'i phyir/ /ya mtshan cha lugs ston par mdzad/ /blo ldan go 'phang mtho gyur pa/ /de lta de ltar spyod pa bzang / /nor bu rgyal mtshan rtser mchod na/ /dgos rgu yid bzhin stsol bar byed/ /ma rabs mtho ba'i sar bzhag na/ /spyod ngan je bas je mang 'phel /the'u rang phug gi lhar bsten na/ /'khu ldog cho 'phrul je cher 'gro/ /kun spyod ngan pa'i skye bo rnams/ /'khor du bsdu bar mi bya ste/ /'khor g.yog ngan pa'i skyon dag gis/ /rgyal po la yang 'phyar ka gtong / /'khor bzang spyod pa bzang mthong nas/ /skye rgu kun kyang dga' ba skyed/ /26

spyod pa brtag pa/de phyir ya rabs spyod pa can/ /kho na 'khor du bsdu bar bya/ /dus kyi dga' ston ma gtogs pa/ /rgyun chags rtsed mos g.yengs gyur na/ /phal ba yin yang don nyams na/ /che ba'i rigs la smos ci dgos/ /chang gis sems 'chal bag med skye/ /des ni blang dor spyod pa nyams/ /rang blo mun par byas pa la /blun po rnams kyis bde bar bsgom/ /nyin gyi dus su'ang phyogs kun tu/ /sa bdag rgyu ba mi mdzes na/ /mtshan mo'i dus na 'byung po bzhin/ /kun tu 'khyams pa lta ci smos/ / nyin re bzhin yang dran shes kyis/ /bslab dang bzlas sgom ci nus bya/ /'bangs kyi skye bo'i don la brtag /27

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/le lo byas na don kun 'chor/ /sdig pa'i grogs po bsten gyur na/ /sdong bo srin gyis zos pa ltar/ /legs tshogs 'grib cing nyes pa 'phel /skyon kun rtsa ba grogs ngan yin/ /'dus pa'i tshogs la lta ba sogs/ /'phyar g.yeng che na sdod mi tshugs/ /shing bal rlung gis bskyod 'dra ba'i/ /rgyal rigs spyod pa ji ltar mdzes/ /de phyir mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ /rgyan po 'gyed dang 'dus la lta/ /le lo dang ni sdig grogs bsten/ /chang 'thung mtshan mor rgyu ba ni/ /grags pa nyams pa'i rgyu drug ces/ /bshes pa'i spring yig dag las gsungs/ /de dag rnams kyis mtshon nas su/ /chos min bya ba kun kyang spang / /28

spyod pa brtag pa/bya ba min dang bya 'os pa/ /gang la zhugs kyang goms nas 'phel/ /de bas dran shes bag yod kyis/ /rang rgyud 'chos na bzang por 'gyur/ /spyod pa bag dang ldan pa la/ /mtha' dag skye bos bkur 'gyur zhing / /bag med rnams kyang de mthong tshe/ /'jigs bcas zil gyis gnon par 'gyur/ /'dod pa phung krol kun gyi rgyu/ /rgyal bas kim pa'i 'bras 'drar gsungs/ /'dod la zhen pa ma log kyang / /ha cang 'dod chen nyid mi bya/ /tshangs par spyod pa'am dge bsnyen gyi/ /khrims ldan rgyal po 'jig rten na/ /rgyu skar dbus su zla ba bzhin/ /skye bo'i kun dga' 'phel bar byed/ /rgyal rigs rang gi chung ma las/ /29

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gzhan la log par g.yem gyur na/ /tshe 'dir grags pa ngan pa dang / /phyi mar ngan song ltung bar 'gyur/ /'dod pa'i lcags kyus zin pa na/ /rgyal rigs yin kyang gzhan dbang 'gro/ /glang chen lus stobs ldan na'ang / /mchil pas btab tshe bran bzhin byed/ /'dod pa rnams ni cher bsten na/ /phyir zhing rtswa la me bzhin 'phel/ /de yis dpal dang grags pa nyams/ /de phyir chog shes byas na bde/ /sa steng 'dod pa'i longs spyod kun/ /skye bo gcig la bdog gyur kyang / /ngoms pa med par slar yang brkam/ /de bas 'dod la chog shes bya/ /chog shes ldan na 'byor pa'i mchog /ran tshod zin na bya ba'i rab/ /30

spyod pa brtag pa/bya ba snyoms na phyi thag ring / /phan sems che na rje bo'i phul/ /de bas bag yod sems kyis su/ /spyod lam kun tu mdzes bya ste/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang gdul bya phal/ /spyod lam gyis ni 'dul bar mdzad/ /gnya' shing gang tsam lta byas nas/ /gom pa snyoms shing dal bus 'dor/ /'gro na legs par mdzes pa ni/ /'khor du glang po'i dbang po bzhin/ /stan la g.yo med drang por 'dug /bag phebs dal bu'i spyod lam can/ /'dug na gser gyi ri bzhin du/ /brtan par gyur na kun tu mdzes/ /zas kyi tshod zin rgyug brel nyung / /snga bar ldang zhing gos tshags bcos/ /dus su ran par smra ba yi/ /31

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mi bdag de ni bde ba ldan/ /khyi ra ba dang ri dwags gshor/ /smad 'tshong sdud dang 'khor med par/ /dgon pa'i nags su rgyu ba rnams/ /rgyal pos nam yang mi bya 'o/ /don med chu chen brgal ba dang / /sbrul gdug gcan gzan sogs dang rtse/ /mi bsrun rta la zhon pa sogs/ /byas na rang nyid nyams pa srid/ /de bas rgyal po rgyal rigs kyi/ /lus dang spyod lam mtha' dag ni/ /bka' dang bstan bcos las gsungs bzhin/ / legs par bsgrims te bsrung bar bya/ /mthong ba tsam gyis dga' ba rab skyed pa'i/ /rgyu skar bdag po 'chi med lam na gnas/ /skye rgu'i mig gi yul du mngon mdzes pa'i /sa yi bdag po sa steng 'dir ni rgyu/ /32

spyod pa brtag pa/'khor tshogs rgyu skar dbus na mngon mtho zhing / /lugs bzang lha lam yangs por gnas bzhin du/ /ya rabs spyod pa bzang po'i 'od bzang can/ /sa yi bdag po zla ba rgyas pa 'dis/ /sa bla'i lha rnams dga' ba skyed nus na/ /sa steng mi yi 'gro ba smos ci dgos/ /de phyir sa bdag spyod pa bzang po rnams/ /gang du bzhugs pa'i yul der bkra shis 'phel/ /lugs kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan las/ spyod pa brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa ste gsum pa'o//33

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rab tu zud dze+e baji ba/ bdag dang gzhan gyi ngag brtag pa/'jig rten 'jug ldog bya ba rnams/ /ngag gi lam nas shes byed phyir/ /smra ba'i tshig rnams gang la'ang / /skyon yon bsams te smra bar bya/ /res 'ga' ma smras don mi 'grub/ /res 'ga' mi smra don dag bsgrub/ /smra dang mi smra ma shes na/ /smra 'chal 'gyur te nyes pa mang / /tshig bden pa ni yon tan mchog /de phyir rgyal rigs bden par smra/ /bden par smra rnams bstod bya zhing / /rdzun smra smad cing spang bar bya/ /34

bdag dang gzhan gyi ngag brtag pa/gsang bar 'os pa ma bshad kyang / /dgos pa'i dbang gis 'gal ba med/ /de min tha mal gtam dag ni/ /cung zad rdzun kyang tha shal rtags/ /skye bo mkhas shing drang ba la/ /drang por smras na mgu 'gyur te/ /blun cing gya gyur spyod rnams la/ /ji bzhin bshad kyang dgos pa chung / /byams ltos can gyi skye bo la/ /'khyog bshad mi bsre drang por bshad/ /kha nas ci 'byung tshod nyul la/ /drang por mi bshad ci 'os brjod/ /phan gnod med pa'i gtam rnams las/ /don chen yid la brnags pa'i las /dus min par ni khar dbyung na/ /kun gyis thos shing don mi 'grub/ /shin tu gsang bar 'os pa ni/ /35

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rang las gzhan pa su la'ang min/ /mdza' bas mdza' bar tshig spel nas/ /tha ma rgyal khams khyab par 'gyur/ /ji ltar mdza' bar gyur kyang ni/ /dgos med gsang tshig smra mi bya/ /gsang tshig bud med la smras pas/ /skye bo phal cher nyams la ltos/ /tshig kun mi smra gsang mi dgos/ /thams cad bshad par bya ba'ang min/ /dus la bab nas gros byed tshe/ /che thabs mi bya gnad don brjod/ /bstod pas 'jig rten mgu 'gyur te/ /pha rol tu'ang rang nyid bde/ /de bas gzhan gyi yon tan la/ /'khu bar mi bya bstod par bya/ /gzhan la bstod pa byas gyur na/ /rang nyid gzhan gyis bstod par byed/ /36

bdag dang gzhan gyi ngag brtag pa/gzhan la ci tsam smad byas pa/ /de tsam rang nyid gzhan gyis smad/ /bsod chung phrag dog ldan pa rnams/ /gzhan la smad pa 'ba' zhig byed/ /de yis gzhan la mi gnod la/ /rang gi grags pa brlag par 'gyur/ /blo dang bsod nams ldan pa yis/ /gzhan gyi yon tan chung ngu la'ang / /snyan par smra zhing legs par brjod/ /de yis rang nyid snyan grags 'thob/ /bstod bsngags 'jig rten rgyan yin kyang / /blun po nga rgyal can la dug /rdzun dang 'dres pa'i zol tshig gis/ /su la yang ni bstod mi bya/ /dngos su bstod cing lkog tu smad/ /lce gnyis sbrul dang mtshungs pa yi/ /skye bo ngan pa cir mi rung / /37

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/don ldan smra ba 'jig rten rgyan/ /sbyin sogs phan pa rgya che yang / /tshig rtsub smras na gzhan yid ldog /ma byin ma phan ma bskyangs kyang / /snyan par smra bas 'jig rten sdud/ /ma btab gnad du zug pa'i mtshon/ /ma 'thungs khong du song ba'i sman/ /ma zos yid 'phrog sbrang rtsi'i ro/ /tshig gi khyad par rnams la yod/ /dgra dang gnyen du gyur pa phal/ /bya ba gzhan las byung ba nyung / /tshig las byung ba shin tu mang / /de phyir tshig rnams brtags te smra/ /dus su ma bab pa yi gtam/ /gang smra de la kun gyis brnyas/ /dus su bab cing 'thad pa yi/ /ngag tshig bzang pos rang gzhan phan/ /38

bdag dang gzhan gyi ngag brtag pa/char gyi rgyun chen phab na yang / /snod chung nang du ji ltar chud/ /blo rgyud dman la gdams byas kyang / /phan pa rgya cher 'byung mi srid/ /blo bzang dam pa'i skyes bu la/ /zur tsam smras kyang phan pa che/ /phan tshig sman dang 'dra ba de/ /bshad dang nyan par byed pa'ang dkon/ /dbye phyir phra ma'i ngag rnams ni/ /smra ba lta ci mnyan mi bya/ /gal te mnyan par 'os pa la'ang / /brtags shing nges pa'i bar du bsgug /tshig rtsub mang na 'khor rnams 'byer/ /rdzun gyis rang gzhan thams cad phung / /'khyal ba'i ngag gis don nyams sdud/ /de phyir de dag spang bar bya /'di las brtsams te ngag rnams la/ /39

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ skyon dang yon tan rab mang po/ /so sor shes par byas nas su/ /smra dang mi smra shes par bya/ /rgyal khams che la bzang ngan gyi/ /skye bo sna tshogs yod pa'i phyir/ /blun zhing mi bsrun gyur rnams la/ /phan pa'i tshig gis gdul dka' yang / /rgyal khrims drang po'i thig btab nas/ /'di las 'gal bar gyur rnams la/ /chad pa 'di ltar 'byung ngo zhes/ /rna ba'i yul du thos par bsgrag /ci nas bcos su med rnams la/ /'os pa'i chad pa ma bcad na/ /mi bsrun 'phel bas rgyal khams 'jig /de bas dang por smras bzhin bya/ /'khor 'bangs gang phan skyong ba sogs/ /rgyal po'i chus la phan pa'i mi/ /40

bdag dang gzhan gyi ngag brtag pa/gang yin shes nas de dag la/ / phan pa'i tshig gis bsngags par bya/ /las byed dpon du bskos gyur kyang / /rang 'dod kho nas phyogs bzung na/ /de la gnad kyi mtshang brtol te/ /phyin chad las 'di bzlog ces bsgo/ /rgyal rigs chos dang ldan pa rnams/ /'khor la bu bzhin byams pa'i phyir/ /dang por 'jam pos bsgo ba las/ /thog ma kho nar tshar gcod min/ /de ltar byas na skye bo phal/ /log pa'i lam nas bzlog kyang srid/ /cis kyang bzlog par ma gyur na'ang / /bdag por 'khu ba'i blo mi 'byung / /ya rabs rnams la bstod bya zhing / /ma rabs rnams kyi mgo 'phang smad/ /de ltar legs nyes shan 'byed pa'i/ /41

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mi bdag gang na yod pa der/ /skye bo ya rabs dga' 'gyur zhing / /ma rabs rnams kyang bag yod 'gyur/ /ldog na ma rabs skye bo yis/ /sa steng gang gyur chus srid brlag / mi yi dbang pos legs brtags nas/ /smras pa'i tshig las 'gyur mi bya/ /rgyal po'i smra ba lan gcig ces/ /'jig rten na ni yongs su grags/ /sngon byon chos ldan rgyal rnams kyis/ /bka' las gang byung de mi bzlog /bka' khrims legs bcad slar 'gyur na/ /bka' la rtsis thang chung bar 'gyur/ /smra ba'i ngag la mkhas pa yi/ /mi bdag de ni 'jig rten na/ /nyi ma bzhin du gsal gyur te/ /dgos pa'i don kun 'grub par 'gyur/ /42

bdag dang gzhan gyi ngag brtag pa/mngon shes med pa'i skye bo yis/ /'jig rten legs nyes rnam pa kun/ /ngag tshig la brten rtogs pa'i phyir/ /smras pa'i ngag la legs par brtag /skye bo 'du shes sna tshogs pas/ /brjod pa'i tshig kyang sna tshogs smra/ /phal cher bsam pa dkar na yang / /blo mi gsal bas gang byung smra/ /g.yon can rnams kyis rang 'dod don/ /'grub par bya phyir slu tshig sbyor/ /phal cher phrag dog gya gyu yis/ /gzhan la gnod pa 'ba' zhig smra/ /lhag par snyigs ma'i dus 'di na/ /gzhi med rdzun gyis rgyal khams phung / /de phyir su dang gang gis kyang / /smras tshad rjes su mi 'brang la/ /smras tshad rdzun du'ang mi gzung bar/ /43

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bden nam rdzun pa gang yin pa/ /ma gsal bar du yid la bzhag /gsal bar gyur nas don la 'jug /'bangs kyi bde sdug zhu tshig rnams/ /bshad tshul mkhas dang mi mkhas dang / /rgyab skyor mgo 'dren bzang ngan gyi/ /tshig gi g.yam la mi rgyug par/ /bden rdzun mtha' la bskyal te dpyad/ /de yis 'bangs kyi legs nyes dang / /zhu byed blon gyi ngang tshul shes/ /rang nyid khrims la mkhas par 'gyur/ /blang dor gnad la phan pa yi/ /ma shes gsar du spron byed tshig /smyon pa'i ngag las byung yang rung / /rang don shes pas de nyid bzung / /gang zhig de bzhin bzung ba na/ /'phral yun gnod par 'gyur ba'i ngag /44

bdag dang gzhan gyi ngag brtag pa/bla ma'i gsung las byung na yang / /spang bar bya na gzhan lta ci/ /yul gyi bde sdug skyon yon rnams/ /phal cher don med ngag las gsal/ /bden pa'i mi la dri zhing dpyad/ /don med ngag las don rtogs mang / /de phyir rgyal rigs mkhas pa rnams/ /su la'ang gtam gyi 'dri rmed dag /'gog pa'i che thabs mi sbyor bar/ /dus su 'dri ba mkhas pa'i gnad/ /khyed la bstod do smad do zhes/ /nang mis rtog pa sna tshogs ngag /mi 'dri mi rmed btang snyoms bzhag /don ldan yin na dri bar bya/ /smras pa'i tshig las skye bo yi/ /nang gi bsam pa phal cher shes/ /de las bya dang mi bya ba/ /45

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'ga' zhig khong du chud par 'gyur/ /rang nyid smra ba'i tshul la legs mkhas shing / /gzhan gyis smras la rigs dang mi rigs rtogs/ /smra ba'i ngag la tshul bzhin legs 'jug pa/ /ngag gi dpal mo lta bur grags pa 'thob/ /gzugs med gyur kyang gzhan yid 'phrog byed la/ /gtong ba med kyang rnam mang skye rgu sdud/ /'od med gyur kyang nang gi mun sel ba'i/ /smra ba bzang po ngo mtshar rnam mang ldan/ /mi bdag smra la mkhas pa 'jig rten na/ /nyi ma las kyang shin tu 'od gsal zhing / /skye rgu'i yid kyi mun pa rnam bsal nas/ /dga' ston pad+ma'i tshal chen rgyas par byed/ /lugs kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan las/ bdag dang gzhan gyi ngag brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa ste bzhi ba'o//46

da wa 'khoragyiskyebo brtag pa/rab tu zud pha lja ba/ 'khor gyi skye bo brtag pa/mi yi bdag pos rang gi yul/ /bde bar bsrung bar bya ba'i phyir/ /ya rabs tshul la gnas rnams la/ /ji ltar 'os pa'i go 'phang sbyin/ /dam pa dpon du bskos gyur na/ /rang gi 'bangs la lhag par byams /tshul des rang gi chus srid brtan/ /mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal po bzhin/ /ma rabs mtho sar bzhag gyur na/ /rang gi ris la lhag par 'tshe/ /tha ma rang nyid brlag 'gyur te/ /pags pa sngon po'i wa bzhin no/ /blo khog yangs shing phyi mthar blta/ /blang dor tshul bzhin dpyod la mkhas/ /47

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rang 'dod chung zhing 'bangs la sems/ /de 'dra gang yin blon por 'os/ /rigs bzang ngo tsha khrel yod kyis/ /lus tshugs srung zhing chos la dkar/ /yid mthun ya rabs spyod pa can/ /rgyal rigs rnams kyi btsun mor 'os /spyod pa bzang zhing bsgo ba nyan/ / 'chal gtam srung zhing rje la brtse/ /bden par smra ba'i skye bo rnams/ /nang mi mdun na 'don la dbang / /brda sprod gzhung la ma rmongs shing / /snyan ngag la sogs rig byed shes/ /yig gzugs 'bri la legs mkhas pa/ /smyug 'dzin drung yig pa ru bshad/ /lugs bzhin gtong la mi 'jungs shing / /nor rdzas don med chud mi gzan/ /dus la sgrim zhing blo ldan pa/ /48

'khor gyi skye bo brtag pa/mdzod 'dzin phyag tshad bya bar 'thad/ /khrims la mkhas shing phyogs lhung med/ /drang zhing brtag dpyad gzob pa dang / /rgyu 'bras blang dor tshul bzhin sems/ /de 'dras zhal lce bcad na legs/ /snying stobs che zhing zhe gnag la/ /pha rol gnon pa'i sgyu thabs shes/ /sems brtan 'gyar 'gyur med pa rnams/ /dmag dpon dag gi go sar dbang / /blo gros rgya che bsam pa dkar/ /bsod nams rgyas shing klung rta dar/ /lha dang srung ma 'khor gyur pa/ /gang yin gros byed grogs su 'os/ /bslab ldan mang thos rnal 'byor can/ /chos kyi bya bar gcig tu gzhol/ /khrims kyi zhu sna mi byed pa/ /de 'dra yongs 'dzin bla mar bya/ /49

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rgyal po'i pho brang dag tu ni/ /rtsis rig rnams la mkhas pa dang / / gso dpyad tshul bzhin shes pa sogs/ /gtsug lag mkhas rnams rgyun du bzhag /sgo pa dang ni nyug rum pa/ /bang mi bran dang las byed sogs/ /so so'i mtshan nyid ji lta bur/ /bshad pa bzhin du gzhag par bya/ /gang na rgyu 'bras mi bsnol zhing / /spyi la snyoms pa'i sems yod pa/ /de 'dra dpon du bskos gyur na/ /grong ngam grong khyer dag tu bde/ /'di dag rnams las bzlog pa la/ /gang byung go sa ster gyur na/ /so so'i las don mi 'grub cing / /rgyal srid dma' ba'i rgyu ru 'gro/ /de phyir mi bdag mkhas pa yis/ /50

'khor gyi skye bo brtag pa/yon tan dag gi go rim bzhin/ /mi la go 'phang so sor sbyin/ /stes dbang go sa ster mi bya/ /nad la gtong ba'i sman bzhin du/ /so so'i rang skal yon tan gnad/ /ji ltar tshang bas don 'grub kyi/ /thams cad 'grub pa'i mi de dkon/ /snyigs ma'i dus kyi rgyal rigs rnams/ /rang blo gang la 'thad pa'i mis/ /ci byed kha lo bsgyur nas su/ /tha mar rang gzhan 'gyod par sbyor/ /sa skyong blo dang ldan pa rnams/ /rtag tu rang dbang yod byas nas/ /gzhan ngo'i dbang du mi gtang yang / /gzhan dag mgu bar byed la mkhas/ /lus kyi rgyan dang bran gyi tshogs/ /ji ltar 'os pa'i gnas su bzhag /51

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mngags pa'i pho nya bzo yi spyad/ /ji ltar 'tshams pa'i las la sbyar/ /mi yi bdag po'i las byed rnams/ /gang yang rung bas mi chog gi /rdo las gser ltar bkrabs nas su/ /yon tan ldan pa gzhag par bya/ /brgya stong nang nas res 'ga' tsam/ /yon tan che ldan 'byung na yang / /khron sbal gyis ni rgya mtsho bzhin/ /mi rnams phal gyis de mi shes/ /bya ba'am skyes bu'i bzang ngan ni/ /mngon du gyur tshe sus kyang shes/ /sa bon la ni nus pa bzhin/ /snga nas shes na mkhas pa yin/ /cang shes rta dang skyes bu mchog /phal ba'i tshul dang sbyar mi rung / /skye bo ngan dang srin mo'i gzugs/ /52

'khor gyi skye bo brtag pa/ya mtshan gnas su 'dzin mi rung / /blo ldan gtsug lag shes pa dang / /bsod nams che zhing ya rabs rnams/ /yul gyi rgyan du gyur pas na/ /de la rgyal po dga' bar bya/ /ya rabs yon tan can la dga'/ /ma rabs rku khram rngon par dga'/ /chags can smad 'tshong ma la dga'/ /'jungs pa zas dang nor la dga'/ /snyigs ma'i dus kyi rgyal rigs phal/ /bzang po byed la rjes 'dzin med/ /ngan byed tshar gcod med gyur tshe/ /bzang po rnams kyang yi chad 'gyur/ /gang na mi bdag bzang po yis/ /bzang byed rnams la thugs brtse na/ /bzang po'i phyogs rnams spro 'gyur zhing / /ngan pa'ang bzang po'i phyogs su gzhol/ /53

da leg/sabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gang na mi bdag ngan pa yis/ /ngan pa rnams la rjes brtse na/ /ngan pa'i phyogs rnams spro 'gyur zhing / /bzang po'ang ngan pa'i phyogs su gzhol/ /las kyi dbang gis rgyal pos gzhan/ /brtse ba'i gnas su gyur na yang / /ji ltar 'os par dga' bya yi/ /mi 'os dbang gtad ci la bya/ /nang mi 'khor gyi skye bo yis/ /mi rigs bya ba byed na yang / /shin tu tshar gcod mi bya ste/ /'jam po'i thabs kyis rgyang du 'dor/ /nye ba'i 'khor du gyur rnams la/ /rgyu mtshan chung ngus khro mi bya/ /'khor rnams bu bzhin legs bskyangs na/ /kun gyis rgyal po pha bzhin sems/ /blon dang las byed mi rnams la/ /54

'khor gyi skye bo brtag pa/rtag tu brtse bas bskyang bya ste/ /gang phyir rgyal po'i bde sdug ni/ /'khor gyi skye bo'i lag na gnas/ /las byed rnams la ci 'os pa'i /za thang dang ni legs pa'i las/ /bsgrubs pa'i dga' ston gnang sbyin rnams/ /rgyal pos dgag par mi bya 'o/ /legs byas brjed par mi bya bar/ /drin du gzo zhing bsngags pa brjod/ /'khor la byams pas snyoms khyab na/ /'khor rnams 'du zhing don kun 'grub/ /'khor rnams kyis kyang rgyal po la/ /bu gcig bzhin du brtse bya ste/ /'khor gyi che ba gang thob pa/ /rgyal po nyid kyi dpal las byung / /rgyal rigs mi bsrun gyur na yang / /'khor gyis rgyal po ci nus bsrung / /55

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mig la nad ni byung gyur kyang / /bcos par bya yi 'byin mi rigs/ /blon dang zhal lce gcod rnams kyis/ /legs nyes tshul bzhin rting gcod bya/ /gnyen gyi ngo dang gsug 'bul la/ /lta na rgyal khams brlag par 'gyur/ /rgyal po'i chus la mi lta ba'i/ /rang 'dod che de blon yin na/ /rku dang rngon pa smad 'tshong ma/ /blon gyi go sar cis mi dbang / /rang 'dod med par rgyal khams la/ /lta zhing snyoms pa blon po yin/ /rgyal khams bde ba'i thabs byas na/ /rang don phun tshogs zhar la 'byu nga / /gang na tshul dang mthun pa yi/ /blon po rin chen gcig yod kyang / /rgyal po'i chus la phan pas na/ /56

'khor gyi skye bo brtag pa/rgyal khams de na de nyid btsun/ /mi la bzang ngan sna tshogs kyi/ /skyon yon khong na gnas gyur pa/ /kha nas bshad pa ci 'dra yang / / lag gi bya bas nges par rtogs/ /de phyir rgyal po rgyal rigs kyi/ /las byed blon du 'os mi 'os/ /yongs su brtags nas 'byed bya yi/ /gang byung byas na rgyal srid dma'/ /de ltar shes nas rgyal po yis/ /bzang po rnams la dbang gtad cing / /ngan pa rnams la dbang mi bskur/ /rgyal khams bde 'dod de ltar bya/ /rgyal po rab tu gyur pa rnams/ /chos la sems pa gtso bor byed/ /rgyal khams bde ba'i thabs la brtson/ /de yis rgyal srid yar zla bzhin/ /57

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rgyal po 'bring du gyur pa rnams/ /mnga' thang rgyas pa'i thabs la sems/ /rang gi sde ris legs par skyong / /de yis rgyal srid yun du brtan/ /rgyal po tha mar gyur pa rnams/ /'bangs la mi sems nor la sems/ /rtsa ba nyams pa'i shing bzhin du/ /de yis rgyal srid myur du 'jig /'bangs la chad pas mnar ba yi/ /nor gyis rgyal po brngan byas pas /mi bdag ngan pa mgu 'gyur te/ /kye ma snyigs ma'i blo gros mtshar/ /mi la chos ni gtso bo ste/ /chos kyis 'di phyi kun tu phan/ /de 'og mnga' thang snyan grags gtso/ /de yis tshe 'dir dpal dang ldan/ /de gnyis gtso bor mi byed par/ /58

'khor gyi skye bo brtag pa /nor la bltas nas khrims 'phyugs pa/ /skye rgu'i dbang por mi 'os pas/ /chen po'i go sar mi dbang ngo / /de slad rgyal po'am blon po'am/ /grong gi rje bo yin kyang rung / /'os shing dbang ba'i nor blang gi /gnas min nor la bsam mi bya/ /mi las che ba'i go sa ni/ /rin chen gser gyis nyos na'ang dkon/ /chen po'i go sar bzhag pa gang / /de nyid rgyal po'i bdag rkyen yin/ /bkren pa rnams la zas gtso ste/ /'byor ldan rnams la rin chen gtso/ /ya rabs rnams la go 'phang gtso/ /de phyir go sa de srung gi /go sa thob nas pha rol la /ji ltar phan par 'gyur snyam du/ /59

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/sbyin pa'i bsam pa bskyed bya yi/ /'phrog pa'i bsam pa bskyed mi bya/ / go 'phang mthon por gnas rnams kyis/ /pha rol tshul bzhin bskyangs byas na/ /zas nor ma bsdus ngang gis 'du/ /nor med gyur na'ang go 'phang brtan/ /des na chen po'i go sa la/ /gnas pa rnams kyis tshul bzhin du/ /rgyal po'i chus dang rgyal khams la/ /phan pa 'ba' zhig bsam par bya /lugs bzhin byed pa'i sa skyong la/ /de yi nye du'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /sna tshogs bsam pa'i phyogs bzung ba'i/ /gnas min ngo chen zhu mi bya/ /gal te pha ma'am bla mas kyang / /mi 'os pa yi zhu sbyor na/ /rgyal pos de la gnad bkrol te/ /60

'khor gyi skye bo brtag pa/khrims 'gal bya ba skabs mi dbye/ /khrims dang lugs las mi 'gal ba'i/ /phan pa gang dang ci yis kyang / /gnyen dang 'khor gyi skye bo yis/ /bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par bya/ /rgyal po'i gros su gtogs rnams kyis/ /rang 'dod phyogs zhen mi smra bar/ /bzang ngan blang dor bya ba'i gnad/ /gang shes tshul bzhin zhu bar bya/ /rgyal pos bla mar bzung rnams kyis/ /rgyal po de nyid tshe 'di dang / /khyad par 'jig rten gzhan dag tu/ /bde ba'i thabs la yang dag bsam/ /chos min byas na mi rigs zhes/ /rgyal po la ni gzhen bskul gdab/ /chos dang mthun pa'i bya ba la/ /ji ltar nus par dgod par bya/ /61

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/srog la bab pa'i chad las sogs/ /lugs dang mi 'gal 'ga' zhig las/ /'jig rten khrims kyi bya ba la/ /ngo chen bla mas gsung mi bya/ /bla ma shin tu gnyan pa'i phyir/ /bka' las bzlog par mi rigs pas/ /zhu ba mang na rgyal pos kyang / /bgyi bar dka' ba dag tu 'gyur/ /de phyir bla mas rgyal po bsrung / /rgyal pos bla ma bsrungs bgyis na/ /tshe 'dir thugs mthun bkra shis la/ /phyi ma'i dus na bde bar 'gyur/ /gang la rgyal po thugs brtse ba/ /de yis rgyal po de nyid la/ /gang phan 'ba' zhig bsgrub bya ste/ /bdag la thugs ni brtse'o zhes/ /rang don sna tshogs zhu sbyor gyis/ /62

'khor gyi skye bo brtag pa/rgyal po gnas min sbyor byed pa/ /de 'dra khrel med yin pa'i phyir/ /rgyal pos shes nas dor bar bya/ /'khor dang bcas te rgyud dag pa/ /bzang po'i gser dang mtshungs rnams kyis/ /skye rgu skyong ba'i thabs bstan pa'i/ /lugs kyi bstan bcos brtag par bya/ /de ltar rgyal rigs bsod nams ldan pa yis/ /blo gros stobs kyis skye bo legs brtags nas/ /yon tan ldan pa'i 'khor gyis legs mdzes pa/ /sā la'i shing chen bzhin du mngon par mtho /'khor bzang dag dang nges par ldan gyur na/ /dman pa'i mi yang rgyal rigs che dang mnyam/ / rgyal po bzang zhing 'khor yang bzang gyur na/ /yangs pa'i sa chen dpung bas 'dzin par nus/ /rgyal po gcig pus sa rnams mtha' dag gi /skye rgu'i legs nyes gtan la dbab par dka'/ /63

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'khor tshogs bzang po 'khor du bsdus byas na/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor kun tu dge bar 'gyur/ /mi yi bdag pos 'khor rnams legs bskyang zhing / /'khor gyi skye rgus rje la mngon mchod pa/ /de dang lhan cig bde dang skyid pa yis/ /rgyal khams phyur bur gang ba bzhin du 'gyur/ /lugs kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan las/ 'khor gyi skye bo brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa ste lnga ba'o//64

rgyal po'i tshul gyi don bshad pa/rab tu zud pa drug pa/ bden smra lung bstan pa'i mdo las gsungs pa rgyal dzo'i tshul gyi lethubi don bshad pa/thabs kyi rnam 'phrul bstan pa'i mdor/ /byang sems bdag nyid chen po gang / /mu stegs 'dul ba'i gzugs bzung ba/ /bden par smra ba'i skyes bu la/ /mi bdag gtum po rab snang gis/ /rgyal po rnams kyis skye rgu ni/ /ji ltar bskyang bar bya zhes su/ /dris shing bstan pa'i don rnams ni/ /gsal bar 'di ru brjod bya na/ /mi bdag rnams kyis gus pas nyon/ /skye rgu zhes ni bya ba yang / /65

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/phung po lnga ste 'di la gnyis/ /skye ba bzhis bsdus sems can dang / /'byung lngas bsdus pa snod kyi khams/ /skyong tshul rang rang las dang ni/ /skye rgu'i bdag pos skyong ba gnyis/ /dang po sgra mi snyan pa dang / /bskal pa dang po'i mi rnams bzhin/ /longs spyod dag gis mi phongs la/ /phan tshun 'tshe dang rtsod pa med/ /gzhan yang bskal bzang dus kyi mi/ /pha ma bkur zhing dge chos spyod/ /rgyal por gdags pa med na yang / /rang rang las kyis bde bar skyong / /gnyis pa de rnams ma gtogs gzhan/ /skyong la skye rgu'i bdag ces bya/ /'di la 'khor los sgyur ba dang / /rgyal po che dang khams kyi rgyal/ /66

rgyal po'i tshul gyi don bshad pa/rgyal phran bzhi las 'khor sgyur ni/ /tshe lo brgyad khri yan chad 'byung / /mi bdag gser gyi 'khor lo can/ /kun gyi spyi nas dbang bskur ba/ /mtha' 'am gling bzhi las rgyal zhing / /dge bcu'i chos kyi lam la ni/ /rang nyid gnas phyir chos dang ldan/ /gzhan yang der 'god chos kyi rgyal/ /phyogs las rgyal byed 'khor lo dang / /bzhon mchog ngo mtshar glang po che/ / rtse dga'i mchog gyur btsun mo dang / /snang byed yo byad mchog nor bu/ /longs spyod mchog ldan khyim bdag dang / / dpa' mdzangs bde byed blon po mchog /shul lam bder bgrod rta mchog ste/ /rin chen sna bdun dag dang ldan/ /sa rnams mtha' dag kun nas su/ /67

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rang gi ris su dbab 'gyur te/ /ji ltar zhe na phyir rgol bas/ /gnod med sdo ba med par ni/ /nan gyis bgyi bas 'tshe ba med/ /mtshon gyis 'tshe dang chad pa yis/ /mnar ba dag ni med bzhin du/ /mi rigs gsum spang chos mthun gyis/ /phyogs su ma lhung snyoms pas so/ /gang zhig gling bzhir gnas pa yi/ /rgyal po rgyal phran ji snyed pas/ / 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po der/ / bdag gnas 'byor pa dang ldan pa/ /skye bo'i tshogs kyis gang ba 'di/ /bzhes la bdag cag skyong mdzod dang / /bdag cag lha nyid zhabs 'bring du/ /mchi bar 'tshal zhes 'dud par byed/ /'khor sgyur de yis de kun la/ /68

rgyal po'i tshul gyi don bshad pa/rang rang mnga' ris gtogs pa rnams/ /chos dang mthun skyong mi mthun min/ /chos min spyod la ma dga' bar/ /'khor kun snyoms par skyong gyis dang / /khyod kyang bdag gi zhabs 'bring du/ /'gyur zhes gnang ba sbyin par byed/ /de las gzhan pa'i rgyal po rnams/ /rang gi rigs la dbang ba'am/ /bsod nams stobs kyis gang thob pa'i/ /mnga' yul de la dbang sgyur ro/ /rgyal po rnams ni ci zhig la/ /gnas nas skye rgu skyong zhe na/ /'khor los sgyur ba ma gtogs gzhan/ /bstan bcos la ni gnas nas su/ /skye rgu skyong bar byed pa ste/ /ci yi phyir na 'jig rten du/ /'khor los sgyur ba byung ba'i tshe/ /69

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mi rigs pa gsum med phyir ro/ /mi rigs gsum zhes gang zhe na/ /mi dge bcu la mngon dga' ba/ /chos min gyi ni chags pa yin/ /rang gi 'byor pas chog mi shes/ /mi rigs pa yi 'dod chen nyid/ /log pa'i bstan bcos la bsten pa/ /log pa'i chos kyis 'khor ba zhes/ /de ltar de gsum spyod pa yi/ /sems can de dus ma mchis pas/ /de kun 'khor los sgyur ba de'i/ /rang gi chos kyi che bas ni/ /rgyal po'i sems dang bka' las ni/ /'da' ba su yang mi 'byung la/ /rgyal po'i bya bar tshegs med par/ /kun kyang mthun par gnas pa'i phyir/ /bstan bcos dag la mi ltos so/ /70

rgyal po'i tshul gyi don bshad pa/gang tshe chos min chags pa sogs/ /sems can rnams la ldan pa'i tshe/ /rgyal po rnams kyi sems la ni/ /bzhag cing phan par bya ba'i slad/ /thugs brtse mkhyen par ldan pa yi/ /drang srong chen po rnams kyis ni/ /lugs dang lugs min shes pa'i phyir/ /rgyal po'i lugs kyi bstan bcos byed/ /skye rgu skyong bar byed pa yi/ /bstan bcos de yang gang zhe na/ /mi rigs pa yi chags pa dang / /sdang dang rmongs pa'i gnyen po ru/ / ma chags ma sdang rmongs med de/ /gnyen po gsum gyi rang bzhin dang / /rab dbye phan yon gsum du ston/ /gnyen po gsum gyi kun slong ni/ /bag yod pa dang snying rje yin/ /71

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bag yod ces pa gang zhe na/ /mi dbang des ni 'di snyam du/ /longs spyod mi rtag sprin ltar g.yo/ /bdag kyang 'chi bar 'gyur snyam du/ /dran pa nye bar bzhag nas su/ /'dod pa'i nyes dmigs shes byed cing / /nges 'byung btsal ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /longs spyod dag la spyod byed cing / /dbang phyug dam pas dbang bgyid do/ /snying rje'i sems su bya ba ni/ /ma thob longs spyod kyis mi 'tsho/ /thob la'ang dus min gyis mi 'tsho/ /dus la bab par gyur kyang ni/ /dbul la gnod pas mi 'tsho zhing / /mu ges 'tshe na gzhan skyob byed/ /chom rkun gyis ni 'phrog pa dgag /phan tshun gnod tshe phan gdags shing / /72

rgyal po'i tshul gyi don bshad pa/dbul dang mgon med rnams la sbyin/ /mi bsrun pa la yang dag pa'i/ /chad pas gcod par byed pa des/ /skye rgu skyong bar bya ba 'o/ /mi bsrun pa la chad pa yis/ /ji ltar gcod par bya zhe na/ /yang dag dus bab don ldan dang / /'jal zhing byams pa lnga ldan pa'i/ /mi yi bdag pos chad pa gcod/ /dang po pha rol g.yon la gnas/ /chad pa'i 'os su gyur pa ste/ /nyes med chad pas bcad gyur na/ /shin tu phyin ci log tu 'gyur/ /gnyis pa chad pa gcod pa yi/ /mthu mchis gyur na nyes pa dang / /bstun te ji ltar 'os par sbyar/ /bzlog na dus su ma bab 'gyur/ / 73

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gsum pa ji ltar khas blangs pa'i/ /don la gnas par bya ba las/ /gang byung byas na khrims kyi lugs/ /'das nas don dang mi ldan 'gyur/ /bzhi ba skyon brjod tsam gyis ni/ /mi 'grub chad pas gcad 'os na'ang / /gsad dang dbang po 'byin pa dang / /yan lag nying lag gtub mi bya/ /snying rjes bcings dang btson 'jug dang / /brdeg dang bsdig dang gnod spyod dang / /gnas nas dbyung dang nor 'phrog sogs/ /ji ltar 'tsham par sbyar bar bya/ /de las 'das par brlang byas na/ /ha cang brlang ba che 'gyur te/ /rgyal po skye rgu skyong yin pas/ /mi bsrun bkums par byas gyur na/ /khong khro'i sems kyis dus byas nas/ /74

rgyal po'i tshul gyi don bshad pa/ngan song dag tu phal cher 'gro/ /yun ring skye ba rnams su yang / /sha 'khon rjes su 'brel bar 'gyur/ /dbang po yan lag bral gyur na/ /phyir zhing bcos su mi rung la/ /de las gzhan pa bcing brdeg sogs/ /bcos su rung phyir bya bar bshad/ /gal te mi bsrun dag la yang / /snying rje'i sems kyis ma bsrungs na/ /skye rgu skyong ba'i bya ba ni/ /rgyal pos rdzogs par ma byas so/ /lnga ba ji ltar mi bsrun la/ /snying rjes brlang bar bya zhe na/ /dper na bu ni mi bsrun par/ /nyes pa bzlog slad pha yis ni/ /gsod par byed pa ma yin pa'i/ /brdeg dang bsdig sogs byed pa bzhin/ /75

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gnod sems med pa'i gdul thabs la/ /nyes pa yod pa ma yin no/ /de las chad pas gcad 'os pa'i/ /mi bsrun pa ni rnam lnga ste/ /rgyal po la ni gnod pa dang / /phan tshun gcig gis gcig la gnod/ /rgyal po'i bka' la mi nyan dang / /log par 'tsho bas 'tsho ba dang / /log par zhugs par gyur rnams te/ /'jig rten mi bde 'phel byed pa'o/ /dang po rgyal po'i srog dang ni/ /btsun mo nor sogs brlag byed dang / /phyar ka gtong dang gsang mi thub/ /la sogs gnod par byed pa rnams/ /nyes dang bstun la smad nas su/ /skyon brjod pa dang nor 'phrog dang / /bcing dang bskrad pa la sogs pas/ /76

rgyal po'i tshul gyi don bshad pa/phyin chad gnod pa med par bya/ /phan tshun gcig la gcig gnod pa/ /spyo dang bsdig dang gnod pa dang / /brdeg dang btson du bzung sogs kyi/ /chad pas las de dgag par bya/ /rang gi mnga' yul gnas na yang / /rgyal po'i bka' la mi nyan rnams/ /zil gyis mnan nas dbang bsgyur la/ /rang rang sde ris las mi bskyod/ /rang gi ris nas ma bskyod pas/ /rgyal por drin du gzo sems skye/ /'jigs pas bka' nyan kun gyis 'dud/ /grags par 'gyur zhing bsod nams 'thob/ /bya ba shan pa smad 'tshong sogs/ /sdom min sdig rgyun 'dzin pa yis/ /log pas 'tsho bar gyur rnams la/ /phyin chad 'di 'dra ma byed cig / 77

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/byas na chad pa 'di lta bu/ /gcad par 'gyur zhes 'jigs pa dag /bstan pas bsdigs te dgag par bya/ /tshul min lta ba 'dzin pa dang / /tshul khrims 'tsho ba nyams lta bu/ /log par zhugs pa gang yin rnams/ /thabs kyis gnyen po'i phyogs la gzhug /gal te lta ba tshul khrims dang / /cho ga 'tsho ba nyams pa gang / /dge 'dun mthun pas sbyangs byas te/ /bskrad par bgyis sam rang rang gis/ /khas blangs na yang de bzhin du/ /bskrad par nus par ma gyur na/ /rgyal pos legs par brtags nas su/ /btsun pa'i phyogs kyi grogs bya 'o/ /gal te dge 'dun phyogs gnyis po/ /rtsod pas khrims sogs nyams gyur na/ /78

rgyal po'i tshul gyi don bshad pa/rgyal po rang nyid chos la ni/ /yang dag mkhas na de nyid dam/ /yang na yul der gnas pa yi/ /dge sbyong dang ni bram ze gang / /chos mkhas ya rabs su gtogs pa/ /bsdus nas rtsod pa de sbyang bya/ /de tshe gang zhig rigs pa de'i/ /phyogs kyi grogs ni legs bgyis te/ /bsdig dang bskrad sogs gang 'os pas /cig shos log zhugs de bzlog bya/ /chos ldan rgyal po'i yul khams na/ /pha ma rgas tshe mi bkur zhing / /de bzhin gnyen dang bran sogs la/ /'os pa'i zas nor mi ster bar/ /las la bkol te ngal 'jug pa/ /'di dag mi bsrun lnga po de/ /gang gi khongs su gtogs she na/ /79

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rang la phan 'dogs pa de la/ /sbyin par 'os pa mi ster bar/ /rang gis spyod par byed pa ni/ /log 'tsho chen po yin pas na/ /log par 'tsho ba'i mi bsrun pa'o/ /slong ba'i dge sbyong bram ze la/ /mi snyan rjod par byed pa dang / /mgron du bos nas zan gcod dang / /chos 'gal zas stob brdeg pa sogs/ /byed pa rim gro bgyi 'os la/ /mi bgyi log zhugs chen po ste/ /de phyir de dang de 'dra rnams/ /log zhugs mi bsrun khongs su 'du/ /des mtshon 'os min 'tsho rnams dang / /rigs min ngan pa'i lam zhugs dag /mi bsrun phyi ma gnyis dag tu/ /'du bar yongs su shes par bya /80

rgyal po'i tshul gyi don bshad pa/yul khams gang na de lta bu'i/ /log zhugs mang bar gyur pa der/ /lha rnams dus su char mi 'bebs / mu ges dgon pa nyam ngar 'gyur/ /mi ma yin pa rnams kyis ni/ /rims sogs gnod pa sna tshogs gtong / /tshe dang longs spyod nad med 'grib/ /de phyir de bkag yul de dge /gal te rgyal po mi bsrun par/ /gyur na de la su zhig gis/ /chad pas gcad par 'gyur zhe na/ /rgyal po rang gis rang tshar gcod/ /ji ltar zhe na rang nyid la/ /bag med snying rje med gyur na/ /rang gi shes rab kyis brtags nas/ /mi snyan ngan song 'jigs pa bsam /chos ldan rgyal po dus dus su/ /81

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rang gi yul na mchis pa yi/ /ya rabs dam par brtsi ba gang / /dge sbyong bram ze mkhas gsal ba/ /rig pa dang ni ldan pa la/ /dge ba gang dang mi dge gang / /ci zhig byas na legs pa dang / /ci zhig byas na sdig 'gyur zhes/ /'dri zhing chos ston skabs dbye bya/ /de dag gis kyang rgyal po la/ /gna' bo'i tshul bzang bstan par bya/ /skabs phye gyur nas rgyal po de'i/ /skyon rnams 'jam po'i tshig gis brjod/ /de ltar phyi yi bshes gnyen dang / /nang gi rang gi shes stobs kyis/ /bdag nyid mi bsrun tshar gcad 'gyur/ /snod kyi 'jig rten skye rgu gang / /chos ldan rgyal po'i srung tshul ni/ /82

rgyal po'i tshul gyi don bshad pa/mi bsreg mi gzhig la sogs pas/ /ji ltar gnas bzhin bsrung bar bya/ /'di ltar khro ba'i gnas dag la/ /rgyal po khros par gyur na yang / /grong dang grong khyer bsreg pa dang / /rdzing 'dral gnas bshig bza' shing gcod/ /lo tog gzhom dang rten bshig dang / /gang yang sa phyogs legs bstar dang / /legs bsgrubs legs bris nyams dga' ba/ /de dag gzhig par mi rigs te/ /dngos po de rnams khro yul las/ /'gro gzhan thun mong 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /de rnams nyes pa ma bgyis shing / /gzhan yang khyim sogs de dag la/ /gnas pa'i lha dang dud 'gro'i tshogs/ /nyes med gyur pa du ma zhig /mi dgar byed cing phung byed pas/ /83

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/de dag chud ni ma gzan na/ /snod kyi 'jig rten gyis zin pa'i/ /skye rgu skyong bar byed pa ste/ /de ltar bskyangs pas sems can la/ /phan pa legs par bgyi bar 'gyur/ /rgyal po'i khams na gnas pa yi/ /lha rnams ji ltar bskyang bya na/ /sa phyogs nyams par mi bya zhing / /gtor ma sogs sbyin de ltar na/ /skye rgu kun kyang bskyang 'gyur la/ /mi bsrun pa kun tshar gcad 'gyur/ /kha na ma tho ma mchis dang / /phyi mar bsod nams 'phel bar 'gyur/ /so so'i lag mthus bsgrub phyir dang / /rgyal pos tshul bzhin bskyang ba'i phyir/ /rgyal khams de yi bdog pa rnams/ /de dang rgyal po kho na'i min/ /84

rgyal po'i tshul gyi don bshad pa/yod bzhin 'os pa'i dpya dag ni/ /rgyal po la ni ma phul na/ /de nyid ma byin len min yang / /ser sna'i kha na ma thor 'gyur/ /nor yod pa las 'os pa'i dpya/ / ma byin nan gyis blangs gyur kyang / /gla rngan bsgrub pa'i dpe bzhin du/ /rgyal pos ma byin blang mi 'gyur/ /dbul la nan gyis blangs gyur la/ /sdig pa yod med gnyis su dbye/ /rgyan po smad 'tshong la sogs pas/ /tshul min longs spyod chud za ba/ /dgag phyir blangs na gnyis don byas/ /de la sdig pa med par bshad/ /gang gi longs spyod mes tshig sogs/ /chud zar gyur tshe dpya yang bya /ma byas thabs bral sems can de/ /85

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ma bskyangs pas na sdig par 'gyur/ /bag yod snying rje ldan pa yi/ /rgyal po de ni yan lag dus/ /rnam kun yongs su rdzogs pa yi/ /chos rgyal chos ldan 'gyur zhe na/ /gnam gyis bskos pa phun sum tshogs/ /'khor bsrun pa dang shes rab mchog /brtson ldan chos la gus dang mkhas/ /des pa 'jig rten kun spyod rigs/ /mi bde bzod par gyur pa dang / /chos la phyin ci ma log 'dzin/ /yan lag rnam pa 'di bcu yis/ /chos ldan chos rgyal yongs rdzogs 'gyur/ /bsod nams stobs kyis blon sogs dang / /yul gyi mi rnams nad med cing / /gnod chung bde 'byor ldan gyur la/ /gnam bskos phun sum tshogs zhes bya/ /86

rgyal po'i tshul gyi don bshad pa/'khor bzang dag dang ldan pa yi/ /rgyal po tshegs med bde bar gnas/ /rgyal po'i tshul las mi nyams pa/ /'khor rung pa zhes legs par brjod/ /skye rgu chos kyis skyong tshul la/ /thabs mkhas bya ba ci yang shes/ /gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog pa/ / shes rab phun tshogs rgyal po yin/ /rang gi bgyi ba gang yin la/ /tshul bzhin brtson ldan rgyal po ni/ /dgra yis mi tshugs dga' bar gnas/ /mdzod rnams 'phel zhing phun sum tshogs/ /chos la gus pa'i rgyal po ni/ /bsod nams bgyi ba mi gtong la/ /mi bsrun pa rnams tshar gcod pas/ /chos bzhin byed pa nyid yin no/ /sgrim par mkhas pa'i rgyal po ni/ /87

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/las mtha' ring bas ma nyams par/ /dus dang dus su legs brtsams pas /bsam pa myur du rdzogs pa 'o/ /rgyud 'jam des par gyur pa yi/ /rgyal po gang na gnas pa de/ /yul mi kun gyis yid rton rung / /mtha' dag skye bo 'du bar 'gyur/ / 'jig rten kun spyod rig spyod ces/ /rung dang rung min bye brag shes/ / longs spyod 'du ba'i sgo dag kyang / /chad par mi bgyid gang yin pa'o/ /mi bde bzod pa'i rgyal po ni/ /rgyal po'i bgyi ba mtha' dag gang / /yongs su rdzogs par sgrub nus shing / /sdug bsngal gyis ni mi 'jigs pa'o/ /go 'phang khyad par du 'gro ba'i/ /lam la rang nyid gnas byed cing / /88

rgyal po'i tshul gyi don bshad pa/dge ba'i bshes dang ma bral ba //phyin ci ma log chos 'dzin pa'o/ /gal te yongs rdzogs chos ldan pa'i/ /rgyal po de yi yul du ni/ /'thab mo'i g.yul ni byung gyur tshe/ /ji ltar nan tan bya zhe na/ /thog ma bar dang mtha' ma yi/ /dus gsum thabs mkhas gsum ldan pas/ /chos las nyams par mi 'gyur bar/ /de ltar yul khams bsrung bar bya/ /thabs mkhas rnam gsum gang zhe na/ /thog mar rang ngam blon sogs kyi/ / mdza' bas 'dum par 'gyur ba'am/ /phan gdags pa'am bsdig la sogs/ /sna tshogs thabs la mkhas pa yis/ /'thab mi dgos par zhi bar bya/ /des kyang zhi bar ma nus pa'i/ /89

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bar gyi dus la chos ldan gyi/ /rgyal pos sems gsum bzhag byas te/ /bzlog med rgol bar 'thab mo bya/ /dang po chos ldan rgyal po ngas/ /skye rgu phung byas mi 'gyur grang / /phung las ma bzlog med dam zhes/ /skye rgu bskyang bar sems gzhag bya/ /gnyis pa phas rgol dgra rnams las/ /rgyal ba'i tshul la sems bzhag go /gsum pa skye bo rnams kyi ni/ /srog bzung ba la sems bzhag ste/ /rang gi dpung tshogs bzhi la ni/ /g.yul bsham par ni bka' stsal bya/ /tha mar rang gi dpung tshogs kyi/ /dpa' bo tha ma'i tshogs rnams ni/ /dang por sngon du bsham bya ste/ /'bring rnams de yi rgyab tu bsham/ /90

rgyal po'i tshul gyi don bshad pa/rta pa'i tshogs ni de gnyis ka'i/ /rgyab nas 'gyed par bya ba 'o/ /dpa' bo rab kyi tshogs rnams dang / /rgyal po lhan cig dpung de yi / /rgyab tu bsdad pas bag dro zhing / /rkang thang rnams kyang bsrung 'gyur la/ /dmag rnams bde bar brgal bar 'gyur/ /de ltar thabs mkhas g.yul bshams na/ /dpung rnams rgyal por 'jigs pa dang / /drin dran byas pa gzo sems kyis/ /spyan mi mnyes pa bsgrub mi nus/ /rgyab na dpung gi brjid ldan pas/ /dpung des pha rol rgol ba la/ /ci nus rgol zhing slar mi ldog /tshul ldan drang zhing thabs mkhas par/ /lha rnams grogs byed g.yul las rgyal/ /de ltar thabs la mkhas pa yis/ /91

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/legs par g.yul bshams rgyal po des/ /gzhan sde bkums sam rma byung yang / /kha na ma tho chung 'gyur la/ /rnam smin myong ba'i nges pa'ang med/ /ci phyir zhe na 'di ltar des/ /yongs su mi gtong snying rje yis/ /las de mngon 'du bgyis pas so/ /gang des skye rgu yongs bskyang dang / /bu dang chung ma rigs don du/ /bdag dang longs spyod yongs btang ste/ /las de bgyi phyir gzhi de las/ /bsod nams tshad ma mchis par 'phel /chos ldan yul der dbang med par/ /'thab mo'i g.yul ni gnas pa la/ /chos ldan rgyal pos de ltar bya/ /chos kyi rgyal po 'du shes dus/ /rtag tu ji ltar gnas she na/ /92

rgyal po'i tshul gyi don bshad pa/'di ni rnam pa brgyad kyis te/ /dang po skye rgya'i ris gtogs pa'i/ /'gro kun bu yi 'du shes bya/ /pha yis bu ni bcos pa ltar/ /mi bsrun rnams ni tshar gcod kyang / /snying rje mi gtong dang po 'o/ /mi bsrun rnams la nad pa yi/ /'du shes nye bar bzhag nas su/ /gnod la mi khro de yi skyon/ /bsal slad 'jug pa gnyis pa 'o/ / sdug bsngal can gyi sems can la/ /snying rje'i 'du shes bskyed nas su/ /gnod pa spang zhing phan pa'i las/ /ci nus sgrub pa gsum pa 'o/ /bde 'byor ldan pa'i sems can la/ /dga' ba'i 'du shes bya ba ni/ /brnab sems phrag dog yong med par/ /93

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rjes su yi rang bya ba bzhi/ /dgra rnams bdag la gnod byed kyang / /de la dbang med khro ba sogs/ /nyes rgyus nyes par 'du shes nas/ /rgyu spang mdza' bar byed pa lnga/ /mdza' bshes rjes bsrung 'du shes ni/ /sngon chad ji ltar mdza' rnams la/ /rjes brtses mdza' ba brtan bya zhing / /kun la'ang mdza' bar bya ba drug /longs spyod dag la sman lta bu'i/ /'du shes nye bar gzhag bya ste/ /'dod pa log par mi spyod cing / /ma chags gang 'os spyad bya bdun/ /bdag la bdag med 'du shes ni/ /chos don gnyer zhing chos smra bsten/ /chos la chos kyi rjes su ni/ /nan tan 'jug pa brgyad pa yin/ /94

rgyal po'i tshul gyi don bshad pa/brgyad po de yis gnas pa yi/ /chos dang ldan pa'i rgyal po la/ /gzhan gyis skyes phul ba yis kyang / /bang mdzod yongs su 'phel 'gyur der/ /chos min rgyal po gzhan dag gis/ /g.yo sgyu'i rnam pa thams cad kyis/ /'bad de bsgrubs par gyur pas kyang / /cha tsam 'gran par mi bzod do/ /gnas pa de brgyad kyis gnas na/ /lha rnams dus su char 'bebs shing / /lo legs mu ge mi 'byung la/ /longs spyod chud ni gzan mi 'gyur/ /gcan gzan ma rungs pa la sogs/ /'jigs dang mi bdes mnar ba med/ /rgyal po de la gnod pa yi/ /dgra rnams rang bzhin tshegs chung ngus/ /kho rang nyes pas phung 'gyur zhing / /95

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/zad par gyur nas dgra mi 'byung / /de ltar chos kyis skye rgu rnams/ /skyong ba'i rgyal po 'jig rten na/ /des par gyur pa gang yin pa/ /nongs pa'i nyes pa ma mchis par /lus zhig nas ni mtho ris su/ /lha rnams dag tu skye ba dang / /bde nas bde bar 'gro 'gyur bas/ /mi bdag rnams kyis de ltar spyad/ /lugs kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan las/ bden smra lung bstan pa'i mdo las gsungs pa rgyal po'i tshul gyi le'u'i don bshad pa ste rab tu byed pa drug pa'o// 96

mdo sde dran pa nyer bzhag las rgyal po'i lugs/rab tubyed pa bdun pa/ mdo sde dran pa nyer bzhag las gsungs pa rgyal dzo'i ugs/mdo sde dran pa nyer bzhag las/ /blo ldan byang chub sems dpa' mchog /smon lam dbang gis lha rnams kyi/ /bag med bsal slad skyes gyur pa/ /ngang pa'i rgyal po dus bzang gis/ /sngon tshe sangs rgyas gtsug tor can/ /gang gi zhal nas legs thos pa'i/ /rgyal po chos la spyod pa zhes/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di nyid ni/ /'thab bral lha yi rgyal po la/ /legs par gdams pa'i don bsdus nas/ /gong 'og go rim bsdebs byas te/ /97

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gsal ba'i ngag gis bshad bya na/ /mi bdag rnams kyis mnyan par byos/ /'di dang phyi mar legs pa yi/ /yon tan rgya che 'thob byed pa/ /sum cu rtsa lnga'i grangs ldan pa'i/ /chos 'di rgyal pos spyad par bya/ /'di dang phyi ma'i legs tshogs kyi/ /rtsa ba shes rab yin pas na/ /yang dag shes rab snang ba la/ /goms par byed pa dang po 'o/ /gang zhig 'di dang pha rol tu/ /legs pa'i don rnams gang yin la/ /bsam gzhig legs par byed pa ni/ /sems kyi yon tan gnyis pa 'o/ /bla ma mchod par byed pa ni/ /bden don mkhas shing tshul ldan gyi/ /dge ba'i bshes rnams legs bsten na/ /98

mdo sde dran pa nyer bzhag las rgyal po'i lugs/phun tshogs 'thob 'gyur gsum pa 'o/ /med smra ba'am log spyod dang / /lta ngan chos su smra ba yi/ /skye bo ngan pa sdig grogs rnams/ /yongs su spang bya bzhi ba 'o/ /las dang 'bras bur skur 'debs pa'i/ /log par lta ba mi bzad pa/ /nyes pa kun gyi 'byung gnas de/ /spong bar byed pa lnga ba 'o/ /phyi dang nang gi 'dus byas chos/ /kun kyang rgyu la brten nas skye/ /rgyu 'bras lam dang lam min shes/ /lta ba bzang ldan drug pa 'o/ /ya rabs yon tan ldan pa dang / /de ldog skye bo'i khyad par rnams/ /ma 'dres khong chud mi'i khyad par/ /shes pa zhes bya bdun pa 'o/ /99

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'du shes sna tshogs skye bo yi/ /tshig kun bden par mi gzung bar/ /'os shing don ldan gang yin bzung / /sa bdag chos ni brgyad pa 'o/ /chos ldan phan byed yid rton gnas/ /grogs po brtan pa dang ldan pa'i/ /rgyal po sa rnams kun las rgyal/ /'di ni yon tan dgu ba 'o/ /yid rton 'os min gya gyu can/ /mi brtan phan byed min pa'i grogs/ /rgyal pos rtag tu spangs byas na/ /bde ba 'thob 'gyur bcu ba 'o/ /rang gi skye bo gtsang gyur ces/ /'di dang phyi mar legs blta zhing / /chos dang mthun pas rang dang 'khor/ /rgyud dag pa ni bcu gcig go /sbyin dang snyan par smra ba dang / /100

mdo sde dran pa nyer bzhag las rgyal po'i lugs/spyod pa bzang sogs la zhugs nas/ /bdag nyid snyan par grags pa yis/ /phyogs kun khyab bya bcu gnyis pa/ /yon tan 'phel ba'i dgra chen po/ /le lo spangs par gyur pas ni/ /'di dang gtan gyi don kun 'grub/ /'di nyid yon tan bcu gsum pa/ /don ni gang dang ci sgrub kyang / /ha cang las mtha' mi ring bar /dus su bsgrim na re ba kun/ /rdzogs 'gyur yon tan bcu bzhi ba/ /zas dang skom la sred ches na/ /lus sems las su mi rung 'gyur/ /de 'dra'i sred spang ran par bza'/ /spyad bya'i chos 'di bco lnga ba/ /bag med don nyams rgyur gyur pa'i/ /gnyid kyi dri ma las grol nas/ /101

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/blo gsal bya ba rdzogs gyur gang / /mi bdag yon tan bcu drug pa/ /mi brtan gya gyu phrag dog can/ /nyes pa du ma'i 'byung gnas phyir/ /bud med dbang du mi 'gro ba/ /mi bdag rnams kyi chos bcu bdun/ /byis pa slu bar byed pa yi/ /'dod pa'i yul ni lnga rnams kyis/ /mi bkri tshul ldan rang dbang can/ /rgyal po'i chos mchog bco brgyad pa/ /sdang dang chags pa las byung ba'i/ / khro ba dang ni rgod bag shugs/ /bsdam na rgyal po dul 'gyur te/ /yon tan mchog 'thob bcu dgu ba/ /khro ba rnam par bcom nas su/ /gzhan la 'tshe ba kun spang ba/ /bzod ldan zhes bya rgyal po yi/ /102

mdo sde dran pa nyer bzhag las rgyal po'i lugs/chos su bsngags pa nyi shu ba/ /kun gyi yid dang mthun par ni/ /snyan tshig 'jam por smra ba yis/ /thams cad yid rab mgu byed pa/ /rgyal po'i chos lugs nyer gcig pa/ /rtag tu bden par smra ba ni/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ /yid rton 'os yin yon tan mchog /'di ni yon tan nyer gnyis pa/ /phyogs lhung med pa zhes bya ba/ /yul ljongs kun la pha ma ltar/ / snyoms shing bshes ngor mi byed pa/ /yon tan chos 'di nyer gsum pa/ /blo brtan pas na nor gzhis rnams/ /glo bur 'phel 'grib mi byed par/ /rtag tu mnyam par gnas byed pa/ /gang 'di yon tan nyer bzhi ba/ /103

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/nges pa'i 'bras bur longs spyod ces/ /'os pa'i dpya khral 'ba' zhig las/ /'das te cung zad mi len pa/ /rgyal po'i chos 'di nyer lnga ba/ /mi bsrun gdul dka' ngan spyod can/ /yul du bzhag na nyes pa 'phel /de spangs yul khams bde bar 'gyur/ /rgyal po'i chos ni nyer drug pa/ /pha mes sogs kyis sngon byin pa/ /de ni de bzhin sor bzhag nas/ /de la dga' zhing slar yang ster/ /'di ni yon tan nyer bdun pa/ /zang zing chos dang mi 'jigs pa'i/ /sbyin pa dag la rab 'bad na/ /sa 'di kun nas dbang 'gyur te/ /rgyal po'i chos ni nyer brgyad pa/ /'jig rten mchog gyur dkon mchog gsum/ /104

mdo sde dran pa nyer bzhag las rgyal po'i lugs/mchod cing gzhan la'ang gtong ba'i sgo/ /yangs byed blo ldan bsod nams can/ /zla ltar mngon 'phags nyer dgu ba/ /bzang po'i las kyi rnam smin can/ /lha rnams dge ba'i grogs la brtson/ /de mchod bkra shis bde ldan 'gyur/ /'di ni yon tan sum cu ba/ /rang gi bu dang bu mo sogs/ /shin tu brtse bas bde bar bskyang / /legs pa'i lam la gzhug par bya/ /spyad bya'i chos 'di so gcig pa/ /'bangs kyi bde thabs legs bsams nas/ /gang phan thabs kyis 'khor 'bangs kun/ /dbugs dbyung rigs par bder skyong ba/ /sa la dbang 'gyur so gnyis pa/ /chos bzhin skye rgu bskyang bya ste/ /chos ma yin rnams chos la gzud/ /105

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/chos ldan rgyal po 'jig rten na/ /nyi ltar gsal 'gyur so gsum pa/ /dge ba bcu yi las lam la/ /rang nyid gnas shing gzhan kyang dgod/ /'di phyi'i 'jig rten rnam gnyis su/ /'khor bcas bde 'thob so bzhi ba/ /dus su nges par dam pa'i chos/ /legs par ston par byed pa ni/ /gzhan phan chos 'dzin skyes bu ste/ /'di ni yon tan so lnga ba'o/ /yon tan 'di dag re re dang / /ldan pa'ang tshe 'dir grags 'byor sogs/ /yon tan rnam mang thob gyur nas/ /phyi mar lha gnas rnams su 'gro/ /chos ldan rgyal po 'jig rten 'dir/ /skye rgu'i mchog tu bde myang zhing / /bde ba'i lam nas yang dag pa/ /106

mdo sde dran pa nyer bzhag las rgyal po'i lugs/bde ba'i gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /'di dag so so'i yon tan gyi/ /rnam pa rgya che'i bsngags pa dag /mdo de nyid du 'byung bas na/ /blo ldan rnams kyis blta bar bya/ /lugs kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan las/ mdo sde dran pa nyer bzhag las gsungs pa rgyal po'i lugs kyi rab tu byed pa ste bdun pa'o//107

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rab tu zud pa brgyad pa/ gser 'od dam pha las byung ba'i rgyal wo lugs kyi bstan bcos/'phags pa gser 'od dam pa las/ /lha yi dbang po'i dam tshig ces/ /rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos las/ /gsungs pa'i don rnams gsal brjod na/ /sngon tshe tshangs pa chen po la/ /lha yi dbang po'i tshogs kyis ni/ /gang zhig mi yi rgyal po la/ /lha zhes bya dang lha'i sras zhes/ /lha rnams ji ltar mi bdag 'gyur/ /de skad ces ni dris pa dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs rnams la/ /tshangs pa'i dbang pos 'di skad gsungs/ /108

gser 'od dam pa las rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos/lha yi dbang po la sogs pa/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /chos min nyes byas gzhig pa dang / /chos kyis yul khams bsrung ba'i phyir/ /mi yi bdag por byin brlabs pas/ /rgyal po de la lha zhes dang / /lha yi bu zhes bya ba yi/ /grags pa lha yi gnas su sgrogs/ /tshe 'dir legs par byas pa dang / /nyes par byas pa'i las rnams kyi/ /rnam smin 'bras bu mngon sum du/ /ston par byed slad rgyal por bskos/ /gang tshe rgyal pos sdig can gang / /nyes par byed pa'i skye bo rnams/ /'os mthun chad pas bcad nas su/ /yongs su 'gog par mi byed na/ /rgyal po de yi yul khams su/ /109

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/chos min shin tu 'phel bar 'gyur/ /g.yo dang 'thab rtsod mang 'gyur zhing / /lha dang bcas pa'i skye rgu 'khrugs/ /gang gi ched du lha rnams kyis/ /rgyal por bskos pa'i las de ni/ /sdig can 'phel ba 'gog yin na/ /las de yal bar bor ba'i mthus/ /dus min rlung dang char ba dang / /pha rol dmag dang nad mang zhing / /gza' skar ma rungs la sogs pa'i/ /mi bzad ltas ni 'byung bar byed/ /me tog lo 'bras mi smin zhing / /rku 'phrog thog ser mu ge dang / /dus min 'chi ba sna tshogs pa/ /mya ngan 'jigs pa mang po 'byung / /sbyin gnas dang ni slob dpon dang / /'khor rnams chos min byed par 'gyur/ /110

gser 'od dam pa las rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos/de tshe rgyal po des kyang ni/ /chos min pa la mchod byed cing / /chos ldan chad pas gcod par byed/ /chos ldan chad pas bcad gyur na/ /chu dang rgyu skar rlung gsum 'khrugs/ /chos min skye bo bkur bas na/ /dam chos snying po sems can mdangs/ /sa yi bcud gsum 'jig par 'gyur/ /lo 'bras ro bcud mi ldan zhing / /zos kyang tshim par mi 'gyur la/ /sems can mdog ngan nyams mi bde/ /yongs su dga' med bag mi phebs/ /nyon mongs brgya yis rnam par 'khrugs/ /chos min rgyal po de yang ni/ /sdug pa thams cad dang bral nas/ /sdug bsngal sna tshogs 'thob par 'gyur/ /rgyal por bskos pa chud gzan pa/ / 111

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'di ni chos min rgyal po zhes/ /lha gnas rnams su gleng bar byed/ /lha rnams 'grib cing ngan song 'phel /rgyal pos las su bya ba'i don/ /lha rnams bzhed pa ma grub pas/ /lha yi bu ni ma yin la/ / lha yi rgyal po pha rnams kyi/ /gnas su'ang nyes pa dang bcas 'gyur/ /lha mchog rnams kyang yi chad nas/ /rgyal po ngan pa de bor bas/ /myur du yul khams 'jig par 'gyur/ /gal te chos min tshar bcad nas/ / chos dang ldan pas yul bskyang ste/ /yul 'khor gzhan gyi skye bo yang / /phyogs lhung med par des bskyangs na/ /chos dang ldan pa'i rgyal po de'i/ /grags pa 'jig rten gsum du khyab/ /112

gser 'od dam pa las rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos/sum cu rtsa gsum lha gnas su/ /lha yi dbang po dgar 'gyur te/ /'dzam bu'i gling na nged kyi bu/ /'di ltar chos ldan rgyal po yis /chos kyis yul khams bskyangs byas pas/ /sa steng skye bo 'dir 'gyed de/ /lha gnas gang bar byed snyam zhes/ /de ltar chos ldan rgyal po la/ /lha dbang 'khor bcas dgyes gyur nas/ /rtag tu rang gi bu bzhin srung / /yul der gza' skar legs rgyu zhing / /dus su rlung ldang char 'bab sogs/ /gong gi skyon kun las bzlog pa'i/ /yon tan shin tu mang po 'byung / /de lta bas na rgyal po yis/ /rang gi srog kyang btang nas su/ /gang gis 'jig rten bder 'gyur ba'i/ /113

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dkon mchog chos ni mi gtang bar/ /chos ldan yon tan can bsten nas/ /chos kyis yul 'khor bskyang bya ste/ /rtag tu chos min rnam par spang / /chos kyang yang dag bstan par bya/ /sems can legs par byed la dgod/ /nyes par byed las bzlog par bya/ /gang tshe bzlog med sdig byed rnams/ /tshul bzhin chad pas 'dul byed na/ /rgyal po grags dang ldan 'gyur zhing / /yul khams gzi byin 'phel 'gyur la/ /skye rgu rnams kyang bde bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs 'di don yid la bya/ /sngon tshe 'das pa'i dus nyid na/ /rgyal po stobs kyi dbang po'i tog /ces bya'i sras su gyur pa ni/ /mdzes pa'i tog gis bstan bcos 'di/ /114
