gser 'od dam pa las rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos/yab las legs par mnos byas pa/ /'di yi tshul gyis ston pas sngon/ /lo ni nyi khri'i bar dag tu/ /rgyal po byas te skad cig kyang / /chos min bya ba ma byas zhes/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis legs par gsungs/ /da lta'i rgyal po rnams kyis kyang / /ston pa'i bka' 'di dran par byos/ /lugs kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan las/ gser 'od dam pa las byung ba'i rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos kyi rab tu byed pa ste brgyad pa'o//115

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rab tu zud pha dgu ba/ brtan zhing brtson pa brtag pa/ji ltar rgya mtsho chen po ni/ /'phel dang 'grib par mi 'gyur ba/ /de bzhin sa bdag bzang po rnams/ /lugs las nam yang mi g.yo 'o/ /gsar rnying grub mtha'i chos lugs ni/ /yab mes dus kyi srol gang yin/ /de nyid kho na gtso bor 'dzin/ /gzhan du gyur na mi bde 'phel/ /blon sogs go sa gang dbang ba'i/ /mi rgyud rnams kyang ji srid bar/ /de bzhin legs par gnas byas na/ /sngar tshul mi nyams mdzes pa yin/ /116

brtan zhing brtson pa brtag pa/gtong ba'i sgo dang chab srid srol/ /gna' bo'i lugs bzhin bskyang bya ste/ /'os min sngon med bya ba 'ga'/ /'phel bar gyur na 'jig pa'i ltas/ /rang gi tshul las gang 'das pa/ /su la'ang mdzes pa ma yin zhing / /khyad par du ni rgyal po rnams/ /lugs las mi 'da' yon tan mchog /snyigs ma'i mi rnams dga' sdug dang / /khengs dang dud dang 'jam rtsub sogs/ /spyod lam rnam pa mi 'dra ba/ / nyin re bzhin du 'gyur ba mang /gsar ba'i tshe na 'grogayobade zhing / /yun du bsten na rgyu med par/ /skyo ba skyed pa'i grogs po ni/ /gzhung ngan mi brtan pa zhes bya/ /dang po 'dris par dka' ba la/ /117

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/legs par 'grogs na slar yang ni/ /mi phyed mdza' ba brtan pa de/ /grogs po blo brtan pa zhes brjod/ /cung zad tsam gyis dga' zhing snyems/ /cung zad tsam gyis 'khrug cing zhum/ /skye bo ngan pa srang mda' dang / /'dra ba skyes bu tha shal yin/ /rigs pa dang ni mi rigs pa'i/ /bya ba dang ni gtam sogs la/ /rnam 'gyur snga bar mngon pa ni/ /spre'u bzhin du col chung yin/ /bstod smad 'jam rtsub tshig phal cher/ /brag ca bzhin du yal 'gyur mod/ /ku cos dkrogs pa'i khyi bzhin du/ /blo chung sha thang chad chad 'khrug /skyid sdug nges pa med pas na/ /'khor ba'i snang tshul rmi lam 'dra/ /118

brtan zhing brtson pa brtag pa/'byor kyang dregs par mi bya la/ /rgud kyang zhum par mi bya 'o/ /drin byas brjed par gyur pa ni/ /mi yi nang nas tha chad yin/ /byas pa shes shing drin gzo ba'i/ /mi la dpal mgon nye bar gnas/ /phan pa chung ngu dag la yang / /rjes su lta ba'i sems bskyed mod/ /rmig rjes kyi ni chu bzhin du/ /rgyal po mgu bar sla mi bya/ /rgya mtsho'i steng gi ku ba bzhin/ /skye bo ngan pa bskyod pa yang / /ri rab bzhin du mi g.yo ba'i/ /mi bdag 'jig rten 'di na mchog /byis pa rnams kyi rtsed mo la/ /ltad mo lta ba'i rgan pa bzhin/ /col chung rnams kyi bya ba la/ /119

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/khro dang dga' ba bskyed mi bya/ /skye bo ya rabs tshig btsun rnams/ /khas blangs nas ni don chung yang / /ldog pa min na don chen dang / /mna' dor ba las ji ltar ldog /gtam dang bya bar nges med na/ /su yang rung ste brtsi bkur chung / /don ldan smra ba'i skyes bu yi/ /tshig las kun gyis 'da' bar dka'/ /dam bca' ri ltar brtan gyur na/ /rang gi dgos pa kun 'grub cing / /skye bo'i yid rton gnayogyur la/ /bsdigs na lha yang 'jigs pa skye/ /blo mi brtan pas chos dang srid/ /gang brtsams na yang mthar mi phyin/ /bya ba mang la 'grub pa nyung / /khas len che la lag rjes chung / /120

brtan zhing brtson pa brtag pa/blo brtan rnams kyis gang bsgrubs kyang / /yun nas yun du 'bad pa yis/ /thigs pa bsags pas rgya mtsho bzhin/ /tha ma grub 'bras rgya cher ldan/ /blo mi brtan la yon tan gyis/ /re zhig bsgos par gyur na yang / /rdo la ga bur dri bzhin du/ /ring por mi thogs yal bar 'gyur/ /'du shes sna tshogs skye bo yis/ /brjod kun rjes su mi 'jug par/ /rang gis legs par dpyad nas su/ /'os pa'i don las ldog mi bya/ /dbu ba rdos 'dra stobs med sems kyis ni/ /lugs zung bya ba gang yang mi 'grub phyir/ /mi shigs snying stobs rdo rje lta bu yis/ /rigs pa'i don kun bde blag bsgrub par bya/ /lhun po'i rgyal po rdo rje'i khor yug can/ /121

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'dzin ma'i dbus su g.yo med gnas pa ltar/ /sa skyong brtan zhing lugs las mi g.yo ba/ /sa steng skye bo kun las mngon par 'phags/ /grogs ngan chu gter rlabs kyis mi g.yo zhing / /glo bur rnam rtog rlung gis mi bskyod par/ /rtag tu brtan pa'i ngang tshul ri dbang 'dis/ /sems med ri bo mchog kyang zil gyis gnon/ /gang zhig brtan pa'i blo ldan de dag ni/ /snying stobs che zhing brtson 'grus mi g.yel bas/ /rang gi las su bya ba gang la yang / /zhum pa'i sems ni nam yang mi bskyed do/ /las la bgyi ba ma btang na/ /don chen dag kyang mthar gyis 'grub/ /pha bong sgul bar dka' ba yang / /rim gyis ri rtser 'byin par nus/ /blun pos bya ba khas 'che zhing / /thog mar bsgrims nas tha mar lhod/ /122

brtan zhing brtson pa brtag pa/mkhas pas bya ba zhe la bzhag /dang por lhod cing tha mar bsgrims/ /dam pas dang por khas 'che dka'/ /gal te khas ni blangs gyur na/ /rdo la ri mo bris pa bzhin/ /shi yang gzhan du mi byed do/ /brtson 'grus che dang ldan gyur na/ /ri bo'i rtse'ang mtho ba min/ /rgya mtsho'i gting yang mi dma' ste/ /'di lta'i snying stobs ldan pa la/ /lha yang skrag pa skye 'gyur na/ /mi yi skye bo smos ci dgos/ /ded dpon sbyin pa chen po yis/ /rgya mtsho'i chu ni bcus pa bzhin/ /brtson 'grus dag dang ldan pa yis/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten bya zhing / /gzhung lugs rnam mang bslab bya ste/ /123

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/thos pas shes rab mig bsgrubs nas/ /'os shing rigs pa'i bya ba dang / /khyad par don chen gnas rnams la/ /seng ge'i tshul gyis 'jigs med par/ /bya ba'i las la sbyar bar bya/ /dman pa bsten pas mi rnams nyams 'gyur zhing / /thad kar bab pa bsten pas so na gnas/ /mchog rnams la bsten dam pa 'thob 'gyur ba/ /de phyir bdag pas gtsor gyur bsten par bya/ /yon tan kun dang ldan pa dkon/ /yon tan ci yang med pa'ang nyung / /yon tan gtso che bsten byas te/ /skyon 'dor yon tan len par bya/ /chu yis phyed tsam gang ba yi/ /bum pa spyi bor thogs pa bzhin/ /thos chung nga rgyal che ba phal /bkur bar shin tu dka' ba yin/ /124

brtan zhing brtson pa brtag pa/ngan pa ji srid nyam chung ba/ /de srid bar du rang bzhin bzang / /ji ste rnyed bkur thob pa na/ /de ma thag tu 'gying tshul ston/ /gzhon yang rgan pa'i nye bar zhi la dga'/ /mkhas par gyur kyang shes pa'i nga rgyal med/ /gzi brjid che yang bzod cing des pa'i ngang / /je mthor phyin kyang snyems pa med rnams mchog /mthu che ba dang 'grogs gyur na/ /mthon po nyid du su mi 'gyur/ /me tog phreng bar 'brel ba yi/ /skud pa mgo la 'dogs par byed/ /dam pa dag dang 'grogs pa na/ /rang rgyud yon tan ldan par 'gyur/ /ko tu bha dang lhan cig pa'i/ /rdo khams gser du sgyur bar byed/ /bong bu phyugs la me tog phreng bas ci/ /125

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dud 'gro phag la kha zas zhim pos ci/ /long la snang dang 'on pa dag la glu/ /glen pa rnams la chos kyis ci zhig bya/ /gang zhig tshig gcig tsam ster ba'i/ /bla mar phyag byas ma btud na/ /khyi yi skye ba brgya brgyud nas/ /rigs ngan dag tu skye bar gsungs/ /rig pa gzhon pa'i dus na bslab/ /ba ni dgun gyi dus su gso/ /zhing ni drod gsher ldan tshe rmo/ /'di gsum 'bras bu smin pa'i rgyu/ /grog mkhar sa dang sbrang rtsi dang / /yar ngo'i zla ba bslab pa'i blo/ /rgyal po'i nor dang sprang po'i nor/ /cung zad cung zad bsags pas 'phel/ /yon tan dag la 'bad bya yi/ /'gying tshul bstan pas ci zhig bya/ /126

brtan zhing brtson pa brtag pa/yon tan med pa'i che 'gying ni/ /rang nyid sma phab kho na yin/ /mnog chung bde bas g.yengs pa la/ /don chen yon tan ga la skye/ /de bas slob tshe sdug bsngal kun/ /khyad du bsad de yon tan bslab/ /rig pa'i gnas dang dam pa'i gzhung / /ma thos bar du shes mi 'gyur/ /thos pas blang dor gnas kun la/ /blo gros mig bzang 'byed par byed/ /yang dag mkhas pa'i slob dpon la/ /bsten par ma byas rig pa de/ /'phyon ma yi ni bu bzhin du/ /khungs btsun par ni mi 'gyur ro/ /ya rabs rigs rgyud mtho ba dang / /mkhas shing dam pa'i skyes bu la/ /bsten cing khungs phyung byas tsam gyis/ /127

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/skye bo gzhan gyis rtsi bar byed/ /legs par mthar phyin sbyangs gyur na/ /gzhung gcig shes kyang nyi ma bzhin/ /the tshom dang bcas gzhung mang po/ /'dzin rlom byas kyang rgyu skar 'dra/ /thos pa'i don la rtse gcig tu/ /rigs pa'i lam nas dpyad byas te/ /bsam byung nges pa ma rnyed na/ /thos klog phal cher ne tso 'dra/ /rigs dang mi rigs dpyod pa'i blo med cing / /thos dang bsod nams don du mi gnyer bar/ /lto 'grangs 'khrig spyod tsam gyis dus 'da' ba'i/ /skyes bu de blo phyugs dang khyad par ci/ /rgas shing 'khogs par gyur na'ang / /'bad de thos bsam shes rab sbyang / /shes rgyud de la des bsgos pas/ /skye ba gzhan du mkhas par 'gyur/ /128

brtan zhing brtson pa brtag pa/rig pa glegs bam la gnas dang / /ma bsgrubs pa yi gsang sngags dang / /tshags su ma byas yo byad rnams/ /dgos pa'i dus su sleb par dka'/ /rang gi 'di phyi'i legs tshogs dang / /'bangs kyi don rnams mtha' dag la/ /mi bdag dus su bsgrim bya ste/ /le los phyi bshol mi bya 'o/ /brtson pa dag dang bral gyur na/ /don chung yin yang 'grub par dka'/ /brtson 'grus ldan na yon tan kun/ / rang gi lag na gnas dang mtshungs/ /bdag nyid bdag gi mgon yin gyi/ /gzhan pa su zhig mgon du 'gyur/ /de bas rang don shes pa rnams/ /yon tan len la shin tu brtson/ /dgra bo mi dgar byed 'dod na/ /129

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rang nyid yon tan ldan par bya/ /khro ba'i sems dang tshig rtsub kyis/ /gzhan dag mi thul rang la gnod/ /mchog rnams rgud dang nyam nga'i tshe/ /snying stobs blo gros lhag par che/ /mun pa thibs pos non pa na/ /sgron me lhag par gsal ba yin/ /gang zhig khro na 'jigs med la/ /dga' na'ang phan 'dogs mi nus pa/ /tshar gcod rjes 'dzin med pa de/ /dga' 'am khro yang des ci bya/ /phan btags pa la drin mi gzo/ /gnod byas lan ldon med pa yi/ /nus med lam kha'i tho yor dang / /'dra la kun gyis brnyas par byed/ /blo ldan sems dpa' mchog rnams la/ /byas pa chung yang drin gzo che/ /130

brtan zhing brtson pa brtag pa/gnod pa mang yang mi 'khrug pas/ /sa gzhi bzhin du gnas mod kyi/ /gang de'i spyod yul ma thob gzhan/ /phan dang gnod pa ngo shes nas/ /tshar gcod rjes 'dzin mthu yod pa/ /de srid de nyid kun gyis brtsi/ /gang na mgo bo gcod nus pa/ /dga' na rgyal srid sbyin par nus/ /nus pa che dang ma ldan na/ /mi bdag ces grags dgos pa chung / /mi lcogs pa yi bya ba la /gzhan gyis rbad kyang bsgrub mi bya/ /dge'o dge'o zhes smras pas/ /me yi nang du su zhig mchong / /thabs la mkhas byas don gang zhig /dka' yang bsgrub par nus mthong na/ /gzhan gyis bkag kyang ldog mi bya/ /131

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mkhas pas rin chen len dang mtshungs/ /sbrul gdug mgo las nor bu bzhin/ /bya ba chung ngu dag la yang / /bag zon bcas pas bsgrub bya yi/ /bab col rtsom pa nam yang min/ /mdze can mer ni 'jug pa lta'i/ /phung krol rnams kyis nyen che ba'i/ /bya ba'i gnas la 'jug pa gang / /rnal mar gnas pas byar mi rung / /'phrod par za ba'i mi la ni/ /zas las byung ba'i nad med pa/ /de bzhin legs par brtags nas su/ /bya ba byed la nyes pa dkon/ /don chung ba la chags rnams kyis/ /chen po'i bde ba mi 'thob pas/ /blo ni ci nas rgya bskyed de/ /yon tan chen po nyid du bya/ /132

brtan zhing brtson pa brtag pa/bsgrubs na lha yang 'grub 'gyur la/ /bcom na brag kyang zhig pa'i phyir/ /zhum pa dang du mi blang bar/ /rgyun chags par ni brtson par bya/ /goms na sla bar mi 'gyur ba'i/ /dngos de gang yang yod ma yin/ / ngang pa mtsho dang bya rgod dag /dur khrod la dga' goms pa'i blo/ /stobs ldan sha khrag rtag za ba'i/ /seng ge lo rer lan gcig 'khrig /rdul tsam 'gam pa'i bong bu rnams/ /rtag tu bag med 'khrig pa spyod/ /chags bral chags dang yid log bzhin/ /'gro rnams sems kyi rjes su 'brangs/ /sems ni goms pa'i rjes 'gro'i phyir/ /rang sems dpang gyur dngos grub mchog /skye rgu las kyi rjes 'brangs pas/ /133

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/phal cher rang dbang yod ma yin/ /las de'ang sems pas bkod pa'i phyir/ /sems gdul ba la nan tan bya/ /sa steng 'di na bde ba dang / /sdug bsngal ris su byas pa med/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i don/ /gang sgrub bdag la rag las pas /gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog par/ /bdag nyid gcig pus bgyi ba'i don/ /mthar phyin pa ni bya'o zhes/ /sems pa skyes bu seng ge yin/ /ji ltar me ni rlung gis sbar gyur na/ /tshang tshing nags kyi tshogs rnams tshig par nus/ /de bzhin thabs dang ldan par gang brtson pa/ /mi mthun rgol ba'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal/ /dge ba'i skas las mtho ris gnas 'gro zhing / /dpal dang 'byor pa'i mtsho chen rang gir byed/ /134
sa gsum 'du ba mgron du 'gugs pa yang / /brtson pas lag na gnas pa bzhin du byed/ /lugs kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan las/ brtan zhing brtson pa brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa ste dgu ba'o//

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rab tu zud dze+e bcu ba/ mi bdag dul ba brtag pa/dpal dang 'byor pa phun sum tshogs ldan pa'i/ /mi bdag bzang po rnams ni lhag par dul/ /rgyu skar phreng bas bskor ba'i ri bong 'dzin/ /sprin med mkha' la 'char ba ji bzhin no/ /yon tan chung rnams nga rgyal che/ /yon tan mchog ldan khengs pa bral /snye ma long ba mgo 'phang mtho/ /'bras bzang smin pa dud de gnas/ /rang gis rang la bstod byed pa/ /brgya byin yin yang mi mdzes pas/ /kha col chung ngus mi gcol bar/ /rgya mtsho bzhin du brling bar bya /136

mi bdag dul ba brtag pa/yon tan can la lhag par dgrar gyur cing / / mtho bar 'gying bzhin dma' bar sgyur byed pa/ /bdag gi skyon rnams mthong du mi ster ba'i/ /nga rgyal dang mtshungs nyes pa gzhan yod min/ /mthong ba tsam nas skye bos sdang 'gyur la/ /de yi dpal la gzhan rnams shin tu 'khu/ /brnyas thabs sna tshogs mgron du 'gugs byed pa'i/ /nga rgyal gdon de nga rgyal can la 'jug /gdon gzhan sngags kyis gdul nus kyi/ /nga rgyal can la legs smras na/ /sbrul la 'o ma blud pa bzhin/ /thabs des zhi bar byed mi 'gyur/ /tsan dan gla rtsi ga bur gyis bsgos kyang / /sgog skya'i dri ngan rang bzhin mi 'dor ltar/ /dam pa'i gzhung lugs mang po legs bslabs kyang / /rang bzhin ngan pa'i mtshan nyid 'dor bar dka'/ /legs bshad shes shing 'os pa'i gnas la gus/ /137

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mi 'os brnyas thabs byed tshe spobs pa'i gdengs/ /lhun po'i rtse mo lta bur gzengs mtho ba/ /skyes bu de yi nga rgyal rgyan dang 'dra/ /bde zhing 'byor dus spobs pa'i gzengs mtho zhing / /bshad kyang mi go kun la rtswa 'drar brnyas/ /'jigs pa mngon sum byung tshe zhum pa'i mthar/ /snyeg par byed pa skyes bu tha shal rtags/ /gzhan las 'tshol zhing zas zhim 'dod/ /slong mos 'tsho zhing khengs pa che/ /bstan bcos mi shes rtsod par 'dod/ /'di gsum 'jig rten bzhad gad rgyu/ /rnyed dang bkur snyis blun po la/ /nga rgyal skye zhing skyon rnams sgrib/ /dre'u mo yi mngal chags bzhin/ /pho shal bkur snyis brlag par 'gyur/ /dam pa ji ltar go 'phang mtho gyur pa/ /de lta de ltar dul zhing gzhan phan brtson/ /138

mi bdag dul ba brtag pa/de yi grags pa phyogs dang phyogs rnams su/ /skye bo'i tshig gis bsgrags te khyab par 'gyur/ /me tog dri ni rdzi phyogs kho nar gzhol/ /mchog rnams grags pa'i dri bsung phyogs kun khyab/ /bdag nyid dul zhing yon tan sba byed kyang / /gzhan gyis gzhan la ngom pa bzhin du sgrogs/ /mi mkhas nga rgyal che ba'i skye bo ni/ /rigs gzugs thos sogs yon tan chung ngu yis/ /khron pa'i rus sbal bzhin du khengs gyur nas/ /dam pa rnams la lhag par gshe byed kyang / /de yis dam pa'i yon tan mi 'gog la/ /rang gi 'di phyi'i yon tan zad par byed/ /me lce thur du sbubs par gyur pa des/ /rang gi lag pa sreg par byed dang mtshungs/ /rigs gzugs 'byor pa thos sogs yon tan ni/ /gong nas gong du rgya cher 'phags mchis pas/ /blo chung rigs sogs mnyam pa gzhan dag la/ /139

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'gran zhing nga rgyal byed pa shin tu 'khrul/ /nga rgyal dag gis sma 'bebs ma byas pa'i/ /yon tan chung bar gyur kyang che dang 'dra/ /'byor dang thos sogs shin tu rgya che yang / /nga rgyal dug dang 'dres na chung bar byed/ /'dod pas long bas sdig mi mthong / /dmus long gis ni gzugs mi mthong / /dregs pa yis ni skyon mi mthong / /bdag ltas de nyid mi mthong ngo / /rigs dang blo gros ldan rnams kyis/ /bkur la dman pas brnyas thabs byed/ /mkhas pas phyag byas mchod rten ni/ /khwa rnams stan du 'ding bar byed/ /mkha' la gyen du gtor byas pa'i/ /mi gtsang rang thog 'bab pa bzhin/ /ma rabs nga rgyal can bsten na/ /sten pa po la byur du 'bab/ / 140

mi bdag dul ba brtag pa/mkhas shing ya rabs dul ba la/ /bsten pa tsam gyis sten pa por/ /yon tan dpal dang grags pa 'phel /nor bus gtsug rgyan byas pa bzhin/ /gsang ba'i bdag po'i mtshan bzung bas/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams srung ba ltar/ /rigs mtho ba dang mkhas pa la/ /'brel ba rnams kyang mchod pa 'thob/ /chen pos nga rgyal bya ci dgos/ / nga rgyal med tshe lhag par mdzes /dman pas nga rgyal byas ci phan/ /nga rgyal yod na lhag par brnyas/ /nga rgyal phrag dog g.yon gsum gyi/ /skyon ldan skye bo blun gyur gang / /mdza' bar byas na mi rung 'phel/ /rgyang du bsring na bde ba 'thob/ /bzang po dgra ru gyur kyang sla/ /141

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/legs par bsdum na phan par byed/ /sbrul gdug las kyang thu ba yi/ /skye bo ngan pa mdzar mi rung / /mdza' bar byas na khro 'gyur zhing / / phan btags pa na log par lta/ / bden par smras na phyir rgol ba/ /bcos su mi rung mi bsrun yin/ /mkhas pa gang gis de shes nas/ /'jam pos brid par mi bya ste/ /bad kan nad la rtsub bcos bzhin/ /thabs la mkhas pas brlang bar bya/ /drang po phal cher gzhom 'gyur la/ /'jam po phal cher brnyas bgyid pas/ /des shing drang ba rnams kyis kyang / /mi bsrun blun la ci 'os sbyar/ /skye bo ngan dang gser dang rnga/ /mi bsrun rta dang bud med dregs/ /142

mi bdag dul ba brtag pa/lnga bo brdung na dul 'gyur gyi/ /de dag 'jam po'i 'os ma yin/ /ya rabs rigs kyi gdong na pad+ma med/ /ma rabs rigs la klad nas rwa ma skyes/ /ji lta ji ltar spyod pa'i khyad par gyis/ /'phyon ma'i bu yi rigs rnams gsal ba nyid/ /des pa rnams kyis sbyin pa ma stsal la/ /nga rgyal can gyis gzhan nor ma phrogs kyang / /ji lta ji ltar so so'i skyon yon las/ /skye bo rnams ni dga' dang sdang bar byed/ /nga rgyal med cing des par gyur pa'i skye bo gang / /'grogs na bde zhing mdza' ba rab tu brtan gyur pa/ /'bras ldan ljon shing bzang po'i grib ma snum por ni/ /ngal bsos bzhin du brten rnams bde ba 'thob par byed/ /nga rgyal che zhing ma dul ba yi skye bo gang / /mthon po'i rigs su skyes kyang de la skyabs 'tshol 143

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rnams/ /sprin chung grib ma bzhin du rjes su phan mi 'gyur/ /de phyir dregs med des pa'i sa skyong bsten par bya/ /nga rgyal med cing dul ba dang ldan 'di ni zla ba min yang sa gsum kun dgar byed/ /'grogs na shin tu bde ba'i 'jug ngogs dam pa yin yang bdud rtsi'i rdzing bur gyur ma lags/ /mtha' dag skye bo dga' zhing lta ba'i 'dun sar gyur kyang lha yi dga' tshal ma yin no/ /gzhal med khang mchog min yang 'di phyir bde zhing legs pa'i sgo brgya 'byed pa'i tshul dang ldan/ /lugs kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan las/ mi bdag dul ba brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa ste bcu ba'o//1yo

kun la snyoms pa brtag pa/rab tu zud pa bcu gcig dze+e/ kun la stoms pa brtag pa/chen po'i sar gnas mi yi bdag po rnams/ /rang gi 'khor gyi skye bo mtha' dag la/ /phyogs lhung med par gcig tu mnyam pa'i yid/ /yangs pa'i sa chen bzhin du gzhag par byed/ /gru gcig nang du zhugs pa la'ang / /phyogs lhung can de mi mdzes na/ /skye bo mang po'i tshe gcig gi /dpon du gyur pa smos ci dgos/ /rang gi 'bangs kyi skye bo kun/ /gtso bo de la bsten par mnyam/ /de phyir mnyam par bskyang bya yi/ /mi mnyam gyur na yi chad 'gyur/ /145

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/yon tan can la rjes brtse zhing / /ma rungs pa la tshar gcod pa/ /so so'i las 'bras mngon sum du/ /bstan phyir 'di ni mi mnyam min/ /so so'i las skal gang thob pa/ /'di la bgo bya ci zhig yod/ /khral dang khrims dang srung tshul rnams/ /nye ring byas na mi mnyam yin/ /rgyal pos rang gi yul khams rnams/ /dgra dang gnod pa phongs pa'i phyogs/ /rnams las ji ltar nus par bsrung / /gcig ma bsrungs kyang rgyal po min/ /thabs ni gang gis bsrung zhe na/ /rang don mi shes nus med rnams/ /'di byos 'di las ma 'gal zhes/ /khrims su bcas pas srung bar byed/ /khrims las 'gal na su yang rung / /146

kun la snyoms pa brtag pa/mtshungs par chad pas gcad bya yi/ /'ga' la'ang yang bar mi bya ste/ /de ltar byas na khrims snyoms so/ /khrims ni snyoms par byas nas su/ /skye rgu bde bar bskyang ba'i phyir/ /bka' drin tshul gyis drug cha'i dpya/ /dus bzang rgyal rnams kyis kyang blang / /snyigs ma'i dus kyi rgyal po rnams/ /skye rgu tshul bzhin mi skyong bar/ /dpya la gdu bar byed pa ni/ /bran g.yog ngo tsha med dang 'dra/ /bran g.yog ngo tsha med pa rnams/ /bza' btung mthong na nan gyis 'du/ /dka' ba mthong na thabs kyis byol/ /las mi byed par gla rngan 'dod/ /'os pa'i dpya khral sdud pa yang / /'byor dang 'byor med rim pa dang / /147

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bstun nas mnyam par blang bya yi/ /mi mtshungs blangs na ga la snyoms/ /khral 'ded bya ba'i 'bangs kun la/ /yul dus 'byor pa dang bstun te/ /gzhis la gnod pa med par blang / /mi lcogs pa yis mnar mi bya/ /ba 'jo me tog btu tshul du/ /rtsa ba nyams par bya mi rigs/ /gal te rtsa ba nyams byas na/ /rgyal pos da gzod su las len/ /'bangs rnams rang gi lag mthu yis/ /bsgrubs pa'i longs spyod rgya chung la/ /lo re'i bza' btung gos rnams kyang / /sems khral med par bdog pa'ung dkon/ /grong khyer du ma'i dpya khral ni/ /cung zad blangs kyang bsdoms na mang / /de phyir rgyal pos 'khor rnams la/ /148

kun la snyoms pa brtag pa/brtse sems bzhag ste dpya blang bya/ /dpya dbul pa dang las byed sogs/ /rgyal por phan pa'i bgyi ba la/ /cha mtshungs rigs pas khral rnams la/ /'khor kun skyid sdug snyoms na bde/ /la la ci byed rang dbang can/ /kha cig gzhan dbang rtag tu mnar/ /'dra dang mi 'dra mang ba yi/ /yul de'i skye rgu mkhos mi phebs/ /mchod gnas dam pa'i zhabs 'degs dang / /'os la gnang ba'i bka' drin la/ /'bangs rnams 'gran sems mi 'os kyang / /rigs mthun mnyam par bskyang na legs/ /skye bo las kyis bkod pa'i phyir/ /thams cad bde sdug mnyam par ni/ /rgyal bas kyang ni mi spyod na/ /rgyal po gzhan gyis lta ci smos/ /149

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'on kyang gnas skabs bya ba la/ /'dra zhing mnyam pa kho na yis/ /phyogs su ma lhung snyoms byas na/ /mtho dman sus kyang bka' la brtsi/ /rgyal po kun gyi thun mong phyir/ /bya ba phyogs su ma lhung zhing / /phyogs zhen can gyi ngag mi smra/ /gtong la'ang phyogs zhen mi bya 'o/ /rang gi chos lugs gtsor bzung ste/ /bstan la phan 'dogs ci byas kyang / /de la grub mtha' gzhan 'khu na/ /rgyal po'i skyon min 'khor gyi skyon/ /rang gi grub mtha' gces bzung nas/ /grub mtha' gzhan la gnod byed na/ /de la 'khu ba ci byung yang / /'khor gyi skyon min rgyal po'i skyon/ /de phyir phyi rol mu stegs tshun/ /150

kun la snyoms pa brtag pa/rgyal po'i yul na gang gnas pa'i/ /gna' bo'i grub mtha' rang rang gi /snga tshul de bzhin rgyal pos bsrung / /phan tshun bsre bar mi bya la/ /phan tshun gnod du mi 'jug par/ /so sor ma nyams bskyang ba na/ /skye rgu skyong ba'i tshul lugs yin/ /dgos pa'i dus su ma gtogs pa/ /sde dang ris dang go sa la/ /dgos med glo bur dag tu ni/ /bab col 'phel 'grib mi bya 'o/ /glo bur dus kyi gnang sbyin sogs/ /phyogs lhung med par byas gyur na/ /mnga' bdag ris su ma chad ces/ /skye bo rnams ni yid mgu nus/ /cha lugs dang ni spyod lam sogs/ /ya ma zung du mi byed par/ /151

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rgyun du snyoms par gnas byas na/ /ya rabs tshul du gnas pa yin/ /bstod na khengs tshul mi bya zhing / /smad na zhum pa mi bya bar/ /rtag tu snyoms par gnas pa yi/ /mi bdag de ni gzi dang ldan/ /phyi thag blta ba'i mig rgyang gis/ /dgra la'ang bu bzhin bskyangs byas pas/ /tha mar dgra bo dbang gyur pa/ /blo khog yangs pa'i yon tan yin/ /blo gros rgya mtsho ltar yangs na/ /byis pa'i skye bos drod mi zin/ /col chung rnams kyi cal sgrogs la/ /mi brten skyes bu'i spyod pa mtshar/ /don chen go 'phang chen po'i phyir/ /phran tshegs dag la blta mi bya/ /sa rnams dbang du 'gyur ba'i slad/ /152

kun la snyoms pa brtag pa/ci 'byor gtong yang phongs sam ci/ /kun shong blo rgya che ba rnams/ /blo chung sems kyis bzod par dka'/ /mig rgyang thung ba'i skye bo la/ /sang nyin las kyang de ring gtso/ /sbrang bu ba rgyas bcings pa bzhin/ /blun po phran tshegs la chags nas/ /don chen gnas la gros mi thebs /rtag tu rang gis rang nyid bshol/ /nor gyis nor rnams 'gugs byed la/ /don las don gzhan 'byung ba'i phyir/ /don chen 'grub par mthong tshe rkyen/ /cis kyang mkhas pa bshol mi nus/ /dang por legs brtags the tshom gcod/ /bar du gang rtsom 'jigs pa med/ /tha mar dge'am nyes kyang rung / /mkhas rnams 'gyod med rtag tu bde/ / 153

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/blun pos bya ba ci byed kyang / /'jigs 'gyod the tshom med pa dkon/ /mkhas pa'i bya ba phal mo cher/ /de gsum med pas blo bder gnas/ /yun thung dus dang thabs chung ngus/ /bgyi ba chen po 'grub par dka'/ /yun ring dus su thabs chen pos/ /bsgrubs na mi 'grub gang yang med/ /ya rabs rnams la go 'phang gtso/ /yon tan sgrub dang thos pa dang / /dpal dang mnga' thang 'phel ba'i thabs/ /gang yin de la zhib tu rtogs/ /bsgrub bya de dag rnams don du/ /zas nor 'byor pa rtswa bzhin gtong / /mi bde khyad du bsad nas su/ /lus kyang bran bzhin bkol bar byed/ /nor gsog tsam la grung ba yis/ /154

kun la snyoms pa brtag pa/zas gtong nor ni srung bar byed/ /ma rabs rnams kyis gzhan bzhag nas/ /zas la rtog dpyod zhib par byed/ /so nam dus su zhib bya zhing / /dgos pa'i dus na rtsing por spyod/ /spyad par bya phyir nor gsog gi /mi spyad bsags na sdug bsngal rgyu/ /bya ba rdul ltar zhib na yang / /blo rgya sa gzhi ltar che la/ /legs nyes 'ja' ltar gsal na yang / /blo khog mkha' ltar yangs rnams mchog /zas dang spyod lam snyoms par gnas gyur na/ /'du ba snyoms shing nad med bde bar 'gyur/ /skye rgu rnams la snyoms par byas gyur na/ /phyogs med skye bo 'du zhing rjed par byed/ /bde dang sdug bsngal snyoms pa'i yid bzhag na/ /dus kun zug rngu rnam spang bde bar gnas/ /155

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mtha' la ma zhen mnyam pa'i yid skyed na/ /lta ba bzang ldan chos nyid don la gnas/ /phyogs lhung med par mnyam na spyi rje ste/ /yon tan 'di dang gang ldan rgyal por 'os/ /bshes ngor byed cing bya ba mi snyoms pa/ /khrims 'chal gnod pa du ma'i rgyu ru 'gyur/ /sa bzhin snyoms pa'i rgyal po 'jig rten na/ /skye bo'i tshogs kyi rten du gyur pa ste/ /yon tan rnam pa mang la rgya che ba'i/ /'bras bu bzang po'i tshogs kyi 'byung gnas yin/ /lugs kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan las/ kun la snyoms pa brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa ste bcu gcig pa'o//156

snying rje brtag pa/rab tu zud dze+e bcu gnyis pa/ snying rje brtag pha/sa skyong snying rje ldan pa rnams/ /'bangs la bu gcig bzhin du byams/ /rang gi srog dang nor btang nas/ /'khor rnams rjes su skyong ba yin/ /skyes bu phyugs kyis 'tsho rnams kyang / /phyugs la brtse bas ma bskyangs na/ /nye bar rgud pa thob min nam/ /rang don shes na 'khor bskyang bya/ /ljon shing lo 'dab rgyas pa de/ /ljon shing nyid kyi che rtags yin/ /'khor la phun sum tshogs pa de/ /rgyal po'i mnga' thang che rtags yin/ /157

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rgyal po rgyal po zhes bya ba/ /'bangs la brten nas ming du thogs/ /mi reng gcig pur gyur pa la/ /rgyal po zhes ni su zhig 'dogs/ /snyigs ma'i dus kyi rgyal rigs rnams/ /'bangs la gzan zas lta bur mthong / /sdig pa dag gi phru gu yis/ /ma nyid zas su mthong nas za/ /sngon tshe chos ldan rgyal rnams kyis/ /srog dang longs spyod btang nas su/ / rang gi 'bangs rnams skyong bar byed/ /kye ma blo yi khyad par ltos/ /rang don bzhag nas gzhan don gnyer/ /de la su zhig skyabs mi byed/ /'bras ldan shing dang yid 'ong chu/ /skye bo kun gyi 'dun sar 'gyur/ /rang don che zhing gzhan 'dor ba/ /158

snying rje brtag pa/de la su zhig skyabs su 'dzin/ /'bras med shing dang mi gtsang chu/ /blo ldan su yis bsten byar byed/ /gang zhig bsten pas dpal dang grags pa dang / /nor dang bde ba phun sum tshogs thob pa/ /bum bzang dpag bsam nor bu'i rjes 'gro ba'i/ /mi mchog de la bsten rnams rgyal bar 'gyur/ /bsten par gyur na khro dang brkam chags sogs/ /nyes pa'i dbang gis 'khor rnams phung byed pa/ /ha la'i ljon pa dug chu'i rdzing bu can/ /sa bdag ngan la su zhig sten par byed/ /de phyir su zhig bdag la bsten pa rnams/ /sdug bsngal yongs spangs bde bar 'gyur snyam du/ /rnam par dpyod pas nyin mtshan 'da' byed pas/ /sa skyong bzang po rnams ni don dang ldan/ /gal te rang don sems na yang / /rang don legs par sgrub pa la/ /159

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'khor bskyang ba las don che ba'i/ /rgyal po'i bya ba gzhan ci yod/ /'bras med shing dang mtsho bskams par/ /bya rnams 'du bar mi 'gyur ltar/ /rgyal srid mnga' thang nyams pa'i phyogs/ /skye bo kun gyis spong bar byed/ /skyid na lha yang 'du byed la/ /sdug na bu yang 'bros byed pas/ /rgyal pos rang gi yul 'khor kun/ /dpal gyi mtsho ltar gang bar bya/ /'khor dang nor gyis 'byor gyur na/ /rgyal po stobs dang cis mi ldan/ /'byor par gyur tshe kun kyang mdza'/ /rgud par gyur tshe thams cad dgra/ /rgyal pos yul der mi bzad pa'i/ /dbul dang khas nyen sdug bsngal can/ /skyabs med 'di dag rnams kyi skyabs/ /160

snying rje brtag pa/bdag min su zhig yod snyam bya/ /shin tu mi bsrun gyur rnams la/ /rgyal pos bdag la brnyas snyam du/ /rgyud tshig par ni mi bya ste/ /de rnams nyes pas rmongs phyir ro/ /rmongs phyir pha dang ma la'ang /'tshe zhing dkon mchog gsum la gnod/ /bdag gi bde ba khyad gsod pa/ /de la snying rje cis mi skye/ /mig med g.yang sar mchong ba ni/ /g.yang sar brnyas pa ma yin gyi/ /rang gi las kyis rang brnyas nas/ /dbang med sdug bsngal myong bar zad/ /de bzhin mi bsrun pa rnams la/ /snying rje'i bsam pa bskyed nas su/ /pha yis bu ni bcos pa ltar/ / bsdig cing gdul dka' gnas nas bskrad/ /161

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/sdug pa dang bral rang mis brnyas pa dang / /bu lon mang zhing ngan pa dag la brten/ /dbul bar mthong nas mdza' bos spangs pa ste/ /me ma yin par lus sreg de lnga 'o/ /gang zhig rgan po byis pa nad pa dang / /nyam chung thabs stor de bzhin rgud pa dang / /rgyal pos spangs dang skyabs med gyur rnams la/ /snying rje med pa de dag mir mi rung / /bdag ni mgon dang bcas snyam re sems kyis/ /nyam chung mchi mas brnangs pa'i smre sngags kyis/ /sa bdag la ni bden pa'i don gsol ba/ /yal bar 'dor ba sems kyis ji ltar bzod/ /shin tu nyam chung rnams kyis mi bdag la/ /zhu bar rngo mi thogs pa mang ba'i phyir/ /dus dang dus su 'bangs kyi bde sdug la/ /tshul bzhin rtog cing dpyod pa mkhas pa yin/ /rang nyid bde bar gnas pa phal/ /162

snying rje brtag pa/pha rol nyams la lta ba dkon/ /gzhan gyi khong du zhugs pa lta'i/ /bsam dpyod can gyi rje bo bzang /rnam pa kun tu sems kyis yongs brtags kyang / /bdag las ches sdug 'ga' yang ma mthong ba/ /de ltar so sor gzhan la'ang rang sdug pa/ /de phyir bdag dgas gzhan la gnod mi bya/ /bde ba 'dod dang sdug bsngal mi 'dod par/ /skye bo kun kyang shin tu mnyam pa'i phyir/ /bdag gi tshul la bltas nas 'gro ba gzhan/ /shin tu phongs par gyur la snying rje byed/ /bdag ni skye bo 'di yi mgon gyur la/ /'di kun bdag la re zhig lta byed pas/ /bdag gi srog ni btang bar ches bla yi/ /'di rnams gtang bar mi bya snyam du bsam/ /skyabs med rnams la skyabs su mi bgyid cing / /ji ltar nus pas dbugs 'byin mi stsol bar/ /163

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'bangs kyi nor len 'bangs la mi sems rnams/ /khrel ldan yin na khrel med gzhan su zhig / yon tan can la bsten byas na/ /srog gi phyir yang des mi gtong / /seng ge yan lag ma smad pas/ /spre'u'i phru gu bsrung ba bzhin/ /ngan par ji ltar phan btags kyang / /rkyen dang 'phrad pa'i tshe na bslu/ /mi ngan chu las bsgral na yang / /ri dwags ru ru gzhan la bstan/ /rang gi ris nas ma 'das pa/ /ji ltar mi bsrun gyur na yang / /rang la dbang ba'i phyir na des/ /brnyas par mi dogs 'bad de 'chos/ /rang gi ris nas gang 'das pas/ /gnod kyang chad pas ji ltar gcod/ /brnyas thabs byed na des byed de/ /164

snying rje brtag pa/khro na de la khro bar bya/ /gang zhig sbrul gyis zin gyur na/ /gdug pa'i dug ni mched dogs pas/ /rang gi sor mo yin na yang / /gcad par bya ba ji bzhin du/ /gang zhig bcos su mi btub pa'i/ /mi bsrun gdug pa gang gnas pa'i/ /yul khams de yang sdug bsngal phyir/ /rang gi gnas nas bor bar bya/ /rang gi yul gyi skye bo yis/ /gal te nyes pa byas pa la/ /'os mthun chad pas bcad byas kyang / /rang la dbang phyir snying rje bya/ /snying rje med cing gdug ldan pa'i/ /ma la'ang bu ni 'bros byed na/ /'khor gyi skye bo smos ci dgos/ /'khor rnams 'grib na rgyal po dma'/ /165

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ rang gi yul der gnas pa yi/ /glo bur mgron dang dbul po'i tshogs/ /ci nus par ni bsrung bya ste/ /ci mi snyam du gzhag mi rigs/ /rang don phun sum tshogs 'dod na/ /gzhan don sgrub pa thabs su bsngags/ /gzhan phan byed pa'i skye bo rnams/ /rgyal po min yang rgyal po 'dra/ /rtsod pa'i dus kyi rgyal ngan rnams/ /'khor gyi phun tshogs mthong gyur na/ /sems la zug rngu skye ba ni/ /'chi ltas bzhin du phyin ci log /brtse ldan dam pa'i skyes bu yis/ /rgyal khams gzhan gyi phun tshogs la'ang / /dga' zhing rjes su yi rang ba/ /de yis rang gi phun tshogs 'phel/ / dngos po'i rang bzhin shes byas nas/ /166

snying rje brtag pa/dgra rnams la yang byams pa yis/ /khyab par byed pa'i sa bdag des/ /sa rnams ma lus dbang du 'du/ /byams pa'i sems ni nyer bzhag ste/ /gtong dang snyan par smra ba dang / /'bangs kyi don byed rgyal po de'i/ /grags pa 'jig rten gsum du khyab/ /gang la byams pa'i sems kyi dpal gnas par/ /bsod nams stobs kyis lha rnams dgar gyur nas/ /mi ma yin pa rnams kyang srung byed na/ /mi yi skye bo'i tshogs rnams smos ci dgos/ /mi bdag snying rje ldan pa'i yul khams su/ /rnam mang 'byor pa dbyar gyi chu ltar 'phel/ /pha rol dpung gi tshogs kyis mi brdzi zhing / /skye bo'i tshogs rnams dga' bas bag phebs 'gyur/ /byams ldan rgyal po zla ba rgyas pa bzhin/ /skye rgu'i bsod nams dpal du shar ba'i tshe/ /167

yul phyogs der ni mgon dang bcas pa'i phyir/ /rgyal po nyid kyis tshostongs pa zhes bshad/ /lugs kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan las/ snying rje brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa ste bcu gnyis pa'o//

mi yi bdag pos rang nyid legs par srung ba'i tshul brtag pa/rab tu zud pa bcu gsum pha/ mi yi bdag dzo rang gis rang nyid legs par srung ba'i tshul brtag pa/de ltar brtan zhing des la snyoms gyur cing / /snying rje'i sems dang ldan pa'i mi bdag des/ /rang gi mnga' ris legs par skyong ba yi/ /thabs tshul rnam pa mang la sems par byed/ /skye rgu bde bar byed pa 'tsho tshis yin/ /mi bde 'phel ba 'gog pa khrims yin pas/ /'jig rten bde bar 'tsho dang khrims kyi las/ /gnyis kyi sgo nas skye rgu srung bar byed/ /mi bdag rang sde bsrung 'dod pas/ /sngon du rang nyid legs par bsrung / /rang yang srung bar ma nus pas/ /169

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrig sa/gzhan dag ji ltar bsrung bar bya/ /thog mar bdag gi tshe dang lus/ /sde bzhi'i rtsa bar gyur pa gang / /yun du brtan zhing 'tsho ba yi /thabs la 'bad pas bsrung bar bya/ /rin chen sman dang rig sngags kyi/ /sbyor ba'am rlung gi rnal 'byor sogs/ /thabs dang ldan pa'i cho ga yis/ /lus ni legs par bsrung bar bya/ /bsod nams kyis ni 'di phyir bde/ /bsod nams ldan na bsam pa 'grub/ /de phyir bsod nams 'bad bya ste/ /bsod nams stobs kyi rnam thar ltos/ /blo gros bya ba gnas grogs rdzas/ /la sogs dpal rnams ji snyed pa/ /lha dang klu la nor bu bzhin/ /bsod nams stobs kyis 'bad med 'thob/ /170

mi yi bdag pos rang nyid legs par srung ba'i tshul brtag pa/dran dang shes bzhin bag yod kyis/ / sems kyi yon tan bsrung bya zhing / /brtson pas gong nas gong du ni/ /'phel ba'i thabs la sbyar bar bya/ /'phags pa gser 'od dam pa dang / /rgya cher rol pa tog gi gzungs/ /sa snying 'khor lo bcu ba dang / /'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud la sogs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab rnams/ /dge ba'i bshes las lung nod cing / /mchod dang bkur snyi cher byas nas/ /dus su bklags shing bsams byas na/ /rgyal rigs de dag bsod nams 'phel/ / sngags kyi dkyil 'khor rnam mang por/ /gang dag dad pas legs zhugs te/ /dbang mnos dam tshig bzung byas na/ /tshe dang bsod nams grags pa 'phel/ /171

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ji srid 'dod chen ma gyur pa/ /de srid yon tan gtsang ba yin/ /'dod chen nyid la zhugs gyur na/ /yon tan btsun par ga la 'gyur/ /ngo tsha med na de'i yon tan/ /brjod byar byas nas gtam ngan 'phel/ /de phyir ngo tsha khrel yod pas/ /rang gi yon tan bsrung bar bya /gnas khang me ru 'bar tshe sngon/ /ngo tshas lus ni byibs bzhin du/ /shi ba'ang tshangs gnas skyes zhes su/ /yon tan de ltar mdo las bshad/ /ngo tsha tsam la de lta bu'i/ /yon tan che dang ldan gyur na/ /ngo tsha khrel yod dang ldan pas/ /yon tan srung ba smos ci 'tshal/ /ngo tsha med pa'i mi rnams ni/ /172

mi yi bdag pos rang nyid legs par srung ba'i tshul brtag pa/ji ltar brgyan kyang mdzes ma yin/ /khyad par chen po'i mi rnams la/ /ngo tsha khrel yod mchog tu dgos/ /che rnams ngo tsha mi shes na/ /ngo tsha med rnams su yis 'dul/ /skyabs las 'jigs pa byung ba dang / /chu las me 'bar sus zhi nus/ /ngo tsha med pas sma phab pa/ /chen po'i go nas yar mod kyi/ /da dung rang tshul mi shes par/ /che bar rlom pa kye ma 'khrul/ /'dod pas gdung la khrel med ngo tsha med/ /bkres pas gdung la stobs med mdangs kyang med/ /nad kyis gdung la gnyid med bde ba med/ /de phyir 'dod pa'i gnas las bag yod bya/ /'dod pa dang 'dra'i 'dam rdzab med/ /zhe sdang lta bu'i gnod pa med/ /173

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gti mug lta bu'i rgya med de/ /sred pa lta bu'i chu klung med/ /chags pa dang 'dra 'gro ba'i dri ma med/ /phrag dog dang 'dra gzhan la gnod pa med/ /slong ba dang 'dra'i mdza' ba yod min te/ /gtong ba dang mnyam nor ni gzhan na med/ /shes rab 'dra ba'i mig ni gzhan yod min/ /thos pa dang 'dra bshes gnyen gzhan med de/ /yon tan 'dra ba'i rgyan ni gzhan du med/ /de phyir skyon yon legs bsam rang nyid srung / /mi chos srog shing drang po ste/ /ya rabs bya ba phal mo che/ /gya gyu'i rdzab kyis ma g.yogs par/ /gtsang ma'i gser bzhin mngon pa yin/ /g.yo sgyus bsgrubs pa'i zas dang nor/ /rnyed do snyam kyang shor las thu/ / yid rton slu bar byed pa rnams/ /174

mi yi bdag pos rang nyid legs par srung ba'i tshul brtag pa/'tsho yang 'tsho ba min dang 'dra/ /rgyu 'bras med pa mi srid la/ /lha mig sgrib par mi nus pas/ /gya gyu can gyi ngan mtshang skyon/ /'di dang phyi mar yang yang myong / /las 'bras lha mig dpang bzhag ste/ /rang sems gtsang mar gyur pa rnams/ /lha dang mi yi 'jig rten na/ /sgrib med zla rgyas bzhin du mdzes/ /ngan spyod rang gis ma byas na/ /brgya byin gyis kyang smad mi nus/ /gang zhig ngan spyod med pa des/ /ngan spyod can rnams 'dul bar 'os/ /bzang po shor nas ngan pa 'dzin/ /skye bo ngan pa chu tshags 'dra/ /ngan pa spangs nas bzang po sgrub/ /khab len rdo dang ya rabs mtshungs/ /175

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rang nyid don la mkhas gyur cing / /ya rabs bya bar rtag gnas na/ /rin chen sgron ma 'od 'bar ba/ /'thor rlung gis ni gnod med 'dra/ /ma smras gzhan gyis ma bskul bar/ /rnam 'gyur sogs las bsam pa shes/ /dus su don rnams yol med du/ /sgrub par shes na mkhas pa yin/ /phal bas rtogs par dka' ba yi/ /mkhas pa'i spyod yul shes na mkhas/ /srin bus shing la yig ris bzhin/ /stes dbang don grub mkhas pa min/ /phan dang gnod pa'i nus pa can/ /gang na yod par mi shes pas/ /su la'ang khyad du mi gsad par/ /phan par byas na rang nyid 'phel/ /mkhas pas ma 'ongs ched du sbyin/ /176

mi yi bdag pos rang nyid legs par srung ba'i tshul brtag pa/blun pos rang phan mthong tshe sbyin/ /byin par 'dra yang pha rol la/ /ngo so che chung 'dra mi 'gyur/ /mkhas pas rang la gang phan brtsi/ /blun pos gang 'byor gang mtho brtsi/ /pho rab chus kyi spyi rgya dpyod/ /pho tha za kha che chung dpyod/ /grogs bzang mdza' bo rgud tshe skyong / /grogs ngan mdza' bo 'byor tshe skyong / /bskyang bar 'dra yang blo ldan gyis/ /bltas na skyong tshul 'dra mi 'gyur/ /pho bzang rgyal kha phyi la rtsod/ /pho ngan rgyal kha nang du rtsod/ /brtsad par 'dra yang pha rol gyis/ /bltas na rtsod tshul 'dra mi 'gyur/ /blun pos thog mar bde 'bras 'tshol/ /mkhas pas thog mar bde rgyu 'tshol/ /177

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/btsal bar 'dra yang gnad shes pas/ /bltas na 'tshol tshul 'dra mi 'gyur/ /de sogs 'dra la mi 'dra ba'i/ /bya ba'i khyad kyis bzang ngan shes/ /yon tan med pa'i grogs stong las/ /yon tan ldan pa'i grogs gcig mchog /dgra gcig yod kyang mang dang 'dra/ /gnyen brgya yod kyang nyung dang mtshungs/ /de bas mdza' phyogs mang bya zhing / /su la'ang dgra ru bslang mi bya/ /bskyang na dgra yang gnyen du 'gyur/ /mnar na bu yang dgra ru 'gro/ /su yang mdza' dang dgra min gyi/ /phal cher rang gi bya bas byas/ /'jam pos rtsub mo'ang 'dul nus na/ /'jam po nyid la smos ci dgos/ /'jam la dus su rno ba ni/ /178

mi yi bdag pos rang nyid legs par srung ba'i tshul brtag pa/dgra rnams kyis kyang thub par dka'/ /dgras kyang brnyas pa'i des pa dang / /gnyen yang 'bros pa'i rtsub mo des/ /ci bya zhi drag gnyis ka'i mthu/ /gang la yod de kun gyis bsngags/ /rang la lan pa med pa yi/ /drang po'i lam la rtag gnas nas/ /pha rol rgyu med 'tshe ba la/ /'dud par mi bya brling bar bya/ /yon tan ldan na dgra yang mdza' ru bsdum/ /mi bsrun ngan pa mdza' yang rgyab tu bor/ /bar mar gnas pa btang snyoms tshul du bya/ /de ltar shes na rtag tu bde ba 'thob/ /phyi nas 'di 'drar 'gyur snyam pa'i/ /bsam gzhig sngon du legs btang ste/ /bya ba 'bras bur ldan bya zhing / /las kun rjes 'gyod med par bya/ /179

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dus la bab pa'i bya ba rnams/ /tshegs med par yang 'grub par 'gyur/ /dus yol ba 'am dus snga ba'i/ /bgyi ba phal cher bsgrub par dka'/ /tshe 'dir rgyal po'i khrims dang ni/ /phyi ma rnam smin 'bras bu la/ /su yang byol bar mi 'gyur bas/ /mi bden pa na pham ngos blang / /mi la lta ba'i mig yod kyang / /rang la lta na me long dgos/ /rang blo nang du ma bsdus na/ /rang skyon rang gis mthong bar dka'/ /blun pos bde dang sdug bsngal kun/ /gzhan gyi rkyen las byung snyam du/ /rtag tu yul la 'dor len gyi/ /chags sdang rnam rtog rba la g.yeng / /mkhas pas bde dang sdug bsngal kun/ /180

mi yi bdag pos rang nyid legs par srung ba'i tshul brtag pa/bdag la rag las shes byas nas/ /rtag par nang du blo phyogs te/ /bdag la rtog cing bag yod gnas/ /legs nyes gang dang gang myong yang / /bsam dpyod can la blo skyed thon/ /skyid sdug brgya phrag mthong na yang / /bsam med blun por bogs skyed med/ /sna tshogs nor bu ji bzhin du/ /go sa dus dang pha rol dang / /bstun pa'i bya ba mkhas pas ston/ /blun po rdo la mdog 'gyur ci/ /stobs ldan 'byor pa rgya che yang /gnas min gzhan la mnar mi bya/ /rgyal bar gyur na tshod zin pa'i/ /mi bdag de ni rtag tu rgyal/ /nags tshal tshogs kyis mgron du bos pa yi/ /lce bdun gar thabs bskyod la su mi byol/ /181

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dus su char 'bebs sprin gyi rnga gsang can/ /chu 'dzin slog phreng mdzes 'dis kun yid 'phrog /ci tsam rnyed cing rgyal tshe blun po rnams/ /brkam chags me ltar 'bar nas myur du yal/ /rnyed pa 'phel zhing gzhan las rgyal na yang / /mkhas rnams bag yod sgo nas sprin bzhin bsil/ /mi ngan bsten rdzi byed pa dang / /ban sngags dgra ru bslang ba gnyis/ /rgyal po yin kyang mi bya ste/ /byas na rang nyid phung ba'i rgyu/ /'khon rnying ba dang bu lon lhag /me mched chung ngu'i dus na bcad/ /rkon pa'i nang nas bya shor bzhin/ /rjes su bgyi bar dka' ba mchi/ /ci tsam rtsi zhing bkur ba na/ /de lta de ltar dul bar bya/ /ci tsam brnyas shing 'tshe ba na/ /182

mi yi bdag pos rang nyid legs par srung ba'i tshul brtag pa/de lta de ltar gtum par bya/ /bkur na khro zhing brnyas na zhi 'gyur la/ /thub na lha gsod mi thub bdud kyang mchod/ /'thab na 'bros shing btud na mnar byed pa'i/ /ngan pa'i mi la blo ldan su zhig dga'/ /dgra bos brnyas thabs byas kyang chu bzhin 'thung / /'khor gyis phan par byas kyang 'tshe bar rtsom/ /blang dor log par spyod pa'i skye bo la/ /phan pa'i gnyen kyang bsam pa gzhan du phyogs/ /blo ldan rang nyid 'byor tshe dman la byams/ /pha rol rgud tshe dgra yang legs skyong ba'i/ /tshul 'di mdzes kyang mdzes la 'os kyang 'os/ /lugs zung yon tan dus gcig ma ngoms gsal/ /gnyen no cog la sbyin zhi snyan smra sogs/ /mthun 'jug thabs kyis gzhan yid bsdu mkhas pas/ /tshegs med bya bas rang stobs skyed byed cing / /yon tan spo la dar bzhin mngon par byed/ /183

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'khon med par ni rgyal srid phrogs pa sogs/ /las kyi dgrar gyur bcos su mi rung ba'i/ /mi bsrun rnams la zhi ba'i thabs kyis ci/ /de phyir drag po'i spobs pa nges par bskyed/ /gnyen du byas na phan pa che/ /dgra ru bslang na gnod nus pa'i/ /mi gang dgra zun go chod pa/ /deng sang snyigs ma'i dus na dkon/ /ma brnyas mi yi rtsa ba yin/ /brnyas pa'i nor gyis ci zhig bya/ /dgra go zun go mi chod pa/ /mi ru btags kyang phyugs las dman/ /rgyal po yur chu 'khri shing dang / /bud med dmus long lnga bo ni/ /g.yon can gar 'khrid 'gro bar gsungs/ /de bas gzhan dring 'jog mi bya/ /g.yon can gus pa ston pa ni/ /184

mi yi bdag pos rang nyid legs par srung ba'i tshul brtag pa/dgos pa'i phyir yin dga' bas min/ /brtags shing gdeng ni ma thob par/ /su la'ang yid brtan mi bya 'o/ /kha cig rang la dpe blangs nas/ /skye bo gzhan dag 'jal bar byed/ /kha cig ngan pas sun phyung bas/ /dam pa la'ang yid mi ches/ /mkhas pa dag gis brtags byas na/ /ngang pas chu las 'o ma bzhin/ /bzang ngan don ni khong chud de/ /bya ba'i gnas la rmongs mi 'gyur/ /g.yon can tshul bzang ngag snyan ston pa dang / /'khon rnying dgra dang ma brtags gsar 'grogs la/ /yid brtan byas pas kha cig phung 'gyur te/ /bya rog gis ni 'ug pa'i tshang bsregs bzhin/ /seng ge'i lus kyi 'bu bzhin du/ /chen po rnams la dgra bas kyang / /185

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rang gi ris nas gnod pa mang / /de phyir 'khor dang ris la brtag /nor mnyam nus pa mnyam pa dang / /gnad shes 'bad rtsol che ba yi/ /rang dang ris su mnyam pa la/ /bag zon ma byas de 'dras phung / /phan pa med na gnyen kyang gzhan/ /pha rol yin yang gang phan gnyen/ /lus la lhan cig byung ba'i nad/ /gso byed dgos pa'i sman bzhin no/ /byas pa gzo dang phan gnod tshul/ /go ma log pa'i bya ba ni/ /gnad can gcig gis skyes bu de'i/ /yon tan drod tshad shes par nus/ /rgud tshe mdza' yang spong byed la/ /'byor tshe dgra yang mchod byed pa'i/ /tha shal de 'dras bdag nyid la/ /186

mi yi bdag pos rang nyid legs par srung ba'i tshul brtag pa/mchod kyang blo ldan su zhig mgu/ /yid mthun ring na gnas kyang nye/ /mi mthun gam na gnas kyang ring / /sha lhag mtshon gyis gcod byed la/ /rgyan bzang lus la srel bar byed/ /dam pa min dang dam pa dag /lhan cig 'grogs kyang 'dre mi 'gyur/ /dam pa gnyis ni rgyang ring yang / /mthun 'gyur nyi dang pad tshal bzhin/ /nyin byed dbang po shar ba'i tshe/ /mig ldan gzugs la lta ba bzhin/ /blo ldan blo ldan phrad pa na/ /tshig gcig gis kyang gros ngogs mthong / /blun po rnams la phan btags dang / /gnod pa byas kyang de yi yid/ /ji ltar gyur pa 'byed dka' ste/ /mun par rdo 'phang ji bzhin no/ /187

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/sngar byas phan gnod mi brjed cing / /da lta gang brtson don ldan byed/ /'byung 'gyur don la bag yod can/ /mkhas pas dus gsum rjes su blta/ /blo rgya che zhing blo dpangs mtho/ /blo gsal bya ba kun shes pa'i/ /mitshobu rin chen mchog nyid ni/ /brgya stong nang na re re tsam /sa gzhi rdul phran mtsho chu thigs/ /ji bzhin skye bo'i sems kyi stobs/ /mchog dang bar ma dman pa'i tshad/ /klu chen dang 'dra mkhas pas shes/ /skye bo ngan pa rdzing chung bzhin/ /zhag gam zla bas gting tshod lon/ /mtsho 'dra'i yon tan can yun ring / /bsten kyang je zab mtha' mi mngon/ /phan sems brlang tshig smra ba dang / /188

mi yi bdag pos rang nyid legs par srung ba'i tshul brtag pa/g.yo sgyu'i 'dzum dkar ston pa gnyis/ /mkhas pas so sor 'byed 'gyur la/ /blun pos shes par mi 'gyur ro/ /ri bong cal sgras kun dkrogs ltar/ /blun po grags pa'i rjes su 'brang / /bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du/ /mkhas pa rang gis brtags nas 'byed/ /re zhig phan byed yid 'ong yang / /nam phugs gnod pa dag kyang srid/ /re zhig gnod byas mi dga' yang / /'grogs na phan par 'gyur srid pas/ /yud tsam zhig gis mdza' ba dang / /mi mdza' gnyis ka mi bya bar/ /'phral du 'grogs na bde ba dang / /phugs su ches cher brling bar bya /brtson 'grus stobs ldan blo gros che rnams la/ /lha yang 'jigs pa skye na mi lta ci/ /189

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/khong bzang g.yo med klan ka mi 'tshol ba'i/ /grogs po bzang por lha yang dga' ba skye/ /grogs bzang dang bcas thabs mkhas blo ldan pas/ /rlung yod me bzhin dus su brtsams byas na/ /'jig rten kun gyi dpal rnams ma lus pa/ /yid kyi lag tu mchis pa bzhin du 'gyur/ /ha cang byams pa che drags na/ /tha mar 'khon gyi rgyu ru 'gro/ /ha cang g.yo sgyu che drags na/ /tha mar rang nyid brlag pa mang / /zas dang sman gyi tshod bzhin du/ /bya ba gang dang ci la yang / /dus dang bstun pa'i tshod shes na/ /rgud pa chen pos mnar mi 'gyur/ /gal te rtag tu mdza' 'dod na/ /gsum po 'di dag mi bya ste/ /rgyan po 'gyed dang nor 'brel dang / /190

mi yi bdag pos rang nyid legs par srung ba'i tshul brtag pa/lkog tu chung ma dang smra ba'o/ /g.yul ngor dpa' bo ji bzhin du/ /mkhas pa'i yon tan mkhas pas shes/ /blun pos mkhas dang rmongs pa dang / /rdo dang rin chen mnyam par lta/ /dam pa yon tan ldan pa dag /drung na gnas kyang blun po yis/ /de yi yon tan mi shes te/ /nyi ma shar yang 'ug pa bzhin/ /blo gros ldan des skye bo la/ /yon tan gang dang ldan gyur pa/ /tshig dang bya bas rgyang nas shes/ /du ba'i rtags las me bzhin no/ /g.yul du zhugs tshe dpa' bo shes/ /'byor pa zad tshe chung ma rtogs/ /rgud tshe phan par byed pa ni/ /mdza' bo yin par nges pa rnyed/ /191

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bogs med tshong dang 'khor ldan dag la 'tshe/ /slong zhing 'gying la nor med 'dod la dga'/ /bud med gzhon la tshig rtsub smra ba ste/ /skyes bu log par spyod pa lnga zhes gsungs/ /bya ba mi lcogs rtsom par byed pa dang / /tshogs dang 'khon zhing stobs ldan dag la rgol/ /bud med la ni yid brtan byed pa ste/ /'chi bdag drung na sdod pa bzhi zhes gsungs/ /rig pa log par shes pa dug /rgan pos gzhon nu bsten pa dug /nad la btang snyoms bya ba dug /dbul po nyal dga' che ba dug /ma smin zas dang mi 'phrod za/ /nyin par 'khrig dang nyal dang gnyid/ /bud med rgan dang 'khrig spyod rnams/ /lus stobs 'phrog byed bzlog na 'phel/ /gang du phan pa ma yin pa'i/ /192

mi yi bdag pos rang nyid legs par srung ba'i tshul brtag pa/bya ba dang ni spyod lam dang / /zas dang gnas dang bran la sogs/ /brtags te rab tu spang bar bya/ /ltas dang bsam sbyor rjes mtha' rnams/ /rang la dge zhing gang shis pa'i/ /gnas grogs dus sogs bsten mkhas na/ /don rnams yid bzhin 'grub par 'gyur/ /ha cang byams pa gnyen la'ang min/ /ha cang mnar ba dgra la'ang min/ /rgyal khrims ha cang lhod pa dang / /ha cang dog pa mi bya 'o/ /lo lnga'i bar du bu rnams brid/ /lo bcu'i bar du dgra ltar brdeg /bcu drug lon par gyur nas ni/ /bu la mdza' ltar bya bar gsungs/ /'khor la brtse zhing skabs su bsdigs/ /dgra la bsdigs shing skabs su brtse/ /193

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bud med byams bskyang zil gyis mnan/ /bran g.yog bkol zhing nor gyis bskyang / /don chung bya bar gal mi 'dzugs/ /gal chen don rnams yal mi 'dor/ /mkhos chung bya bar zhib mi 'jug /gnad chen don la zhib mor sgrim/ /bdag las phrogs pa ma yin phyir/ /gzhan 'byor gnas la rngam mi rigs/ /tshur rgol la sogs rgyu med par/ /pha rol rgyal srid 'phrog mi bya/ /gzhan 'byor la ni brnab sems can/ /de yi re ba mi 'grub cing / /la yogs rnam smin mi bzad pas/ /myur du rang phung 'gyur bar zad/ /de phyir stobs dang ldan na yang / /pha rol mnar bar mi byed pa'i/ /mi bdag rnams ni bsod nams kyis/ /194

mi yi bdag pos rang nyid legs par srung ba'i tshul brtag pa/rang srid brtan zhing phyogs kun 'du/ /snyigs dus tshe 'byor snyan grags sogs/ /lhan cig tshang ba chun dka' bas/ /ci nas bsod nams rgya chen po/ /bsag dang thabs la mkhas par bya/ /thabs shes pa yis legs brtsams na/ /'grub par dka' ba'ang 'grub 'gyur te/ / sngags sogs thabs kyi cho ga yis/ /dug kyang bdud rtsir bsgyur ba bzhin/ /lugs dang mi mthun rno myur gyis/ /'phral du rang don 'grub pa tsam/ /snyigs dus pho bzang zhes sgrogs kyang / /rdzing chung bzhin du cher mi 'phel/ /lugs dang mthun par gnas pa rnams/ /'phral du mngon par ma gyur kyang / /nam zhig chu gter che bzhin du/ /dpal 'byor rgya cher rgyas shing brtan/ /195

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/blun pos 'bad de bcos pa las mkhas pas dus su smras tsam mchog /thabs mkhas ldan pa'i bya ba ni/ /chung yang 'bras bu che bar 'gyur/ /thabs mi mkhas pa'i yon tan rnams/ /grags pa chung la skyon ltar smod/ /thabs mkhas ldan na skyon rnams kyang / /yon tan ltar 'gyur grags pa che/ /n+ya gro dha yi 'bras bu dang / /nyungs gzhi sa la lhung tshe mnyam/ /tha mar rim gyis skyes pa'i tshe/ /che chung mnyam par mi 'gyur bzhin/ /rang gi ris su mtshungs pa yi/ /skye bo'i nang nas yon tan can/ /lo dang zla bas 'phel 'gyur te/ /tha mar kun las khyad du 'phags/ /de phyir rang don shes pa yis/ /196

mi yi bdag pos rang nyid legs par srung ba'i tshul brtag pa/nyi ma don med mi bya bar/ /bzlas dang bsod nams bsag pa dang / /bslab dang bsgrub bya'i don la 'bad/ /sdig pa zad 'dod bde bar gshegs la dad/ /bsod nams 'dzad 'dod bsam pa ngan pa 'char /rigs rgyud zad 'dod glen zhing lkugs pa skye/ /skal ngan zad 'dod bsod nams bsag par 'dod/ /mi bsrun skye bo sa khung las byung ba'i/ /tshig ngan sbrul gyis skyes bu dam pa zin/ /dug de zhi bar byed pa'i gnyen po yang / /shes rab bzod pa'i sman mchog btung bar bya/ /skye bo blo dpangs mtho rnams la/ /tshe 'di'i bde skyid mchog gnyis te/ /ci 'dod phun sum tshogs pa dang / /cig shos 'du 'dzi spang ba 'o/ /dam pa'i 'gro ba gnyis yin te/ /me tog dag gi mgo rtsog bzhin/ /197

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'jig rten kun gyis spyir bkur ba'am/ / nags nyid du ni dengs pa 'o /dpal ni rgyab kyis phyogs pa dang / /rtsol ba don med nyid gyur cing / /dam pa dbul por gyur pa la/ /nags las gzhan du bde ba med/ /yon tan shes shing bkur byed pa'i/ /gnas su mkhas pas gnas par bya/ /sbrul gdug khrod kyi nor bu bzhin/ /ma rabs tshogs su gnas mi bya/ /ngang pa khā yi tshogs nang mdzes ma yin/ /cang shes bong bu'i tshogs nang mdzes ma yin/ /seng ge wa yi tshogs nang mdzes ma yin/ /mkhas pa blun po'i tshogs nang ji ltar mdzes/ /blun pos bdag gi khron pa 'di yin zhes/ /chu gtsang gzhan spangs ba tshwa can 'thung ltar/ /bsgrod par bya ba'i yu la gzhan yod bzhin du/ /198

mi yi bdag pos rang nyid legs par srung ba'i tshul brtag pa/'khor dang gnas ngan dag la ci phyir chags/ /dga' zhing mthun pa'i yul na gnas pa bde/ /bag phebs yid rton grogs dang 'grogs pa bde/ /bsod nams bsags shing dam pa bsten pa bde/ /chog shes 'byor ldan rang dbang gyur pa bde/ /byis pa'i dus na pha ma'i dbang gyur la/ /lang tsho'i dus na mdza' grogs dbang gyur cing / /rgas pa'i dus na bu yi dbang gyur pa'i/ /blun po nam yang rang dbang yod ma yin/ /dbang med gyur pas yon tan mi 'thob cing / /rang nyid rjes su bsrung bar mi nus pa/ /de phyir rtag tu rang dbang yod bgyis te/ /rang gi dgos pa don du gnyer bar bya/ /rang dbang thams cad bde ba ste/ /gzhan dbang thams cad sdug bsngal yin/ /rang dbang thob nas yon tan la/ /'bad par byed pa de bas bde/ /199

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ nad kyis 'jigs pa ma byung la/ /dam pa dag dang 'grogs par brtson/ /skye bos brnyas thabs ma byung ba'i/ /nyin gcig lo brgya bas kyang mchog /lan med pa yi sbyin gtong dang / /bshes pa med par phan 'dogs dang / /zang zing med par chos ston pa/ /bdag nyid chen po'i che ba'i rtags/ /ji srid sdug pa'i dus kyi zla rgyas nyid/ /'chi bdag gza' chen 'di yis ma rnyed pa/ /de srid bag yod par ni gnas bya ste/ /rigs dang yon tan tshul bzhin bsrung bar bya/ /dus ni yun thung rig pa'i rnam pa mang / /tshe yi tshad kyang ci tsam mi shes pas/ /ngang pas chu nang nas ni 'o ma bzhin/ /gang zhig gces pa de ni bsten par gyis/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i don la legs 'jug cing / /200

mi yi bdag pos rang nyid legs par srung ba'i tshul brtag pa/de yi 'bras bu 'dod pa'i dpal gyis bde/ /'di phyir legs pa'i chos dkar 'du byed pas/ /gtan bde thar pa'i 'bras bur longs spyod pa/ /mngon mtho nges legs rgyu 'bras phrug bzhi bo/ /sde bzhi zhes grags dam pas bsgrub bya ste/ /blo ldan bag yod gyur pa rnams la ni/ /'di 'dra'i 'bras bu shin tu rgya cher ldan/ /gang zhig mi mkhas bag med skal ngan rnams/ /shin tu yun ring 'tsho bar gyur kyang ni/ /tshe 'dir don nyams bde ba mi 'byung la/ /phyi ma'i dpal yang shin tu nyams par 'gyur/ /de phyir mi yi bdag po mkhas rnams kyis/ /sde bzhi'i 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa yi/ /dpag bsam ljon pa bskyed pa'i lag rjes kyis/ /'jig rten tha gru kun tu dge bar 'gyur/ /luṭa kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan las/ mi yi bdag po rang gis rang nyid leṭa par srung ba'i tshul brtag pa ste rab tu byed pa bcu gsum pa'o//201

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rab tu zud pha bcu bzhi ba/ yul 'khor bde bar srung ba'i tshul brtag pa/de ltar skye rgu nyer 'tsho'i gzhi/ /rgyal po rang nyid legs bsrungs nas/ /'bangs rnams bde bar bya ba'i slad/ /'tsho ba'i tshul gyis bskyang bar bya/ /sa snying 'khor lo bcu ba'i mdor/ /dpe yi tshul du legs gsung ba/ /gang gis rgyal po'i dpal thob pa'i/ /mi bdag blo dang ldan pa des/ /'das dang da lta ma 'ongs pa'i/ /rgyal po'i khrims lugs brtags byas te/ /yul der gnas pa'i mdzangs pa rnams/ /las kyi 'khor lo gsum la sbyor/ /202

yul 'khor bde bar srung ba'i tshul brtag pa/dgra thabs shes shing rtsal sbyang du/ /'jug pa rgyal srid las 'khor yin/ /zhing las dang ni gnas khang gi /bya ba slob pa gnyis pa ste/ / tshong dang bzo rnams sna tshogs kyi/ /las la sbyor ba gsum par bshad/ /las kyi 'khor lo gsum po 'dis/ /skye rgu bde bar byed pa 'o/ /gtsug lag shes dang rig byed pa/ /bzo gnas pa dang tshong khang dang / /dge sbyong dang ni bram ze rnams/ /mang bar gyur pa'i yul der bde/ /de phyir rgyal pos rang yul du/ /gtsug lag khang rnams brtsigs byas te/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rten bzhengs la/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i srol btsugs shing / /'jig rten bla ma dkon mchog gsum/ /203

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mchod cing dman la sbyin pa dang / /bsod nams bgyi ba rgyun 'dzugs pa'i/ /yul der dge legs rgya cher 'phel /rigs kyi rgan rabs rnams dang ni/ /pha dang ma dag bkur byed la/ /cha lugs rgyan dang spyod lam kun/ /ya rabs dag gi chas su bzhag /kun dga' ra ba me tog tshal/ /lha mchod dus kyi dga' ston sa/ /bro gar glu yi rig byed sogs/ /'jig rten dga' ba bskyed phyir bzhag /chu mtsho ri brag shing bzang po/ /yul gyi gzhi bdag brten pa'i gnas/ /cung zad nyams par mi bya zhing / /bkod pas brgyan la gzhag par bya/ /ri mtho sa gnyan yul bzang po/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i sa phyogs rnams/ /204

yul 'khor bde bar srung ba'i tshul brtag pa/mi bsrun rnams la rang dbang du/ /sma 'bebs byed du mi gzhug go /tshe rig shes dang dus rtsis pa /de bzhin sngags gto mo gshen sogs/ /yul la phan pa'i gsos yin pas/ /za thang bskyed la phan du gzhug /bzo gnas rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /ngo mtshar dga' ba bskyed pa dag /slob pa'i grwa btsugs tshong 'dus kyi/ /'dun sa dag kyang bca' bar bya /sra brtan go cha btsan rdzong dang / /mgyogs 'gro sna tshogs mtshon cha'i rigs/ /sgyu rtsal shes shing dpa' mdzangs kyi/ /skye bo so so'i gnas su bsags/ /blo ldan snyoms shing bsam dkar rnams/ /yul gyi spyi 'dun 'thus mir bzhag /dmag dang dmag dpon go char bcas /205

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/nam dgos 'phral du shol med bya/ /rgyal rigs dgos pa'i don rnams la/ /snga nas nyer bsdogs shes pa dag /dus su bab tshe bgyi ba ni/ /gang la'ang thogs med 'jug par nus/ /mkhas rnams rang nyid stobs ldan kyang / /bag yod sgo nas phas rgol bsrung / /blun rnams rang nyid stobs zhan kyang / /mi shes rlom bzhin dogs med gnas/ /blun pos da lta 'ba' zhig dpyod/ /mkhas pas ma 'ongs nam phugs dpyod/ /ma 'ongs pa na phan gnod gnad/ /snga nas shes na mkhas pa yin/ /char dbab pa dang gzhi bdag brngan/ /nad rims bzlog dang sa bcud gso/ / phywa g.yang 'phel ba'i thabs la sogs/ /yul rnams kun tu so sor bya/ /206

yul 'khor bde bar srung ba'i tshul brtag pa/ha cang nyams kyis mi lcogs pa'i/ /bgyi ba mang pos mi mnar bar/ /'bangs dang blo gros mthun byas nas/ /bags kyis dus su bsgrub par bya/ /ji ltar sprin chen 'khrigs pa yis/ /rgya mtsho yi ni chu drangs nas/ /sa la rgyun du phab pa yis/ /rtsi shing lo 'bras smin pa ltar/ /byams shing blo ldan rgyal pos kyang / /gnod pa med pa'i dpya khral gyis/ /'bangs rnams slar yang bskyangs byas pas/ /skye bo'i kun dga' 'phel bar byed/ /mi bsrun rkun ma g.yon can sogs/ /dus dang dus su nyul la bskrad/ /sa rnams rang dbang bsdam bya ste/ /phung krol can ni gzhug mi bya/ /rang gir byas pa'i sa phyogs su/ /207

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/tha na dud 'gror gtogs pa tshun/ /'jigs med bde bar bag phebs pa'i/ /thabs rnams rtag tu rgyal pos bya/ /glo bur lhags pa'i chas bstar dang / /dge ba'i gru zam lam 'phrang 'dzugs/ /dgra kun gcan gzan 'tshe sogs las/ /ris med skye bo dbugs dbyung bya/ /khyim sun 'byin dang rdzun rlabs kyis/ /'jig rten mgo skor byed pa sogs/ /shed bskyed mi bya gyi nar bzhag /ma rabs khram pa'i dpung mnan bya/ /sde snod mkhas dang sdom brtson ldan/ /grub pa'i rnal 'byor chos 'dzin rnams/ /yul gyi rgyan du bzhag byas te/ /rgyang nas bstod cing bkur tshul bya/ /nyam chung rnams la brtse bya zhing / /gnas min dpung shed 'phyar ba dmad/ /208

yul 'khor bde bar srung ba'i tshul brtag pa/yul khams bde bar bag phebs pa'i/ /sa der lha yang mgu ba skye/ /yul gzhan rnams su dus dus su/ /tshong dang khe yi phyir 'gro ba/ /dpung du bsdoms te mgo 'dren pa'i/ /dpon bcas bde blag dong bar bya/ /nyung ngus bsgrub na bgyid dka' zhing / /mang po bsdom na phan tshun don/ /bde blag nyid du nus rnams la/ /rgyal pos de ltar mgo bsdu bya/ /skye bo phan tshun mi 'thab par /gcig la gcig ni grogs bgyid pas/ /don mthun nyid du 'gyur ba'i thabs /'jam rtsub gang 'os de ltar sbyar/ /yul 'brog sa gnas so so ru/ /rang skal gnas kyi longs spyod la/ /mthun par spyad par bya ba las/ /209

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'dod chen phyogs lhung khrims kyis dgag /yul gyi mi rnams phan tshun du/ /dpung bsdoms rang phyogs bsrung dgos pas/ /'then 'khyer med par chabs cig tu/ /yul gyi so kha bsrung bar bya/ /dge sbyong dag dang bram ze ni/ /rgyal po'i rtsa bar gsungs pas na/ /dge 'dun 'du ba'i sgo sogs kyis/ /dge 'dun sde rnams bskyang bar bya /yul dus de la der 'tshams pa'i/ /skye bo'i bde thabs gang mchis pa/ /yul gyi bdag pos mgo bsdus nas/ /ji ltar phan pa bka' stsal bya/ /'bangs kyi skye bo 'phel ba dang / /bde ba'i thabs la nan tan bsam/ / rang la dbang ba'i mi gcig kyang / /god par mi bya gser bzhin btsa'/ /210

yul 'khor bde bar srung ba'i tshul brtag pa/skye bo phal cher rmongs pa yis /rang don phra mo'ang bsgrub mi nus/ /mi shes rnams la slob byed phyir/ /rgyal po pha dang 'dra ba yin/ /skye bo phal cher zhum pa yis/ /brtson pas phongs par gyur pa rnams/ /las la bskul zhing sna 'dren pas/ /rgyal po ded dpon 'dra ba yin/ /skye bo phal cher sbrul gdug bzhin/ /gzhan la 'tshe zhing gdul dka' la/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis 'dul byed pas/ /rgyal po sngags mkhan 'dra ba yin/ /rtag tu rang gi 'bangs rnams la/ /snying rje'i bsam pa nyer bzhag ste/ /bde thabs 'ba' zhig la brtson pas/ /rgyal po ma dang 'dra ba yin/ /yul khams de yi bde sdug dang / /211

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/skyon yon rnam pa sna tshogs la/ /'dri zhing dpyod pa lhur len pa/ /rgyal po rtog chen 'dra ba yin/ /'jigs pa can la dbugs 'byin zhing / /sdug bsngal can la phan 'dogs byed/ /re ltos can la dga' bgyid pas/ /rgyal po dpag bsam shing dang 'dra/ /blang dang dor bya'i dngos po ston/ /tshul dang tshul min rnam par 'byed/ /yang dag lam la 'dren byed phyir/ /rgyal po mig dang 'dra ba yin/ /rang gi dpal gyis phyogs kun tu/ /legs par brgyan par byas nas su/ /'khor gyi skye rgu dga' byed pa/ /rgyal po rin chen gter dang 'dra/ /phas kyi rgol bas mi tshugs shing / /ris su gtogs rnams bag phebs la/ /212

yul 'khor bde bar srung ba'i tshul brtag pa/'gran zla'i tshogs kun spa bkong bas/ /rgyal po rdo rje'i rdzong chen 'dra/ /bsod nams stobs kyis mngon mtho zhing / /rgyab rten lha dang srung mas brjid/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba yi/ /rgyal po rin chen rgyal mtshan bzhin/ /de ltar mi bdag yon tan mchog mnga' ba/ /sum rtsen gnas su bgrod par ma byas kyang / /gdong ba bzhi ldan lha yi rgyal po bzhin/ /bdud rtsi'i zas can rnams kyang dga' bas 'du/ /bum bzang dpag bsam nor bu'i rgyal pos kyang / /'gran par mi bzod mi bdag rin po che/ /gang gi dpal gyis mtho ris dpal mtha' dag /rang gi lag na gnas pa bzhin du spyod/ /dpal dang gzi brjid snyan par grags pa'i sgra/ /rgya mtsho'i khor yug tu yang 'gro byed cing / /sa steng 'di na nyi ma gnyis pa bzhin/ /213
mtshungs med yon tan dpal gyis lham mer 'gyur/ /lugs kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan las/ yul 'khor bde bar srung ba'i tshul brtag pa ste rab tu byed pa bcu bzhi ba'o//

gros brtag pa/rab tu zud pa bco lja ba/ spos brtag pa/yul gyi skye bo bde thabs dang / /lugs bzang khrims kyi bya ba sogs/ /yid rton pa yi skye bo dang / /lhan cig gros kyis bsgrubs na legs/ /bye brag phyed pa'i blo yod kyang / /bya ba gros kyis bsgrub par bya/ /'grub 'gyur kho nar ma zad kyi/ /ma grub na yang mdzes pa yin/ /thog mar brtag dpyod byed pa'i tshe/ /gros su 'os pa'i blon lta ci/ /bsam yod gzhan gyis smras pa la'ang / /rigs dang mi rigs rang gis dpyad/ /blo rgya chung ba'i gros log dang / /rang 'dod phug bcug 'khyog po'i gros/ /215

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/phyi mtha' ma brtags spyi brtol ngag /spobs pa zhan pa'i zhum tshig dang / /blo gros che bas gnad bkrol tshig /rang 'dod ma 'dres bsam dkar ngag /phyi mtha' gzhal nas brjod pa'i gtam/ /mi zhan spobs pa bskyed pa'i tshig /so sor ma 'dres shes byas la/ /ngang pas chu las 'o ma bzhin/ /don dang ldan pa'i gtam bzung ste/ /gros thag blo ldan rang gis gcod/ /'jug ldog rang gis shes na yang / /rgyal khams bya ba gros kyis brtag /thams cad mthun par gros byas pa'i/ /bya ba gang byung 'gyod med nyid/ /snyigs dus g.yon pos g.yon bkab ste/ /mthun par smras nas rje bo bslu/ /ra skyes 'khrid pa'i bram ze la/ /216

gros brtag pa/rkun pos khyi ru btags dang mtshungs/ /de bas rje dpon mkhas pa rnams/ /g.yon can zhen phyogs shes byas nas/ /gzhan dring mi 'jog blo thob na/ /sa bdag khrims la mkhas par 'gyur/ /bden zhing brling na yid rton bya/ /rtag tu yid mi ches pa yi/ /skyes bu bya rog khu 'phrig can/ /de la blo ldan gros mi ston/ /bye brag 'byed pa'i blo ldan la/ /dris na rang nyid dpal thob ste/ /stobs ldan dga' byed kyis kyang ni/ /ha nu man+d+ra grogs su bkug /rgyun du bsod nams ldan pa dang / /stobs ldan dag la bsten na bzang / /mchil bas mkha' lding la sbran pas/ /rgya mtsho'i klu rnams skrag par byas /217

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bya ba'i cha la rmongs gyur pa / /blo dang ldan pa'i gros kyis 'byed/ /chu bo rnyog mar gyur pa rnams/ /chu dwangs nor bus sel bar byed/ /rang nyid blo dang ldan na yang / /bgros na sngon med blo gros 'byung / /grong gi skye bo'i tshig mnyan pas/ /gsal rgyal g.yul las rgyal ba bzhin/ /legs par brtag dpyod ma byas na/ /smras pa 'ga' las nyes pa 'byung / /khyu mchog dang ni seng ge gnyis/ /shin tu mthun pa wa yis brlag /nam phugs rang don ma gzhal bar/ /skyes bus gang bstabs len mi bya/ /bag gsar bstabs pa'i bkur snyi yis/ /tha mar stong thub nyams la ltos/ /blo can rnams kyis rdzu bag gis/ /218

gros brtag pa/grung po'ang mgo bo gdugs ltar bskor/ /khyab 'jug mi'u thung gzugs brdzus nas/ /stobs ldan sa yi 'og tu bcings/ /blo gros mchog dang ldan pa na/ /blo ldan yin yang pham par nus/ /phyag rgya lnga ldan khyab 'jug kyang / /legs ldan nag po'i thabs kyis bkol/ /de phyir bya ba gang la yang / /thabs mkhas ldan pa'i gros kyis 'grupa/ /sprel dmag mang du tshogs pa yis /rgya mtsho la yang zam pa btsugs/ /lcam pa nyi ma'i phyogs su 'dud/ /chu shing 'brug sgra bsgrags na skye/ /phan pa'i grogs dang phan pa'i gros/ /gang nas 'byung ba'i nges pa med/ /'bod sgrog chung ma'i don du bsad/ /laṅka'i grong khyer spre'us bsregs/ /219

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gnod pa'i grogs dang ngan pa'i gros/ /gang nas 'byung bar cha med nyid/ /de slad blo dang ldan rnams kyis/ /mi 'os grogs dang gros spangs nas/ /'os pa'i grogs dang gros bsten na/ /dpal las nyams par mi 'gyur ro/ /mi reng dbul pos su la bgros/ /gnyis tshogs phan chad gros la ltos/ /rgyal khams chen po'i bya ba phal/ /gros la ma ltos 'grub par dka'/ /su la'ang gros su ma byas na/ /'khor tshogs rgyu skar ltar mang yang / /sus kyang rje bo glen pa de/ /nyam thag gnas las bslang mi nus/ /mang po bsdoms nas gros byas na/ /chen po yis kyang thub par dka'/ /srog chags grog ma'i tshogs 'dus nas/ /220

gros brtag pa/seng ge'i phru gu bsad ces grags/ /rang sde bsrung bar 'dod pa dang / /gzhan sde gzhom par 'dod na'ang / /mang po dag gi dpung bsgril te/ /gros su bya ba mkhas pas bsngags/ /pha ma bzhin du sems brtse yang / /gros med pa na skyes bu de'i/ /'dod don ji ltar sgrub pa yi/ / tshul rnams gzhan gyis ji ltar shes/ /skye bo kun rtog sna tshogs phyir/ /mi rigs pa yi bya ba la'ang / /gros mthun 'gyur ba rnyed sla na/ /'os pa'i gros la lta ci smos/ /gros mthun gyur rnams bya ba la/ /nye 'am rgyang na gnas kyang rung / /rang don bzhin du 'jug pa'i phyir/ /bya ba chen po gros kyis bsgrub/ /221

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gros kyi nang nas grogs 'byung zhes/ /gna' rabs mkhas pa'i gtam las bsgrags/ /thog mar gros su mi byed par/ /tha mar 'gyod pa blun po'i mtshang / /legs par bgros na legs pa'i blo skye zhing / /don gyi bgyi bar kun kyang don mthun pas/ /dka' ba'i gnas kyang dka' ba med 'grub phyir/ /'khor mang ldan rnams 'khor la cis mi bgro/ /don chen bya ba gros med tshig tsam gyis/ /drang srong dmod pa bzhin du su yis 'grub/ /thag chod 'os pa'i gnas la gros med kyang / /sa bdag rnams kyi tshig gis 'grub par 'gyur/ /de phyir mi dbang blo dang ldan rnams kyis/ /rang gi bgyi bar 'khor gyi tshogs bsdus te/ /legs par dpyod cing gros su byas pa na/ /pha rol stobs dang ldan kyang gnod mi nus/ /skye bo mang po mthu dang dpung bsgril te/ /222

gros brtag pa/'os pa'i bya bar gros mthun zhugs gyur na/ /yid la ji ltar brnags pa'i don de dag /khab len rdo yis lcags bzhin 'gugs par nus/ /lugs kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan las/ gros brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa ste bco lnga ba'o//

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rab tu byed pa bcu drug pa/ dge bcu'i tshas dang ldan pa'i tshul brtag pa/rgyal po rang nyid khrims ldan pas/ /'khor la khrims su byas na mjes/ /rang nyid khrims las 'das spyod na/ /skye rgu'i dpang por ga la 'os/ /rgyu 'bras rten 'brel mi bslu ba/ /'jig rten kun gyi spyi khrims te/ /rgyu 'bras log par spyod rnams la/ /chad pa ngan song sdug bsngal yin/ /rgyal pos chos bzhin ma byas na/ /tshe 'dir grags pa ngan pa dang / /rgyal srid dag kyang 'jig 'gyur bas/ /rang nyid dge bcu'i khrims ldan bya/ /224

dge bcu'i chos dang ldan pa'i tshul brtag pa/mi dge bcu bo gang gis kyang / /ngan song gsum du 'khrid byed cing / /mtho ris dag tu skyes na yang / /rgyu mthun 'bras bu mi bzad myong / /skye rgu kun la srog phangs pas /rgyal pos srog gcod yongs su spang / /srog gcod tshe thung nad mang byed/ /de bas rgyal po'i yul khams su/ /bya dang ri dwags tshun chad la/ /'tshe ba ci nus bzlog par bya/ /ljongs de'i mi dang dud 'gro rnams/ /'jigs med srog gi skyabs bya 'o/ /gal te mang po'i don gyi phyir/ /gdul dka'i mi bsrun gzhan du bskrad/ /cis kyang thabs kyis mi 'chos na/ /skye rgu'i phung sel byed pa rnams/ /bsad na rgyal khams bde zhes pa/ / 225

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rtsod dus rgyal po'i lugs la yod/ / 'on kyang snying rje'i bsam pa ni/ /nam yang gtang bar mi bya 'o/ /rang gi 'byor pas chog shes nas/ /mi 'os gzhan nor 'phrog mi bya/ /ma byin blangs pas dbul 'gyur zhing / /rang gi longs spyod gzhan gyis 'khyer/ /'os pa'i dpya dang rigs pa yis/ /nor gyi chad pa len na yang / /nor la nyes pa'i 'du shes bzhag /brkam chags che bar yong mi bya/ /rang 'dod gdug pas ma bslad par/ /rgyal khams bde ba'i don gyi phyir/ /'tshe dang ma byin len kho nas/ /rgyal po sdom min can mi 'gyur/ /rang gi btsun mor dgyes byas nas/ /gzhan la log par g.yem mi bya/ /226

dge bcu'i chos dang ldan pa'i tshul brtag pa/log g.yem gyis ni 'khor mi bsrun/ /'gran zlar bcas pa'i chung mar 'gyur/ /rtag tu bden par smra ba ni/ /chos dang ldan pa'i yon tan mchog / rdzun smras pas ni skur ba mang / /gzhan gyis rang nyid bslu bar 'gyur/ /pha rol dbye bar byed pa yi/ /phra ma spangs nas bsdum par bya/ /phra mas rang gi 'khor mi 'dum/ /'thab byed 'khor ngan 'thob par 'gyur/ /mi bdag rtag tu tshig 'jam zhing / /snyan par smra la nan tan bya/ / tshig rtsub smras pas 'thab mo dang / /yid du mi 'ong gtam thos 'gyur/ /don med kyal ba rnam spangs nas/ /ji skad smras bzhin don ldan brjod/ /ngag 'khyal smras pas tshig mi btsun/ /227

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/spobs pa ma nges can du 'gyur/ /gzhan 'byor che'am chung yang rung / /brnab sems mi bya dga' bar bya/ /brnab sems yid la re ba 'joms/ /'dod chen chog mi shes par 'gyur/ /gzhan la gnod pa'i sems spangs te/ /kun la byams pa'i sems su bya/ /gnod sems kyis ni zug rngu mang / /gzhan gyis don med gnod pa 'byung / /las dang 'bras bu med lta ba'i/ /log par lta ba rtsad nas spang / /log par lta ba ma spangs na/ /skye gzhan lta ngan sgyu can 'gyur/ /lta ba ngan pas bslad pa la/ /sa bon tshig pa'i myu gu bzhin/ /dkar po'i chos rnams mi skye zhing / /yang dag lta ba chos kun gzhi/ /228

dge bcu'i chos dang ldan pa'i tshul brtag pa/ri gzar po yi 'bab chu bzhin/ /'tsho ba yun thung ring mi gnas/ /'jig rten pha rol 'gro 'gyur bas/ /bag yod bgyis te phyi mar bsam /las 'bras nam yang mi bslu bas/ /chung yang don med chud mi za/ /rang gis gang byas rang la smin/ /'di la sus kyang 'da' ba med/ /de phyir chos min rgyal srid la/ /gnas rnams dmyal ba'i sta gon yin/ /chos dang ldan pa'i rgyal srid ni/ /lha gnas bgrod pa'i them skas yin/ /rgyal po rgyal rigs skyes pa rnams/ /skye bo'i tshogs la dbang bas na/ /dge bcu'i las kyi lam dag la / /kun kyang ci nus gzhug par bya/ /srog bskyab pa dang sbyin pa gtong / /229

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/log g.yem dgag cing rdzun sogs gcod/ /gzhan 'byor rnams la yi rang zhing / /byams dang yang dag lta ba sgom/ /dpya len pa dang chad las sogs/ /'os pas skye rgu bskyangs byas te/ /snying rje'i sems dang thabs mkhas par/ /byas na nyes med dge yang srid/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba bsdoms byas nas/ /bla med byang chub don gnyer na/ /'jig rten tshul dang mi 'gal zhing / /dam pa'i lam las mi 'da' la/ /chos bzhin skye rgu legs skyong bas/ /don gnyis bsgrub la stobs ldan phyir/ /rgyal sras sems dpa' che rnams kyang / /rgyal po'i tshul du ston par mdzad/ /pha ma dge sbyong bram ze sogs/ /bkur zhing mchog gsum mchod pa dang / /230

dge bcu'i chos dang ldan pa'i tshul brtag pa/'di dang phyi ma'i sdug bsngal rgyun/ / 'gog pa'i thabs rnams rgyal pos bya/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol tu/ /bde ba'i thabs tshal rnam mang po'i/ /stosrol la skye rgu 'dzud byed pa/ /chos ldan rgyal po yin shes bya/ /lugs kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan las/ dge bcu'i chos dang ldan pa'i tshul brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa ste bcu drug pa'o//231

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rab tu zud pa bcu bdun pa/ chos kyi rgyal dzo'i khrims brtag pa/rang nyid chos dang ldan byas la/ /gzhan la dge bcu'i khrims bsdoms pa/ /chos kyi rgyal po chen po zhes/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis legs par bsngags/ /mi dge bcu bo dug 'dra ste/ /'dir gnod phyi ma sdug bsngal kyang / /zhe 'dod lag len 'gal rnams la/ /chos rgyal rnams kyis khrims su mdzad/ /mi gsod pa dang nor rku dang / /chung ma 'phrog dang byi byed dang / /rdzun gyis bslu dang phra mas 'byed/ /don med rtsub mo'i tshig gis gcod/ /232

chosakyitsholapo'ikhrims brtag pa/'di dag gnod tshabs che chung dang / /sngar gyi lan skyon yod med sogs/ /nyes pa'i 'os dang bstun nas su/ /chad pa'i las kyis dgag par bya/ /rags pa'i nyes pa rnam bkag pas/ /phra ba yid kyi nyes pa rnams/ /shugs kyis mthu ni med byas pas/ /dge bcu'i khrims su bcas zhes bya/ /sems can spyi la 'tshe ba dang / /dkon mchog gsum la gnod pa dang / /rgyal po'i chus la gzan pa dang / /rgyal khams mi bde byed pa rnams/ /mthu ldan rgyal pos bkag byas na/ /rgyal khams spyi dang bye brag bde/ /chos ldan rgyal po med gyur na/ /rgyal khams bde ba'i thabs gzhan dka'/ /sngar dus mi rnams khrel yod tshe/ /233

kyilegs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dngul gyi dong tse gcig brkus kyang / /srog la bab pa'i chad las kyi/ /khrims byas de ltar rkun ma nyung / /deng sang shin tu gdul dka'i dus/ /de tsam nyes pas srog bkums na/ /yul 'khor stong la thug par mchi de bas yul dus sbyar ba yi/ /khrims kyi zhal lce gcod lugs rnams/ /sngon byung rgyal po mkhas rnams kyi/ /bka' khrims bzhin du 'tshams par sbyar/ /khrims zhes bya ba phyogs lhung med/ /drang po gnam gyi thig yin pas/ /las 'bras mngon sum ston pa dang / /'dra phyir sus kyang bsgyur du med/ /'gal na rgyal po'i bu yang pham bsrungs na grong gi dbul po rgyal/ /klad par gnam lcags bab pa ltar/ /234

chos kyi rgyal po'i khrims brtag pa/mi 'khur dbang med khrims zhes bya/ /stobs 'byor yod na yang 'gyur la/ /khas zhan dbul por lcid 'gyur ba/ /de 'dra rgyal khrims ma yin te/ /'phyon ma'i gar gyi lta phyogs mtshungs/ /smad 'tshong gzugs kyis 'tsho ba ste/ /dge sbyong chos kyis 'tsho ba yin/ /rgyal rigs khrims kyis 'tsho ba ste/ /bram ze cho rigs bsrung bas 'tsho/ /rang rang 'tsho ba de nyams na/ /chos gzhan gang gis mi skyob ste/ /srog gi dbang po 'gags pa na/ /dbang po gzhan gyis bskyab bam ci /rgyal po zhes pa'i ming de yang / / khrims kyi bdag por byas pas thob/ /khrims ni lugs bzhin mi gcod na/ /rgyal po yod kyang med dang mtshungs/ /235

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ rang nyid khrims bdag gyur pa na/ /dgra la'ang khrims ni lugs bzhin gcod/ /gnod pa byed kyang dus gzhan bya/ /mkhas pa'i khrims la nye ring med/ /khrims yod pa yi sa phyogs su/ /chos bzhin byed rnams bag phebs la/ /chos min byed rnams bag yod 'gyur/ /khrims bzang 'jig rten mgon dang skyabs/ /nyes pa can la 'os pa yi /chad pas bcad pa thos na yang / /skye bo bzang rnams dbugs 'byin cing / /ngan pa rnams kyang skrag par 'gyur/ /nyes can chad pa med thos tshe/ /ya rabs rnams kyang bag za zhing / /ma rabs rnams la bag med sgo/ /'byed pa'i nyer bsdogs bzhin du 'gyur/ /nyes med chad pas bcad thos na/ /236

chos kyi rgyal po'i khrims brtag pa/bzang po rnams kyang yi chad cing / /rgyal po g.yon can tha chad ces/ /lha gnas su yang mi snyan sgrogs/ /nyes med nyes par ma sbyar na/ /nyes med de yi rgyus shes rnams/ /rgyal po'i bsngags pa rjod byed la/ /lha dang bcas pa yi rang 'gyur/ /gzhan gyi srog la 'tshe ba rnams/ /rang gi lus la dpe byas te/ /brdung dang brdeg pa'i tshul sogs kyis/ /phyin chad sdig rgyun bzlog par bya/ /gzhan gyi nor la rku ba rnams/ /'jal dang stong gis bsab bya zhing / /chung ma bran sogs 'phrog pa yang / /de de'i tshul gyis dgag par bya/ /rgyal po ha cang des drags na/ /mi bsrun pa dang rkun po 'phel/ /237

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rgyal khams ma rungs gang 'gyur bas/ /rgyal po snying rje ldan na yang / /mi bsrun rnams la ci 'os pa'i/ /chad pa dus su legs bcad cing / /nyam thag srog chags snying rje'ang bgyid/ /ces pa bden smra'i mdo las gsungs/ /sa snying 'khor lo bcu ba'i mdor/ /tshangs chen lha yi snying po la/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /bstan la dad pas rab byung nas/ /skra dang kha spu bregs byas te/ /ngur smrig tshal bu gyon pa gang / /tshul khrims ldan nam 'chal yang rung / /de la lha dang mi dang ni/ /lha ma yin la sogs pa yi/ /khyim pa'i tshul dang 'dra bar ni/ /dman par sbyar du'ang mi gnang na/ /238

chos kyi rgyal po'i khrims brtag pa/de la lcag gis gzhu ba dang / /dbyug pas brdeg cing btson du 'ching / /gshe dang spyo dang lus gcod dang / /gsod par byed pa lta ci smos/ /tshul ldan mang thos ci smos kyi/ /rab tu byung nas tshul nyams te/ /mi dge spyod pas khong rul ba/ /dge sbyong min la dge sbyong du/ /khas 'che ma rungs pa de yang / /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis/ /mchod 'os yon tan gter du 'gyur/ /ston pa'i cha lugs 'chang tsam yang / /mthong bas ston dang tshul khrims sogs/ /rjes su dran pa'i yon tan 'byung / /tshul nyams mi ro lta bu zhes/ /gsungs kyang khyu mchog shi ba la/ /gi waṃ dang ni gla ba'i ror/ /239

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gla rtsi yod pa ji bzhin du/ /yon tan lhag ma'i mthu yod phyir/ /de la nan tur bya dgos na/ /dge 'dun mthun pas bskrad bya yi/ /rgyal po dang ni blon po'am/ /dpang po dag gis sangs rgyas la/ /skyabs song cha lugs 'chang tsam yang /gzhu ba dang ni 'tshog pa sogs/ /chad pas gcad par mi rung ste/ /mtshams med lnga byas mi gang zhig /rdzun gyis rab byung cha lugs su/ /gnas pa de la'ang rgyal po yis/ /gzhu zhing 'tshog pa sogs ma gnang / /ma 'ongs rgyal rigs gdol spyod can/ /chos ldan dge sbyong mi bkur bas/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung smod byed/ /de la lha rnams khros nas su/ /240
