chos kyi rgyal po'i khrims brtag pa/yal bar 'bor bar byed par 'gyur/ /chos ldan skyo nas gzhan du byer/ /phyi dang nang gi 'khrug pa 'byung / /yul der sdug bsngal rnam mang zhing / /rgyal srid nyams shing nad sogs 'byung / /shi nas ngan song 'gro bar 'gyur/ /dge sbyong sdig spyod rgyal po yi/ /pho nya byed pas sna drangs nas/ /ma 'ongs rgyal blon gdol spyod rnams/ /dge sbyong nor dang mchod rten dkor/ /dkon mchog rdzas la bag med spyod/ /shin tu mi bzad nyes pa des/ /tshe 'dir gso dka'i nad byung nas/ /dmyal bar yun ring 'tshed par 'gyur/ /sngon tshe ngur smrig gos gyon pas/ /glang por dug mdas bsnun na yang / /glang po'i dbang pos 'di skad du/ /241

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'di dag bslu ba'i sems yod kyang / /cha lugs sangs rgyas slob ma 'dra/ /'tsho ba'i srog dang bral kyang bla'i/ /sdig pa'i sems ni bskyed mi rigs/ /zhe sa brjod byol song skyes pas kyang / /cha lugs tsam la de ltar dga'/ /ma 'ongs rgyal rigs gdol pa can/ /sangs rgyas rjes 'jug 'tshe byed pa/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas bka' lung dang / /'gal ba nyid du gyur pas na/ /dmyal ba chen por gzhol bar 'gyur/ /sngon tshe rgyal por gyur pa ni/ /dgra las rgyal zhes bya ba yis/ /mi zhig gsad par bya ba'i phyir/ /dur khrod srin mo'i gnas btang tshe/ /skra bregs ngur smrig tshal bu zhig /mgul du btags pa de mthong nas/ /242

chos kyi rgyal po'i khrims brtag pa/lnga stong 'khor gyis bskor ba yi/ /srin mo mtshon cha'i mig sogs kyis/ /bste stang bcas te thal sbyar btud/ /rang gi bu rnams la smras pa/ /sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i bye snyed kyi/ /rnam grol rgyal mtshan gos gyon pa/ /'di la mi dge'i sems bskyed na/ /mtshams med dmyal bar nges par ltung / /zhes smras srin mo mang po yis/ /mi de btang bar gyur pa dang / / de tshul rgyal po la bsnyad pas/ /rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /ngo mtshar rmad du byung gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas slob ma tshul ldan nam/ /tshul nyams tha na cha lugs tsam/ /'chang la kyal ka tsam du yang / /phyin chad gnod pa mi bya ba'i/ /243

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/khrims su bsgrags par byas gyur to/ /yi dwags srin mo gdug pas kyang / /ngur smrig 'dzin pa mchod byed na/ /ma 'ongs yul bdag mi bsrun pa/ /srin po las kyang gdug sems can/ /glen zhing gti mug gyur rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas rjes su zhugs rnams la/ /mi bkur gshe brdeg gnod pa byed/ /de phyir rab byung nor phrogs sam/ /gshe dang chad pas mnar byed na/ /dkon mchog gsum la dga' ba yi/ /lha rnams gzhan du phyogs 'gyur zhing / /chad pas gcod pa'i yul khams der/ /mi bde mang zhing rgyal po la/ /mi bzad nad ni sna tshogs 'byung / /til mar 'tshir dang smad 'tshong dang / /chang 'tshong shan pa'i gnas rnams ni/ /244

chos kyi rgyal po'i khrims brtag pa/bcu 'gyur 'gres kyi sdig lci ba/ /sdig pa mi bzad de las kyang / /rgyal po gdol can nyes che zhing / /shin tu smad pa'i gnas su mdzad/ /rgyal pos ngur smrig 'dzin pa dag /bsrungs par byas na dkon mchog la/ /mchod pa rgya chen nyid 'gyur phyir/ /yon tan bsngags pa bgrang las 'das/ /zhes gsungs 'di dang cha mtshungs su/ /nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo la sogs/ /mdo sde rnams su ston pa yis/ /rab byung chad pas bcad pa bkag /sangs rgyas rjes su zhugs pa rnams/ /chad pas bcad na bsod nams mthu/ /nyams nas rgyal srid 'jig pa yi/ /rtsa ba dag tu gsungs pas na/ /snyigs dus rab tu byung rnams kyang / /245

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/shin tu mi bsrun mang ba'i phyir/ /dge 'dun mthun pa'i chos khrims kyis/ /mi thub rgyal pos 'dul dgos pa/ /du ma mchis par 'gyur na yang / /rgyal po mkhas shing don ldan pas/ /ston pa'i bka' 'di dran byas nas/ /so so'i 'dus sde'i khrims la sbyar/ /dge 'dun mthun pas sbyang du gzhug /des kyang khas len ma btub na/ /dge 'dun dang bcas ston pa'i bka'/ /dpang por byas la rgyal po yis/ /dge 'dun rnams la bka' sbyar nas/ /gnas nas dbyung ba la sogs bya/ /dge 'dun dag las phrogs pa'i nor/ /dge 'dun gsos su slar sbyin bya/ /de ltar byas na ston pa yi/ /bstan pa gces par byas nas su/ /246

chos kyi rgyal po'i khrims brtag pa/mchod cing rjed par byas pa ste/ /bstan la gnod par 'gyur ma yin/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa mi nyams phyir/ /khyim pa sun 'byin skye bo rnams/ /bsal zhing chos kyi khrims bsdoms pa/ /chos ldan chos kyi rgyal po yin/ /de 'dra'i rgyal pos dus gsum gyi/ /dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed cing / /de yi bsod nams dpal dang gzis/ /rgyal khams bde bas khyab par 'gyur/ /rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing ni/ /sus kyang 'da' bar mi nus pas/ /skye rgu kun gyi phrag pa la/ /lci zhes bya bar bshad pa ste/ /ya rabs lugs dang ldan pa dag /rang bzhin bzang po'i lam gnas la/ /nam yang khrims chad mi 'bab pas/ /247

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/de dag rnams la yang zhes bya/ /khrims ni skye rgu bde thabs te/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis de nyid la/ /khur du lci bar mi 'dzin zhing / /bgyi bar dka' ba med phyir ro/ /de phyir rang don gyis bzhag pa'i/ /'os min khrims su ma bcas pas/ /lugs dang mthun pa'i khrims de ni/ /ya rabs rnams la shin tu yang / /skye rgu las kyis mnar rnams la/ /tshe 'dir rang gis nyes byas kyis/ /khrims 'di khur du lci ba yi/ /tshul du sems pa rang skyon yin/ /mi dge'i las lam 'jug rnams la/ /tshe 'dir rgyal po'i khrims las ni/ /brgya stong 'gyur du lhag pa yi/ /rnam smin myong ba rang gis byas/ /248

chos kyi rgyal po'i khrims brtag pa/de phyir lugs dang mthun pa yi/ /rgyal khrims lci la yang zhes bya/ /de 'dra'i rgyal khrims yod pa'i phyogs/ /skye bo mtha' dag bde ba yin/ /snyigs dus rgyal rigs mi bsrun rnams/ /gzugs 'tshong sdud dang spog gtad dang / /rngon bkye snyad 'tshol nor 'phrog dang / /tshul min las la sbyar nas su/ /'os med dpya dang las khral sogs/ /cung zad 'das la'ang cher mnar ba/ /ya rabs ma rabs su la'ang / /lngi phyir khrims lugs min shes bya/ /chos khrims dar gyi mdud pa ni/ /dam zhing lhod pa'ang de 'dra ste/ /'di phyir bde ba chos kyi khrims/ /dam na rang rgyud grol bar byed/ /gang zhig lhod cing bag med pa/ /249

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/de ni 'ching ba mi bzad brgyas/ /shin tu dam por bcing ba de/ /lhod por byed pa chos khrims yin/ /de phyir ya rabs dam pa rnams/ /chos kyi khrims 'dis lhod pa'am/ /bde bar bag phebs byed na yang / /'chal ba rnams kyis dam por mthong / /tshul mthun gtsug lag zung gi khrims/ /ya rabs rnams la gnyen dang 'dra/ /ma rabs rnams la dgra 'dra yang / /khrims kyi skyon min rang skyon yin/ /de slad rgyal po mchog rnams kyis/ /gtsug lag zung dang mi mthun pa/ /rang 'dod gdug pas bzhag pa yi/ /khrims rnams dug bzhin spang bar bya/ /'di phyir phan dang bde ba yi/ /lugs zung khrims tshul legs bskyangs na/ /250

chos kyi rgyalapo'ikhrimasabartagapa/ — rgyal po rang gi bde 'byor dang / /snyan grags 'bad med lhun gyis 'grub/ /gang zhig 'jig rten tshul dang dam pa'i lam/ /ma nyams legs par srol du 'dzud pa yi/ /khrims bzang nyi zla'i kha lo bsgyur nus pa/ /mi bdag bsod nams rlung gi shugs stobs can/ /rgyu skar lam gyi 'khor lo ji bzhin du/ /sa steng skye rgu'i spyi bor mngon mdzes shing / /lugs bzang lhun po'i phrag par rtag gnas te/ /sa rnams kun tu phan bde'i snang ba 'gyed/ /lugs kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan las/ chos kyi rgyal po'i khrims brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa ste bcu bdun pa'o//251

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rab tu zud dze+e bco brgyad pa/ thabs la mkhas pha'i sgo nas pyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i tshul brtag pa/de ltar bde bar 'tsho dang khrims kyis ni/ /rang gi skye rgu legs par bskyang ba yis/ /stobs dang bsod nams 'khor 'bangs snyan grags bzhi/ /phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du 'phel gyur pa/ /mi yi bdag po gnod sbyin dbang po dang / /mtshungs par bsngags 'os thabs la mkhas pa des/ /sa rnams ma lus dbang du byed 'gyur zhing / /mtha' dag phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar nus/ /sa skyong thabs la mkhas pa rnams/ /stobs shes pa dang dus shes shing / / 252

thabs mkhas sgo nas phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i tshul brtag pa/bya ba'i thabs kyang shes pa yis/ /don rnams bde blag 'grub par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid stobs 'byor ldan pa'i tshe/ /mdza' ba mang 'gyur dgra mi 'byung / /'khon rnying zhe la yod rnams kyang / /thal mo sbyar zhing phan tshun ston/ /bdag nyid dmas par gyur pa'i tshe /'khon med gyur kyang dgra ldang mang / /de bas dgra bo gzhom 'dod na/ /thog mar bdag gi stobs bskyed bya/ /blo dang brtson pa'i stobs ldan na/ /pha rol gnon la dka' ba ci/ /sgra ngan dpung tshogs bcu gnyis po/ /skya bseng bu yis bcom pa bzhin/ /stobs med gyur kyang shes rab kyis/ /srung mkhas gyur na gnod mi nus/ /ri bong gis ni glang chen tshogs/ /253

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bskrad cing seng ge bsad pa bzhin/ /rang gi phyogs kyi stobs chung la/ /dgra phyogs stobs dang ldan pa'i tshe/ /brgal zhing rtsod par mi bya bar/ /kha rog 'dug dang bde ba 'thob/ /gzhan gyi yul na gnas pa dang / /gzhan pa'i zas kyis 'tsho ba'i tshe/ /brnyas thabs byed kyang bzod par bya/ /rtsod na rang nyid sma 'bebs 'thob /dgra bo'i blo dang nus pa dang / /dus bab mthu ni rtogs byas te/ /blo ldan rnams kyis dus min par/ /'thab cing rtsod par mi bya 'o/ /bya ba gang dang ci bsgrub kyang / /dus su bab na dka' ba med/ /dus shes pa ni 'jug pa dang / /ldog pa'i gnas la rmongs mi 'gyur/ /254

— thabasamakhas sgo nas phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i tshul brtag pa/drang srong che rnams kyis bshad pa'i/ /skar nag rtsis dang dbyangs 'char gzhung / /mi shes bya ba rtsom byed pa/ /long ba nags su rgyu dang mtshungs/ /dus dang dus min mi shes la/ /mig dang 'dra ba'i gdams ngag rnams/ /rtsod dus skye bo rmongs pa yis/ /gal chung byed pa kye ma 'khrul/ /rten 'brel ltas kyi rnam pa dang / /mgon mdzad lha yi brda rtags las/ /bsod nams ldan pa'i mi rnams kyis/ /dus su bya ba rtsom par byed/ /kha cig rjes su bzung bas te/ /gzhan dag tshar gcod pa yis 'dul/ /thabs la mkhas na skyes bu des/ /tshegs chung bya bas don kun 'grub/ /brkam chags can ni nor gyis bslu/ /255

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/khengs la thal mo sbyar bas te/ /blun po rjes su mthun pas so/ /tha mal pa ni zas skom gyis/ /dman la cung zad byin pas kyang / /lha dang drang srong skyes bu mchog /mkhas pa rnams ni bden pas mgu/ /mi rnams yid ni gang yin pa/ /shes nas de mthun spyod pa yis/ /pha rol yid ni drangs byas na/ /rlung gis shing bal ji bzhin du/ /gar 'dod 'khrid la dka' ba med/ /ji srid 'jigs pa ma byung ba/ /de srid 'jigs la 'jigs par bya /'jigs pa mngon sum byung ba ni/ /'jigs med tshul gyis gzhom par bya/ /blo gros che ldan khro ba'i shugs las rgyal/ /skye bo ngan pa khro ba'i mod la pham/ /256

thabs mkhas sgo nas phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i tshul brtag pa/pham pas pham par byas pa'i blo ngan dag /blo ldan dag dang lhan cig ci phyir 'gran/ /btung na chu bzhin 'jam mnyen 'khril chags la/ /sbar na me bzhin 'tshig par nus pa gang / /mtshan ldan skyes bu'i ngang tshul 'di mthong tshe/ /mtshan nyid med pa'i mi rnams bzhad gad rgyu/ /sa gzhi bzhin du snying stobs brtan la yangs /brtson pa dus mtha'i rlung ltar drag g.yo ba/ /gang la rgol bar byed pa'i dgra bo rnams/ /thal ba'i gong bu bzhin du 'jig par byed/ /rang nyid rtag tu drang po'i lam la gnas/ /bden pa'i stobs kyis lha rnams mgu byed cing / /tshul min rgol ba'i gnas la tshul bzhin du/ /khro ba'i stobs kyis rlag par byed pa mtshar/ /rgyab rten srung ma'i mthu dang bsod nams kyis/ /srung ba'i go cha rtag tu bgos gyur cing / /rig sngags dmod pa drag po'i mtshon cha can/ /257

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mi yi seng ge sa rnams kun las rgyal/ /dus su bab nas rang gi stobs/ /smin pa'i bar du bsgugs byas te/ /snying stobs ldan pas brtsams byas na/ /dgra la bgyi ba ci zhig dka'/ /tshod shes pa yi skye bos ni/ /dus su dgra dang 'dum par bya /dus su bshes dang 'thab par bya/ /res 'ga' rtsom 'gyur res 'ga' bshol/ /res 'ga' lkugs pa'am 'on pa lta bur gyis/ /dus la bab na sa bdag bzhin du smros/ /res 'ga' gangs ri bzhin du bsil bar gyis/ /dus la bab na me lce bzhin du spor/ /res 'ga' rtswa dang 'dra bar zhum par bya/ /dus la bab na ri rab lta bur gyis/ /res 'ga' rgyal po lta bur 'byor bya zhing / /dus su bab na thub 'dra nags su song / /258

thabs mkhas sgo nas phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i tshul brtag pa/res 'ga' dga' ba'i glu gar rtsed 'jo bya/ /res 'ga' ri dwags bzhin du sba bar byed/ /dus su seng ge bzhin du nyams rtsal bstan/ /dus dang dus min shes nas de ltar spyad/ /yul dus mi yi khyad par las/ /dgra sde shin tu stobs ldan la'ang / /'gran zhing rgol ba'i las byas na/ /ya mtshan rang gis len pa yod/ /rang nyid dpung bcas stobs ldan kyang / /yul dus dbang po'i khyad par las /shin tu nyam chung dgra la yang / /mi bsdo bag zon bya ba'ang yod/ /re zhig bsdo bar mi 'os gnad/ /mthong tshe btang snyoms bzhag byas te/ /glang chen lta stangs tshul gyis ni/ /ma shes bzhin du gnas par bya/ /nyungs ma'i rma bzhin 'phel ba yi/ /259

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/srol ngan dgra bo'i rgyun srang lam/ /chung ngu'i dus na nan tur gyis/ /gcod par byed pa mkhas pa yin/ /des mtshon bya ba sna tshogs la/ /bgyi dang mi bgyi'i chag tshad ni/ /blo gros gsal bas mthong 'gyur gyi/ /blun pos 'bad kyang ji ltar shes/ /shin tu bden pa'i gtam yin yang / / yul dang dus la ma bstun na/ /gzhan gyi rna bar mi 'jebs pas /ran par smra ba mchog tu mdzes/ /shin tu phun sum tshogs gyur kyang / /dogs med bag brkyang mi bya ste/ /skye bo las kyi rjes 'brangs pas/ /skyid sdug sna tshogs da gdod 'byung / /shin tu nyam thag gyur na yang / /brnyas thabs 'khur bar mi bya ste/ /260

thabs mkhas sgo nas phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i tshul brtag pa/nor 'dzin yangs pa'i lto ba ru/ /su zhig su yi bran du bzhag /shin tu phongs par gyur na yang / /chos las ldog par mi bya ste/ /chos bzhin byas na rgud pa'i phyogs/ /rmi lam bzhin du yal bar nus/ /shin tu stobs dang ldan na yang / /pha rol khyad du mi gsad par/ /ji ltar 'os par rjes bzung na/ /rang gi phun sum tshogs pa 'phel/ /ltar snang bzang po'i rkyen phal cher/ /ngan pa'i gegs su gyur pa mang /ltar snang ngan pa'i bya ba phal/ /rang la phan par gyur pa'ang yod/ /shin tu 'byed dka' nyam nga ba'i/ /gnas la gzhan dring mi 'jog par/ /shes rab stobs kyis 'byed byed pa/ /261

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/de dag blo dang ldan par bgrang / /blun pos 'bad de byin pa bas/ /mkhas pas spyo ba ngo sor brtsi/ /mi ngan khros te brdeg pa las/ /mkhas pas 'dzum pa khyad du thon/ /thabs la mkhas pas mnar byas kyang / /lcags kyus glang bzhin de yid 'gugs/ /mi mkhas skye bos bskyangs byas kyang / /skyug log zas bzhin gzhan yid ldog /'jug pa'i tshul gyis ldog byed la/ /ldog pa'i tshul gyis 'jug byed pa/ /thabs mkhas ldan pa'i bya ba ni/ /gzhan gyis gting mi dpog bzhin 'grub/ /yid la ri mor bris pa gang / /nam mkha'i gter bzhin mi mngon kyang / /dus su bab tshe don rnams kun/ /ma 'dres za 'og ris bzhin gsal/ /262

thabs mkhas sgo nas phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i tshul brtag pa/sus kyang mtshang du shes nus pa'i/ /g.yo la thabs mkhas zhes mi bya/ /thabs mkhas ldan pa'i bya ba ni/ /kun gyis ngo mtshar phud du sgrogs/ /lha dang drang srong stobs ldan rgyal/ /thabs mkhas bsod nams ldan pa yi/ /tshig tsam gyis kyang phan gnod cher/ /nus na bya bas lta ci smos/ /thog mar 'jug pa'i gzhi mthong nas/ /mi shes skye bos dpya byed kyang / /tha mar grub 'bras mthong ba'i tshe/ /blo ldan de la kun kyang smon/ /de phyir phal ba'i spyod yul las/ /'das pa'i blo gros ldan rnams kyi/ /bya ba'i drod tshad mi zin pas/ /byas pa'i lag rjes blta bar byos/ /nags la me chen mched pa na/ /263

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'thor rlung che yang grogs su 'gyur/ /blo gros mchog tu gyur rnams la/ /gnod par sbyor kyang phan par 'gyur/ /rmongs pa'i khur du lci ba yi/ /bya ba phal cher mkhas la yang / /dug gis rma bya'i lus bzhin du/ /thabs mkhas ldan rnams dgra yis 'tsheng / /dpung las rgyal na dpa' bo ste/ /chung ma gsod kyang dpa' bo min/ /nyam nga'i gnas las rgyal dgos kyi/ /'khor la 'gying tshul bstan pas ci/ /rta dang glang po mi rnams ni/ /ltar snang so so'i ris su mnyam/ /nang gi yon tan khyad par che/ /las la sbyar tshe skyes bu rtogs/ /gsug dang rgyal po'i bka' drin dang / /smad 'tshong gla dang legs brjod dang / /264

thabs mkhas sgo nas phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i tshul brtag pa/gru yi gla dang gnas kyi skal/ /ring na mi 'thob dus der blang / /dam pa bsten dang rig pa bslab/ /bzo gnas sbyang dang nor gsog pa/ /lha sgrub ting 'dzin sgom pa sogs/ /ngang thung mi bya mthar gyis brtson/ /drag po'i rno dbal mtshon gyi yu ba la/ /dbang gi ru dar dmar po phyar ba yi/ /dgra las rnam par rgyal ba'i ba dan ni/ /blo mchog dpa' bo'i lag na rnam par gnas/ /zhi zhing dul la khro na bzod par dka'/ /bsten na rgyal byed 'thab na pham par byed/ /btud na rjes 'dzin 'gran na tshar gcod pa/ /mi mchog skyes bu ngo mtshar rnam mang ldan/ /shin tu phyi thag ring po'i mig rgyang gis/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i pha rol brgal gyur pas/ /go 'phang je mtho je mthor phyin rnams kyis/ /265

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/tshangs pa'i gnas kyang mog por bgyid la phyogs/ /de yi grags pa shin tu rgya che bas/ /nam mkha'i stos kyang ral bar 'gyur snyam du/ /'chi med lam na rgyu ba'i rgyu skar tshogs/ /dus su 'dar ba byed pa de mthong nas/ /nor 'dzin bu mo'i phang bar brten pa yi/ /me tog gzhon nu'i tshogs kyang mig phye nas/ /ge sar gsar ba'i so phreng ngom bzhin du/ /gcig tu dgod par byed pa yin nam snyam/ / slu bar rtsom pa'i g.yon can rnams/ /tshig tsam smos pas shes byas te/ /g.yon can g.yon gyis rmongs byas kyang / /des ma tshor ba mkhas pa'i mthu/ /brkam chags nor la brkams gyur rnams/ /nor gyis bslus nas rang dbang du/ /bcings par byas kyang mi shes bzhin/ /byas pa gzo ba mkhas pa'i mthu/ /266

thabs mkhas sgo nas phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i tshul brtag pa/sdang ba'i sems kyis gnod sbyor ba/ /gnod pa po la bzlog gyur kyang / /rang gi nyes pas byas snyam du/ /dul gyur mkhas pa'i cho 'phrul yin/ /nga rgyal can la nga rgyal gyi/ /mtshon cha khong nas bslangs byas pas/ /nga rgyal ri bo 'jig byed pa/ /blo ldan mchog gi che ba nyid/ /phrag dog can la phrag dog yul/ /rang gi yon tan stobs spel nas/ /'thab pa med par pha rol po/ /zil du rlag byed thabs mkhas stobs/ /rang gi bgyi ba gang yin pa'i/ /brnag pa dag ni mthar dbyung ste/ /phas rgol phyogs las rnam rgyal zhing / /ris su gtogs rnams dbugs 'byin byed/ /'di ltar thabs mkhas ldan pa de/ /267

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'khor los sgyur dang nyi ma bzhin/ /sa steng 'dir ni grogs med par/ /gcig pus sa 'di zil gyis gnon/ /'dod na rgyal srid rang gir nus/ /mi 'dod rgyal srid thob kyang 'dor/ /gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog pa/ /skyes bu rnams kyi khyu mchog 'gyur/ /'di 'dra tshul 'dis bya'o zhes/ /brjod pa'i lam gyis mtshon par dka'/ /bsod nams mthu dang blo gros stobs/ /lha yi byin rlabs dpal las 'byung / / skyes bu 'gran pa'i zla med rnams/ /rigs dang ris ni gar gtogs par/ /byung yang tha ma'i dus kyi bar/ /bzang po'i btsas su 'gyur ba yin/ /luṭa kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan las/thabs la mkhas pa'i sgo nas phyoṭa las rnam par rgyal ba'i tshul brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa ste bco brgyad pa'o//268

chos la sems pa'i tshul brtag pa/rab tubyed pa bcu dgu ba/ tshas la sems pa'i tshul brtag pa/mi bdag blo gros mchog ldan rnams/ /glog gi zlos gar dang mtshungs pa'i/ /tshe 'di nyid kyi bde thabs tsam/ /gtso bor byed pa ma yin no/ / byis pa gang zhig mi mkhas pa/ /yud tsam gyi ni bde ba la/ /chags nas sdig pa'i las byas pas /sdug bsngal mu mtha' med pa 'thob/ /dam pa'i chos la gnas byas na/ /mi yi chos lugs zhar la 'byung / /de yi phun sum tshogs pa dag /nam yang 'grib med 'phel bar 'gyur/ /269

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mi yi chos lugs legs spyad na/ /lha yul bgrod pa thag mi ring / /lha dang mi yi them skas la/ /'dzegs na thar pa gam na 'dug /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor thob dus 'dir/ /bag yod par ni ma byas na/ /'chi bdag pho nya byung ba'i tshe/ /'gyod kyang bcos su ga la yod/ /kye ma 'du byed rnams mi rtag /skye zhing 'jig pa'i chos can yin/ /skye ba yod na 'chi ba yod/ /'dus pa yod na 'bral ba yod/ /gang zhig skyes pa de nas brtsams/ /ri gzar gyi ni 'bab chu bzhin/ /skye rgu'i tshe ni skad cig kyang / /mi sdod 'chi bdag drung du 'gro/ /bya ba byas dang ma byas zhes/ /270

chos la sems pa'i tshul brtag pa/'chi bdag 'di ni mi sdod pas/ /bsod nams bya ba gang yin pa/ /de ring nyid du brtun te bya/ /'byor pa g.yo zhing lang tsho yud kyis 'jig /srog ni gshin rje'i so phrag gnas dang mtshungs/ /'on kyang 'jig rten pha rol sgrub la lhod/ /kye ma mi yi spyod pa ngo mtshar che/ /'du 'dzi kun tu spang bar gyis/ /gal te de spong ma nus na/ /dam pa dag dang 'dre bar gyis/ /de nyid de yi sman yin no/ /'dod pa kun tu spang bar gyis/ /gal te de spong ma nus na/ /thar pa dag la 'dod par gyis/ /de nyid de yi sman yin no/ /gal te 'gro ba 'di kun gyis/ /'chi bdag spyi bor gnas mthong tshe/ /271

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/zas kyang yi gar mi 'ong na/ /bya ba gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /de 'dra'i 'chi bdag de yang ni/ /mdun na bsgug pa bzhin du sdod/ /klad par gnam lcags bab pa bzhin/ /nam 'byung nges pa'i cha med do/ /mi rnams tshe ni rab thung la/ /de phyed mtshan mos 'das par byas /na rga nyon mongs 'jigs sogs kyis/ /phyed po'ang bde bar spyad du med/ /yud tsam gyi ni tshe 'di la/ /bag med rnam g.yeng gis bslus nas/ /dal 'byor chud zar gyur pa rnams/ /kye ma ngan song gnas su lhung / /'bar ba'i me yis bsregs pa dang / /gangs kyi sbubs su chud pa sogs/ /shin tu tsha zhing grang ba yi/ / 272

chos la sems pa'i tshul brtag pa/dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal ji ltar bzod/ /de bzhin ltogs shing phongs pa yi/ /yi dwags kyi ni sdug bsngal dang / /shin tu blun zhing phan tshun 'tshe/ /bkol spyod myong ba'i dud 'gro ste/ /ngan song gsum du lhung ba rnams/ /yun ring sdug bsngal mi bzad phyir/ /g.yang sa de la bsam bzhin du/ /sems shes su zhig 'jug par nus/ /mi la skye rga na 'chi dang / /lha la 'pho zhing ltung ba sogs/ /mtho ris kyi ni gnas rnams la'ang / /sdug bsngal rnam pa mang dang ldan/ /ngo bo nyid kyis sdug bsngal dang / /bde bar snang yang 'gyur ba dang / /sdug bsngal phyi ma'i rgyur 'gyur phyir/ /sdug bsngal gsum dang 'brel bas na/ /273

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mi gtsang 'dam la dri zhim bzhin/ /'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba med/ /me 'obs srin gling 'dra ba der/ /byis pa'i skye bo rtag tu 'khor/ /gang zhig mtho ris ngan song du/ /bde sdug myong bar byed pa ni/ /dge dang sdig pa'i las yin te/ /las byas rang la smin par nges/ /rgyal srid 'byor pa rgya che yang /rga dang na dang 'chi ba sogs/ /kun gyi thun mong yin pa'i phyir/ /sus kyang 'di las ji ltar 'da'/ /dus kyis gnyer te rgyal po 'gro 'gyur na/ /longs spyod mdza' dang gnyen bshes rjes mi 'brang / /skyes bu dag ni gang gnas gar 'gro yang / /las ni grib ma bzhin du rjes su 'brang / /lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /274

chos la sems pa'i tshul brtag pa/bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /de phyir rgyu 'bras bslu med la/ /yid ches par ni gyur pa gang / /'jig rten yang dag lta ba ste/ /dkar po'i chos kun rtsa ba yin/ /'jig rten pa yi yang dag lta/ /chen po su la yod gyur pa/ /de ni tshe rabs stong du yang / /ngan 'gror 'gro bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rgyu 'bras rten 'brel zab mo'i tshul mkhyen nas/ /thar pa'i lam ni 'gro ba'i bla mas bstan/ /drang srong chen po skyabs kyi mchog gyur pa/ /ston pa de dang mtshungs pa gzhan yod min/ /gang de'i thugs su chud nas legs bstan pa/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyi rang bzhin can/ /275

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/zhi bsil bde ba bdud rtsi'i sprin chen po/ /chos mchog de dang mtshungs pa gzhan du med/ /chos kyi bdud rtsis bdag rgyud tshims byas pas /zhing gi dam pa dag pa'i zla 'dra ba/ /yon tan gzhir gyur dge 'dun rin po che/ /tshogs kyi nang na de dang 'dra gzhan med/ /rin chen rnam gsum grags pa'i gdugs dkar po/ /srid zhi'i dge legs kun gyi 'byung gnas la/ /yid ches dad pas sten par byed pa rnams/ /bde nas bde bar byang chub mchog tu 'gro/ /'jigs pas skrag pa'i mi rnams ni/ /phal cher ri dang nags tshal dang / /kun dga' ra dang mchod gnas kyi/ /ljon shing che la skyabs 'gro ste/ /skyabs de gtso bo ma yin zhing / /skyabs de la ni bsten nas su/ /sdug bsngal kun las mi grol gyi/ /276

chos la sems pa'i tshul brtag pa/gang tshe gang zhig sangs rgyas dang / /chos dang dge 'dun skyabs song ste/ /sdug bsngal sdug bsngal kun 'byung dang / /sdug bsngal yang dag 'das pa dang / /'phags lam yan lag brgyad bde ba/ /mya ngan 'das par 'gro 'gyur gang / /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po dag /shes rab kyis ni lta byed pa/ /skyabs de gtso bo yin pa ste/ /skyabs de la ni bsten nas su/ /sdug bsngal kun las grol bar 'gyur/ / mtshungs med ston pa mchog des 'gro ba kun/ /byams brtse'i thugs kyis bdag gir bzhes pas na/ /gzhal med yon tan mchog gi gnas thob phyir/ /bdag kyang de yi tshul la bslab par bya/ /gang zhig thog med dus nas yang dang yang / /pha dang mar gyur 'gro ba'i tshogs 'di dag /277

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dbang med sdug bsngal gsum gyis mnar ba la/ /sems shes su zhig snying rje bskyed mi 'gyur/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i yid can rnams/ /phan dang bde ba'i gnas la sbyor ba'i phyir/ /byang chub mchog tu sems ni bskyed bgyis na/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i pha rol 'gro bar 'gyur/ /byang chub gzhir gyur pa yi rang byung sems/ /thog ma nyid du bskyed pa gang yin pa/ /de yi yon tan bsngags pa mtha' yas te/ /mtshungs med kyis kyang yongs su brjod mi spyod/ /lugs kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan las/ chos la sems pa'i tshul brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa ste bcu dgu ba'o//278

bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po brtag pa/rab tuzud pa nyi shu ba/ bsod nams byu ba'i da'os dzo brtag pha/yab gcig 'di nyid las kyi sa/ /'di nas pha rol 'bras bu'i sa/ /'dir ni gang zhig byas gyur pa/ /de nyid gzhan du nges par spyod/ /dge dang sdig pa chung ngu la'ang / /'bras bu rgya cher so sor 'byin/ /las kyi sa par skyes bzhin du/ /dge ba'i sa bon cis mi gdab/ /dam pas sdig pa chung yang spong / /ngan pa rnams ni che yang min/ /mig ni rdul kyang 'dzem byed la/ /lag pas me lcer reg par byed/ /279

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/lus ni chu yi chu bur lta bu ste/ /dpal dang 'byor pa ston ka'i sprin ltar g.yo/ /yid brtan mi rung 'khor ba'i phun tshogs kyi/ /rang bzhin shes nas gtong la mos par bya /bsags shing mi spyad pa yi nor/ /su yi yin pa gtol med la/ /btang na 'bras bu rgya chen po/ /'jig rten gzhan du rjes su 'brang / /nor rnams chud mi za ba yi/ /gter chen dag tu bskyil 'dod na/ /bsags shing 'jungs par mi bya bar/ /gtong zhing rjes su yi rang bya/ /longs spyod che yang phan pa chung / /gtong ba chung yang 'bras bu che/ /byin na 'phel ba'i sgo yin kyang / /blun po rnams kyis zad par dogs/ /gang la byis pa mngon chags pa/ /280

bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po brtag pa/de la mkhas rnams chags mi 'gyur/ /rgyal po'i shing rta bkra ba ltar/ /lus 'di rtag tu blta bar gyis/ /gang la 'jungs pa rnam chags pa/ /de la mkhas rnams chags mi 'gyur/ /sbrang mas bsags pa'i sbrang rtsi bzhin/ /nor 'di rtag tu blta bar gyis/ /mi bdag bzang po pad+ma'i tshal lta bu/ /gtong ba'i dri bsung phyogs su khyab pa na/ /sa gzhi'i skye bo me tog zas can rnams/ /dga' ba'i gar gyis 'du zhing dga' bar 'gyur/ /tshe dang 'byor pa snyan par grags pa dang / /'di dang phyi ma'i bde ba rgya che ba/ /gtong ba'i thabs mchog gcig gis 'grub nus kyang / /blo ngan rdzas la chags pas mi nus so/ /ngang gis g.yo zhing snying po ma mchis la /dam du bzung yang nam zhig 'dor nges pa'i/ /281

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/longs spyod chu yi lbu ba lta bu la/ /snying po len phyir gtong bar cis mi 'bad/ /sbyin pa 'jig rten rgyan yin te/ /sbyin pas ngan 'gro ldog par byed/ / sbyin pa mtho ris skas yin te/ /sbyin pa zhi byed dge ba 'o/ /mi zad longs spyod 'thob 'dod na/ /gtong la mos pa rgya cher bya/ /de yi rnam smin lta zhog gi /tshe 'dir phan pa ma mthong ngam /blun po rnams kyis lus bkol nas/ /nor gsog pa yis tshe gtugs te/ /sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig 'thob 'gyur zhing / /rgas nas 'dod pas ci zhig bya/ /rmad byung 'byor pa shin tu yid 'ong zhing / /na chung tshogs dang lhan cig rtse ba yi /mi yi bdag po'i spyod yul nyams dga' ba/ /282

bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po brtag pa/mig 'phrul ltad mos byis pa slu dang 'dra/ /de phyir nor la ma chags par/ /mchod dang sbyin pa ci nus bya/ /mgon med skye bo rnams la ni/ /mi 'jigs skyabs kyi sbyin pa dang / /'jig rten ldong ba lta bu la/ /shes rab mig ni rnam 'byed phyir/ /chos kyi sbyin pa dri med pa/ /sa bdag rnams kyis bstsal par bya/ /rmongs pa'i dbang gis 'khor ba 'dir/ /dbang med sdug bsngal myong rnams la/ /rang gi lus dang longs spyod sogs/ /bdog pa'i dngos po thams cad kyis/ /ji ltar sdug bsngal kun bsal nas/ /bde bar 'gyur bar bya snyam du/ /phyogs dang dus kyi mtha' klas pa'i/ /skyes bu chen po'i 'du shes bskyed/ /283

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dus su gso sbyong len pa'am/ /rgyun gyi khrims dang gang ldan pa'i/ /mi bdag de ni mtho ris su/ /lha yi rgyal srid yang dag byed/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i dngos po rnams/ /sa la brten te gnas pa ltar/ /srid dang zhi ba'i yon tan kun/ /tshul khrims nyid la brten par gsungs/ /ngag rnams srung zhing yid ni legs bsdams te/ /lus kyis mi dge ba dag spyad mi bya/ /las lam gsum po 'di ni rnam sbyang na/ /drang srong gsungs pa'i lam ni 'thob par 'gyur/ /rang nyid dge ba bcu yi tshul la gnas/ /'khor gyi skye bo kun kyang de la 'god/ /rnam pa sna tshogs phan dang bde ba'i thabs/ /dbang phyug che ldan mi dbang rnams kyis bgyid/ /sbrul gdug lta bur rang bzhin gyis/ /284

— bsodanams bya ba'i dngos po brtag pa/ngang tshul ngan pa'i mi bsrun pa/ /snyigs ma'i skye bo'i khrod na mang / /de kun su yis gzhom par nus/ /rang gi khro ba gcig spangs na/ /dgra rnams mtha' dag choms dang mtshungs/ /dka' thub kun gyi nang na ni/ /bzod pa phul du byung bar bsngags/ /khro ba'i rkyen gyis bskul nas su/ /rang dbang med par 'tshe byed la/ /dngos po'i rang bzhin shes pa rnams/ /cung zad khro bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gser gyi mdog ltar lta na sdug pa'i lus/ /pad+ma gzhon nu'i ngang tshul 'dzin pa yis/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten mig gi rgyan gyur pa'i/ /mtshungs med lus mchog bzod pas sgrub par byed/ /sdug bsngal ma lus khyad du bsad nas su/ /don chen sgrub la zhum pa med gyur cing / /285

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/zab mo'i chos nyid blo yis bzod gyur pa/ /seng ge bzhin du 'jigs pa med par rgyu/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal ma lus/ /brtson 'grus ldan pas bsgrubs byas na/ /mi 'grub pa ni gang yang med/ / yang dag gnas la spro ba'i blo/ /me lce bzhin du mched gyur na/ /bgyi bar dka' ba'i dngos rnams kyang / /bud shing bzhin du grogs su 'gyur/ /dbang phyug dam pas dbang bgyid rnams/ /mthu dang rtsal ni mi dman pas/ /phyin drug bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi/ /mkha' dang mtsho ltar rgya cher bya/ /dgyes pa'i mig zur gyis bltas pa'ang / /dbul ba'i rgyun ni ma bcad na/ /dbang phyug dam pa min zhes bshad/ /286

bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po brtag pa/des na lag rjes che bar bya/ /yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang / /nyan dang klog dang len pa dang / /'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang / /de sems pa dang sgom pa yi/ /chos spyod rnam pa bcu po de/ /bsod nams phung po dpag med phyir/ /mi bdag rnams kyis 'bad nas su/ /rgyal ba'i dam chos gzung bar bya/ /rang gi bgyi bar kun kyang 'dra/ /gzhan la bgyid du gzhug pa la/ /rgyal po rnams ni dbang che bas/ /rlabs chen dge ba'i srol 'dzugs bya/ /sems ni rnam par g.yeng ba'i mi/ /chu bo'i rlabs kyis khyer ba bzhin/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal tshogs kyis dkrugs/ /rang dbang bde ba nam yang dka'/ /287

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ngal ba brgya yis gtses pa yis/ /lus dub pa yis ci zhig bya/ / byed po sems ni dul ba na/ /thar pa gam na gnas dang mtshungs/ /yid ni dul bar ma gyur na/ /ngur smrig mdzes pa'i bla gos dang / /tshangs skud ku sha'i chun po yis/ /rtog ngan ji ltar zhi bar nus/ /dam pa grong na gnas kyang dul/ /mi bsrun dgon par gnas kyang gyong / /grong gi rta mchog dul ba dang / /nags kyi gcan gzan khro ba bzhin/ /sems ni glog dang sprin dang rlung dang mtshungs/ /rgya mtsho chen po yi ni rlabs dang 'dra/ /sgyu can 'dod rgu'i yul la mngon dga' ba/ /g.yo zhing 'phyan pa nges par gdul bar bya /sems ni las su rung bar gyur pa na/ /288

bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po brtag pa/dang ba'i mtsho la zla skar ji bzhin du/ /mngon par shes pa lnga sogs yon tan ni/ /shin tu rnam pa mang po 'char bar 'gyur/ /zab cing rgya che theg pa chen po'i gzhung / /rna ba'i bdud rtsir ngoms pa med 'thung bas/ /mang du thos pa'i lus stobs rab rgyas te/ /smra ba'i seng ge'i mtshan gyi cod pan 'dzin/ /thos pa'i don la rigs pa bzhis dpyad pas/ /bsam pa las byung shes rab sgron me'i 'od/ /blo ngan mun pa'i 'thibs po sel byed pa/ /yid la nyin mor byed pa bzhin du 'char/ /yang dag don la rtse gcig mnyam bzhag pas/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 'brel ba yi/ /rmad byung shes rab spyan gyis chos kun gyi/ /chos nyid bden pa mngon du gzigs par 'gyur/ /mdun na dpal gnas khyim pa rnams kyis kyang / /shes rab stobs kyis 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho che/ /289

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gnag rjes chu bzhin myur du bskams byas te/ /yang dag thar pa mchog gi gnas su 'gro/ /ji ltar chu bur mthong ba dang / /ji ltar smig rgyu mthong ba ltar/ /de bzhin 'jig rten lta byed pa/ /'chi bdag rgyal pos mthong mi 'gyur/ /shes rab zab mos shin tu legs bstan pa'i/ /'phags pa'i bden pa su dag rnam bsgom pa/ /'jig rten 'di na gang zhig mchis pa yi/ /'jigs pa kun gyis de la 'jigs mi nus/ /phung po 'di dag sgyu ma'i grong khyer bzhin/ /nyon mongs rnams kyang sprin gyi 'du 'god 'dra/ /skye zhing 'pho med rlom pa med mthong ba/ /bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal bar 'gyur/ /rmi lam sgyu ma chu zla'i tshul bzhin du/ /ji ltar snang ba'i kun rdzob 'di shes shing / /gang yang yongs su bzung ba ma mchis pa'i/ /290

bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po brtag pa/nam mkha' lta bu'i don dam yongs su shes/ /snang dang stong pa gnyis su med pa yi/ /bden gnyis dbyer med mnyam pa nyid kyi dbyings/ /rang byung 'od gsal dag pa'i byang chub sems/ /gang gis rtogs pa byang chub mchog 'tshang rgya/ /'jig rten 'dir ni sangs rgyas rnams/ /'byung ba las kyang dkon pa yi/ /'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg /deng sang nyi ma bzhin du 'bar/ /mig 'phrul lta bur bde myur du/ /grol bar byed pa'i lam mchog la/ /blo ldan mi yi bdag po gang / /skal bzang rnams kyis bsten byas na/ /rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti bzhin/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams la/ /ci bde bar ni rol bzhin du/ /zung 'jug mchog gi 'bras bu 'thob/ /291
lugs kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyamyodangos po brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa ste nyi shu ba'o/

lugs kyi bstan bcos kyi yon tan brtag pa/rab tu zud pa nyer gcig pa/ lugs la gnas pha dang lugs kyi bstan bcos kyi yon tan brtag pa/gang zhig ji skad bshad pa yi/ /lugs la gnas pa'i rgyal po rnams/ /sa yi steng na nyi ma bzhin/ /kun gyi rgyan du legs par 'gyur/ /snyigs dus yon tan 'di dag dang / /ldan pa'i rgyal po 'byung bar dka'/ / gal te byung na de gcig pus/ /sa rnams mtha' dag dbang du bsgyur/ /gong du ji skad bshad pa yi/ /yon tan phal cher tshang gyur kyang / /dpal dang 'byor pa snyan grags sgra/ /293

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dbyar gyi rnga bzhin cis mi sgrog /tshul bzhin lugs la gnas pa yi/ /mi bdag gang du byung ba der/ /'khor los sgyur dang nor bu bzhin/ /yon tan rnam pa mang po sdud/ /chos ldan rgyal po lha yi sras/ /mi rnams kun gyi rjer gyur pa/ /'bangs kyi pha dang skye rgu'i gnyen/ /ris med 'gro ba'i mchod sdong yin/ /rin chen ri dbang ji bzhin du/ /skye bo'i dbus na yon tan gyis/ /mngon par 'phags pa'i rgyal po de/ /phyogs dus gang du byung gyur kyang / /ya rabs rnams kyis smon byed la/ /ma rabs rnams kyang bag 'khum 'gyur/ /ched du 'bad pa med par yang / /phyogs rnams kun la ngang gis phan/ /294

lugs kyi bstan bcos kyi yon tan brtag pa/thos kyang bsngags shing dper byed na/ /mthong na dga' bas cis mi blta/ /gzhan gyis lta zhing rjed byed la/ /'bangs kyis bsten pa ci zhig mtshar/ /skal bzang skye bo dgar 'gyur la/ /phrag dog can ni 'khu na yang / /de yi yon tan che ba yis/ /bsdigs pa med par zil gyis gnon/ /rgyal ba rgyal sras 'jig rten skyong / /kun gyis dgyes shing mthu btsal bas /rgyal po de yi stobs dang shugs/ /lo re bzhin yang rgya cher 'phel/ / me tog sman dang 'bru la sogs/ /'phel zhing skyed pa'i 'dzin ma bzhin/ /sa skyong de yi mnga' ris su/ /dge mtshan rnam pa du ma 'byung / /dpa' mdzangs mdzes pa'i mi rnams dang / /295

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/yid du 'ong ba'i longs spyod bcas/ /bde dang skyid pa ngo mtshar dpal/ /'gran pa bzhin du rnam par 'phel /bsdus pa med par longs spyod dang / /skye bo'i 'du ba sprin bzhin rgyas/ /sa gzhi skyong 'di yun ring du/ /'tsho bar gyur ces kun gyis smon/ /snyan grags dri med be+e ḍūr+ya/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i khor yug dang / /ri yi dbang po'i rtse mor yang / /phyogs kyi bu mo'i rna rgyan 'gyur/ /nyin re bzhin yang bdag dang gzhan/ /bsod nams gnas la mngon sbyor bas/ /chu dang rin chen mi zad pa'i/ /rgya mtsho chen po bzhin du 'gengs/ /bsod nams mthu yis 'dod pa'i don/ /'bad pa med par shugs kyis 'grub/ /296

lugs kyi bstan bcos kyi yon tan brtag pa/yul 'khor rtag tu skyid pa dang / /'jig rten pha rol tu yang bde/ /legs pa'i blo dang mnga' thang dpal/ /bsod nams mthu yis cher 'phel zhing / /tshul de'i sgo nas bsod nams kyang / /gong nas gong du spel bar byed/ /nyi ma 'char dang chu klung rgyun/ /bskal pa'i me dang rlung gi shugs/ /chos ldan rgyal po'i gzi byin rnams/ /sus kyang dgag tu med par 'byung / /chos dang srid kyi legs tshogs kun/ /'phel zhing nub pa med pa dang / /bde nas bde bar 'gro ba 'di/ /lugs la gnas pa'i yon tan yin/ /lugs kyi bstan bcos rnam mang po'i/ /legs bshad chu klung kun 'dus pa/ /mi bdag klu dbang tshogs rnams kyi/ /297

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rten gnas rgya mtsho che 'di rmad/ /blang dor bya bar tshad med kyang / /kha cig dngos su bstan pas gsal/ /'ga' zhig shugs las rtogs 'gyur zhing / /gzhan dag 'di yis mtshon nas shes/ /gang zhig 'di las tshigs bcad gcig /shes shing lag tu blangs na yang / /bcud kyis len pa'i sman bzhin du/ /yon tan lang tsho gsar du 'char/ /rgyal po'i rigs su ma skyes kyang / /grong dang khyim gyi gtso bo tshun/ /chos lugs 'di la legs spyad na/ /sa la dbang ba bzhin du mdzes/ /gcig pur grogs med gnas pas kyang / /rgyal po'i chos bzhin rang bsrungs nas/ /sems kyis skye rgu legs bskyangs na/ /nam zhig chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur/ /298

lugs kyi bstan bcos kyi yon tan brtag pa/de phyir gzhung 'di sus bslabs pa/ /rigs kyi rgyal po ma yin kyang / /yon tan rgyal po'i rgyal srid la/ /nges par dbang ba nyid du 'gyur/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten mtha' dag kun/ /rtag tu skyong bar byed pa yi/ /chos kyi rgyal po bcom ldan 'das/ /sras dang bcas pa'i bka' bzhin du/ /rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos gang / /sa steng 'dir ni rgyan gyur pa/ /rgyal sras dam pa'i bkas bskul ltar/ /kun la phan phyir bdag gis bshad/ /thos na dga' skyed lha yi rnga/ /bsams na don bzang bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /goms na dpal 'phel lha'i nor bu/ /mi yi lha rnams rgyan gyi mchog /rgyal srid skyong ba'i skyes bu rnams/ /299

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'jig rten dpal gyis mngon mtho zhing / /chos kyi lam las mi nyams par/ /yang dag 'bras bu 'dis 'thob byed/ /gang zhig lha dang lha min 'thab pa'i tshe/ /lha yi rnga bo che yi sgra bzhin du/ /gzhung 'dis ya rabs rnams ni gzengs bstod cing / /thos pa tsam gyis ma rabs zhum par byed/ /'chi ba slong bar byed pa bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /khong du 'thung ba lha las gzhan pa su/ /de bzhin bskal pa bzang po'i gang zag gis/ /tshul 'di len 'gyur skal dman rnams kyis spong / /lha rdzas nor bus gang gi lus brgyan pa/ /de la dpal rnams sprin bzhin 'du ba ltar/ /gang zhig 'di don nyams su len pa la/ /chos dang srid kyi legs tshogs nges par 'du/ /de phyir rta dang glang po rin chen tshogs/ /brgya stong tshar du dngar ba'i bkod pas kyang / /300

lugs kyi bstan bcos kyi yon tan brtag pa/mi mtshon rin thang bral ba'i legs bshad skyes/ /rgyal sras khyed la dang ba'i sems kyis 'bul/ /kun la phan 'dod thugs brtse ldan pa yi/ /mi mchog gzhon nu khyod kyis ma 'ongs pa'i/ /chos ldan rgyal po'i tshogs la legs bshad 'di'i/ /bdud rtsi'i bgo bsha' dag kyang 'gyed par mdzod/ /khyed dang da ltar bzhugs dang ma 'ongs pa'i/ /rgyal rigs rnams dang gzhan yang skye bo'i tshogs/ /gang gis gzhung 'di mthong thos sems rnams la/ /'dir bshad yon tan kun gyis 'byor gyur cig /lugs kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan las/ lugs la gnas pa dang lugs kyi bstan bcos kyi yon tan brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa ste nyer gcig pa'o// rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras po mkhas rnams kyi/ /legs bshad rin chen bsdus pa'i phreng ba 'di/ /rgyal rigs rnams kyi mgul du thogs byas nas/ /301

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/nyin re bzhin yang bklags shing bsam par bya/ /snyigs ma'i mun pa ches cher bdo na yang / /lhag bsam zla ba'i 'od bzang nyams mi 'gyur/ /bskul dang rtsom pa'i bsam sbyor 'di nyid kyang / /dus su bstan dang 'gro la phan gyur cig /chos ldan rgyal po'i rgyal srid rnam par 'phel/ /de mthus bstan dang 'gro ba'i dpal 'phel zhing / /de yis mkha' khyab skye rgu'i tshogs rnams kyang / /chos rje rgyal po'i rgyal srid 'thob par shog /legs smon bsod nams dus su smin gyur nas/ /byis pa'i dus nas bzang po'i bag chags sad/ /mi yi rje bor lha yis legs bkod khyod/ /'tsho gzhes bzhed pa'i don kun 'grub gyur cig /dmar ser nyi ma 'char kha'i lang tsho can/ /rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i gter khyed rgyal rnams kyis/ /rgyal rigs 'dul ba'i mgon du lung bstan bzhin/ /gzhung 'di 'dzin la blo gros dpal stsol cig /302

lugs kyi bstan bcos kyi yon tan brtag pa/zla gzhon bye ba'i mdzes pa zil gnon pa/ /mig mi 'dzum pa snying rje'i dbang phyug nyid/ /gtam 'di'i tshul gyis brtse ba'i 'od bzang bcas /skye rgu'i yid la bde blag 'jug gyur cig /gnam sngon zhun mar 'khyil 'dra bzod dka'i sku/ /bdud sde mthar byed ye shes rdo rje can/ /'di 'dzin rnams kyi yid la spobs pa dang / /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i stobs skyed cig /gser zhun mdangs 'dra dpal gyi 'od zer can/ /sa yi snying por rab grags mgon po des/ /gzhung 'di gang du dar ba'i sa phyogs su/ /dpal dang 'byor pa'i gter chen rgyas par mdzod/ /sras bcas rgyal ba kun gyi byin rlabs kyis/ /tshul 'di mthong thos dran reg 'dzin pa rnams/ /bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang / /chos mthun bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig /ces rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan zhes 303

da walegasabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bya ba 'di'ang / rgyal ba'i sras po gang zhig rgyal rigs shing sā la chen po lta bur smon lam gyi dbang gis sku 'khrungs pa/ chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i ngang tshul ma sbas par gsal zhing / ya rabs kyi lugs la shin tu gzhol ba/ dam pa'i chos don du gnyer ba la mi ldog pa'i 'dun brtson dang / mkhyen rab kyi spyan ras mchog tu yangs pa/ ris su ma chad pa'i bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa'i thugs/ bskyed mchog tu dkar ba sogs bsngags 'os kyi yon tan rgya mtshos mdzes shing / dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha rnams kyis 'jigs med seng ge'i khri la mnga' gsol ba/ mdo khams sde dge sa skyong bla ma ngag dbang 'jam dpal rin chen gyi zhal snga nas lha rdzas bzang po'i gnang skyes dang bcas te rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos don 'dus la/ yig tshogs mang ba la mi 'dzem par mchog dman sus kyang shin tu go sla ba zhig bris na snyigs dus kyi skye 'gro rnams la phan pa'i gsos su 'gyur ba'i slad du spar du dgod rgyu'i thugs 'dun gyis skul ma nan tan mdzad pa las/ mdo rgyud rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung la thos bsam gyi mig thob pas/legs par bshad pa kun la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa dge ba can/304

— lugasakyibastan bcos kyi yon tan brtag pa/bstan 'gro'i don la lhag bsam mi dman zhing / lhag pa'i lha yi zhabs pad gus pa'i gtsug gis len pa mi pham rnam par rgyal ba'am/ 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje zhes bya bas/ 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa dang / sa snying 'khor lo bcu pa/ mdo sde dran pa nyer bzhag byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul la thabs kyis rnam par 'phrul ba bstan pa'i mdo/ klu yi rgyal po rnga sgra'i tshigs bcad sogs de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' du ma dang / slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab brgya pa/ shes rab sdong bu/ skye bo gso ba'i thigs pa rnams dang / gzhan yang rin chen phreng ba sogs gtam tshogs skor dang / slob dpon ma ti tsi tras rgyal po ka nis ka la springs pa dang / sangs rgyas gsang bas bod rgyal blon la springs pa sogs springs yig dang gtam tshogs kyi skor rnams dang / nyi ma sbas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa'i mdzod/ mchog sred kyi tshigs bcad brgya pa/ ma su rak+ṣas byas pa'i lugs kyi bstan bcos/ tsa na ka'i rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos/don yod 'char gyi dris lan rin po che'i phreng ba/ dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i legs par bshad pa sogs rgya bod mkhas pas brtsams 305

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/pa'i lugs kyi bstan bcos du ma dang / bod yul chos rgyal rnams kyi bka' chems sogs gzhung sna tshogs las gsungs pa'i lugs dang lugs min rnam par 'byed pa'i don mtha' dag gcig tu bsdus nas/ chos srid lugs brgya'i 'dun sa chen po dpal ldan lhun grub steng du grags pa chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyal khab pho brang chen po'i gnas ga la bar/ rab tshes shing mo lug gi lo'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i yar tshes bcu bzhi gza' skar mchog tu dge ba la dbu brtsams nas/ legs smon gyis 'brel ba'i dbang gis gzhung 'di skul ba po lha sras sa dbang bla ma rin po che ngag dbang 'jam dpal rin chen sogs la byams chos skor gzhung bshad bgyis pa'i thun gseng rnams su bris te/ phyi ma dbo zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba gnyis pa gza' skar legs shing dus dge ba'i char grub par bgyis pa'i yi ge pa ni yig ris dang / rig byed kyi gzhung rnams la blo gros gsal ba mdun na 'don bsod nams dpal grub kyis bgyis pa ste/ 'dis kyang nam mkha' ji srid du bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung ba'i rgyu byed par gyur cig maṅga lam̐/ /306

lugs kyi bstan bcos kyi yon tan brtag pa/na ma slarba dzñā ya/ /stobs bcu'i dpal gyis mdzes pa'i nyi ma che/ /'jig rten mgon du byed pa'i dpyid gcig gis/ /legs gsung nor bu'i phung po 'dus pa'i dbyig /lugs mkhyen yongs kyi thugs mtshor mngon gtams pa/ /'phags bod nor bu 'dzin ma'i khyon yangs rnams/ /mdzes byed mkhas mchog du mas bstar ba yi/ /bstan bcos u dus+thā ra'i dga' tshal phul/ /bdag legs 'dod pa rnams kyi don du stsal/ /de dag kun gyi dgongs don gzigs dang bcas/ /smra ba'i seng ge thugs kyi 'khor lo'i dbus/ /brjid chags mi pham rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ /legs bshad mchod sbyin brgya pa'i rnga gsang bsgrags/ /de nyid skul byed sa skyong bla ma che/ /rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i rnam thar 'dzin bzod pas/ /zla med byang chub spyod pa'i rgyun 'bebs phyir/ /chos sbyin phyi mo rdzogs ldan sprin phung gtibs/ /307

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rtsod dus rgyal bstan lnga brgya tha ma'i skabs/ /skye 'gro'i bsam spyod phyin ci log pa'i sgo/ /'gegs byed sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan gyi phul/ /blo ldan yongs kyis dang du len par rigs/ /'di las byung ba'i dge tshogs gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /rnam mkhyen rgya mtshor bskyil dang lha na cig tu/ /sa gsum bkra shis nyi ma kun khyab pas/ /brtan g.yo ji snyed bde legs rgyas gyur cig /gnam sa'i dbang phyug sde bzhi'i chu gter rgyas/ /dge bcu'i bka' khrims dbu rmog dgung du btsan/ /lhar bcas skye rgu yongs kyis btud bzhin du/ /mnga' thang srid pa'i pha mthar brdal gyur cig /mtha' klas gtsug lag ma lus 'dus pa'i gzhung / /srid zhi kun khyab bri gang bral ba'i dngos/ /sngon med legs bshad bde 'byung gtsug rgyan 'di/ /nam mkha' ji srid nub pa med gyur cig / ces spar byang smon lam tshigs su bcad pa'i me tog bkra shis rtags kyi 308

grangs ldan 'di'ang 'jam mgon bla ma rin po che dang / sa skyong ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta mchod yon gyi bka' drin chen pos bskyangs pa'i gus 'bangs 'jam dbyangs dge legs chos 'phel lam/ bso da nams dpal grub kyis lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab chen por smras pa dza yan+tu//(sde dge'i shing par ltar bsgrigs pa yin/)

jus 'god pa/ rin chen don grub/ pad+ma rdo rje/ mkha' 'gro tshe ring /rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ pad+ma rdo rje/deb gzhi'i bzo 'god pa/ zhin ling / dpar yin 'gan len pa/ yi'u chi'u hwa/legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ (deb lnga ba)rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos/'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtshos brtsams/krung go bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas chos lugs zhib 'jug khang gis dag sgrig byas/tāṭ+wāṃsnazlo spe/ la/ mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang /(zi ling grong phro thun rin snyo sgo khyo10)— sprag ang810001 kha par6143426brgyud 'tshong / mtsho sngon zhing chen zhin hwa dpe khang /par 'debs/ mtsho sngon mi rigs par khang /deb tshad/ 85077྾116877 1tre32dpar thog 10 25yig grangs/ khri16par thengs/ 2006lo'i zla4bar par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/dpar thengs/ 2006lo'i zla4bar dpar thengs dang po dpar/dpar grangs/ 1da 4 000dpe rtags/ 152sa7—5420—1216—972 54rin gong / sgor12 00par dbang 'di gar yod pas par bshus brgyab na khrims chad phog(shog ngos chad nor slog skyon gang rung yod tshe par khang la dri gtug bya)

lko shu//༈rwar+sāz-iṣā zalholkorke khri/༅lokā2r+sāṣ+ṭha rdzorngoḥ zazazad+ku mosnyerlukāmikā༈༅ wor+sā11ngukhya.oṃ//lo ṣ+ṭhalko྾ṣ+ṭhastsa.oṃrkelko(5)sdume kālko :sbyiṭha ༈lam̐r+sha4rnya n+d+ra//r+shaglo ༈tshelpam+mulho tshed+ngha7 slolo2(skoṣātsho snro stsa r+sā r+ṣaṭhaṣ+ṭhaphyalone+eṭ+wāṃ(skrutsākothakhrilko10r+ha)ca lhormethilo810001 thulko6143426༅ :khri r+sākhā+ephratshiyā༈spyangukhya 6// r+sār+ṣa༅ṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭṛk+ṣalo/kha)ra thong 850①①྾1168①7 1732tre0 byesdu 10 25dze+e ma 160r+haṭha kre 2006lho4thalko1longukhya tsholko 2006lho4z-ilko1oṃṣ+yok+ṣalo//ngub :yi 1—4000p+lu jo 152smo7—5420—1216—972 54(ṭhaspra)n+t+ra ༈yi/ 1200rkeṭhar+sā(r+shalto 0ngu0/2lko(ā+oṃ.ā+oṃnyakhu+oḍā〉(chaskrah+phustso//lko1r+sādze+ekhuk+ṣaṣ+pe/ḍa4lkolko)
